strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Providence Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 51.1% over the last five entering classes — 499 acceptances from 977 applications.

strings.text: Read each row as a joint figure. It is the rate at which that university admitted this school’s applicants. It is not the university’s overall admit rate, and it does not measure how selective the school itself is. Applied/Accepted are the Fall 2025 entering class. The 5-yr column pools Fall 2021–2025 as sum(accepted)/sum(applied), so a year with many applicants counts more than a year with few. The counts sit beside every rate because several cells are in single digits.
strings.t: Li chak ranje kòm yon chif konjwen. Se to kote inivèsite sa a te admèt kandida lekòl sa a. Se pa to admisyon jeneral inivèsite a, epi li pa mezire jan lekòl la menm selektif. Aplikasyon/Aksepte se pwomosyon ki antre nan otòn 2025 la. Kolòn 5 an an konbine otòn 2021–2025 kòm sòm(aksepte)/sòm(aplikasyon), konsa yon ane ki gen anpil kandida konte plis pase yon ane ki gen kèk sèlman. Chif yo chita bò kote chak to paske plizyè selil gen yon sèl chif.

strings.text: Rank order follows the US News **National Universities** table for NC publics. That qualifier matters: Appalachian State is ranked in **Regional Universities South**, a different list, so “top 6 in NC” is not self-defining. Re-score when the next edition lands.
strings.t: Lòd klasman an swiv tablo **National Universities** US News la pou inivèsite piblik NC yo. Presizyon sa a enpòtan: Appalachian State klase nan **Regional Universities South**, yon lis diferan, konsa « pi bon 6 nan NC » pa defini tèt li. Re-evalye lè pwochen edisyon an soti.

strings.text: Published maxima — **two APs for sophomores, three for juniors, four for seniors** — tell colleges exactly what a demanding schedule means here, so a normal load is not penalised.

strings.text: Quote the school’s 93% / 76%; never recompute them from the AP table. The 2026–27 profile prints Computer Science Principles as 116 exams, but that row’s score cells sum to 126, so summing every cell gives 1,292 rather than the headline 1,282. The school’s percentages match the 1,282 denominator.
strings.t: Site 93% / 76% lekòl la; pa janm rekalkile yo apati tab AP a. Pwofil 2026–27 la bay 116 egzamen pou Computer Science Principles, men selil nòt ranje sa a fè 126, kidonk si ou adisyone tout selil yo ou jwenn 1,292 olye 1,282 ki nan tit la. Pousantaj lekòl la matche ak denominatè 1,282 la.

strings.text: The school publishes no comparison of how hard it grades against local public schools, and no outside group checks its grades. The quintile table and the rule that AP exams are required answer the question indirectly. A direct comparison of grade inflation is not published.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn konparezon sou jan li bay nòt di konpare ak lekòl piblik lokal yo, epi pa gen okenn gwoup deyò ki verifye nòt li yo. Tab senkyèm nan ak règ ki fè egzamen AP yo obligatwa a reponn kesyon an yon fason endirèk. Yon konparezon dirèk sou enflasyon nòt pa pibliye.

strings.t: Rapò ~36:1 pou elèv dènye ane a ak rapò ~151:1 pou tout nivo yo kalkile apati chif enskripsyon pwofil la (754 Upper School, 179 elèv dènye ane ÷ 5), lekòl la pa pibliye yo. Kalifikasyon konseye yo ak ansyen wòl nan admisyon soti nan agregatè.

strings.text: The office leaves four things unpublished. It gives no promise that every application is formally reviewed before it is sent. It states no written Early Decision / Early Action strategy and no position on test-optional applying. And it gives no FAFSA/CSS Profile timelines beyond its general “Paying for College” sessions.
strings.t: Biwo a pa pibliye kat bagay. Li pa bay okenn garanti ke yo revize chak aplikasyon fòmèlman anvan yo voye l. Li pa bay okenn estrateji Early Decision / Early Action ekri, ni okenn pozisyon sou aplike san tès. Epi li pa bay okenn kalandriye FAFSA/CSS Profile pi lwen pase sesyon jeneral “Paying for College” li yo.

strings.text: Two levers work at once. The student builds a standout strength that colleges can check, through first-in-the-nation diploma programmes and a required internship. And the Academic Profile shares so much that it vouches for the student.
strings.t: De leviye travay an menm tan. Elèv la bati yon fòs espesyal inivèsite yo ka verifye, atravè pwogram diplòm ki premye nan peyi a ak yon estaj obligatwa. Epi Academic Profile la pataje tèlman enfòmasyon ke li sèvi kòm garanti pou elèv la.

strings.text: **Global Studies Diploma** — “the first of its kind in the country”. It begins in 9th grade and requires a world language all four years. It also requires globally focused courses, a cross-cultural experience and a personal portfolio. The final course, Global Leadership, ends in a long research paper. **375 graduates since 2007**, 23 in the Class of 2026 alone.
strings.t: **Global Studies Diploma** — “premye nan kalite l nan peyi a”. Li kòmanse nan 9yèm ane epi li egzije yon lang etranje pandan tout kat ane yo. Li egzije tou kou ki konsantre sou mond lan, yon eksperyans ant kilti ak yon pòtfèy pèsonèl. Dènye kou a, Global Leadership, fini ak yon long papye rechèch. **375 gradye depi 2007**, 23 nan sèl Klas 2026 la.

strings.text: **Diploma in Entrepreneurial Studies** — new for 2026, sitting inside IDEAS@PD (Innovation, Design, Entrepreneurship, Analytics, Sustainability) with industry-certification opportunities and business partnerships.
strings.t: **Diploma in Entrepreneurial Studies** — nouvo pou 2026, ki chita anndan IDEAS@PD (Innovation, Design, Entrepreneurship, Analytics, Sustainability) ak opòtinite pou sètifikasyon endistri ak patenarya biznis.

strings.text: **Required 30-hour Senior Project internship** — every student must complete it to graduate, so every graduate leaves with documented work experience. The school deliberately has *no* community-service requirement.
strings.t: **Estaj Senior Project 30 èdtan obligatwa** — chak elèv dwe fè l pou l gradye, kidonk chak gradye pati ak yon eksperyans travay ki dokimante. Lekòl la espre *pa gen* okenn kondisyon sèvis kominotè.

strings.text: **Recruiting & arts tracks** — “Facts About Athletic Recruiting” and “Studying the Arts in College” sessions run in alternating years. The Class of 2026 sent 31 student-athletes to college sport, 13 at Division I.
strings.t: **Pis rekritman ak atizay** — sesyon “Facts About Athletic Recruiting” ak “Studying the Arts in College” fèt an altènans chak ane. Klas 2026 la te voye 31 atlèt-elèv nan espò inivèsitè, 13 nan Division I.

strings.text: The school has announced an Entrepreneurial Studies Diploma. But its course requirements, final project and internship setup are not published, and questions go to an email address. Global Studies, by contrast, publishes both its requirements and its count of 375 graduates.
strings.t: Lekòl la anonse yon Diplòm Entrepreneurial Studies. Men kondisyon kou li yo, pwojè final li ak fason estaj la òganize pa pibliye, epi kesyon yo ale nan yon adrès imèl. Global Studies, okontrè, pibliye ni kondisyon li yo ni kantite 375 gradye li yo.

strings.text: Lever 2 — What the school brings
strings.t: Leviye 2 — Sa lekòl la pote

strings.text: **The Academic Profile as an instrument** — it shares far more than most school profiles, and that openness is what the school brings. It gives the full AP score spread for each of 29 subjects. Its quintile table shows the average SAT and ACT for each fifth of the class. It states the most APs a student may take in each grade. It also gives the weighting formula, with unweighted grades on the transcript. That turns the no-rank policy from a weakness into useful context.
strings.t: **Academic Profile la kòm yon zouti** — li pataje plis enfòmasyon pase pifò pwofil lekòl, epi se ouvèti sa a lekòl la pote. Li bay distribisyon konplè nòt AP pou chak nan 29 matyè. Tab senkyèm li a montre SAT ak ACT mwayèn pou chak senkyèm nan klas la. Li di konbyen AP yon elèv ka pran pi plis nan chak klas. Li bay tou fòmil pwa a, ak nòt san pwa sou relve nòt la. Sa fè politik san ran an pase de yon feblès pou l vin yon kontèks itil.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — the school states it follows the **NACAC Guide to Ethical Practice**. It also “reports all student behavioral probations, suspensions and expulsions through time of graduation” to any college that asks. A student-run Honor Council backs this up. It has eight students, two per grade, plus two elected faculty members and a third named by the Head of School. Being this open earns the trust of college readers, and every applicant gains from it.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — lekòl la deklare li swiv **NACAC Guide to Ethical Practice**. Li “rapòte tout pwobasyon konpòtman elèv, sispansyon ak ekspilsyon jiska moman gradyasyon” bay nenpòt inivèsite ki mande tou. Yon Honor Council elèv yo dirije sipòte sa. Li gen uit elèv, de pa klas, plis de pwofesè yo eli ak yon twazyèm Head of School la nonmen. Ouvèti sa a genyen konfyans moun k ap li dosye yo nan inivèsite, epi chak aplikan benefisye de li.

strings.text: **Repeat pipelines, numbered rather than implied** — the Class of 2025 scholar was Providence Day’s **18th Morehead-Cain**. That is a record going back decades with North Carolina’s most selective merit award. The colleges in bold across the list work as a practical map of the school’s pipelines. Four of the five federal service academies appear.
strings.t: **Rezo ki repete, ak chif olye ke sijere** — elèv Klas 2025 la se te **18yèm Morehead-Cain** Providence Day. Sa se yon istwa ki gen dè deseni ak prim merit ki pi selektif North Carolina. Inivèsite an gra atravè lis la sèvi kòm yon kat pratik rezo lekòl la. Kat nan senk akademi sèvis federal yo parèt.

strings.text: **Two-way relationships and memberships** — the school belongs to NAIS, NCAIS, SAIS, ERB, NACAC, SACAC, **ACCIS** and the College Board, plus Global Online Academy. It is accredited by SAIS and SACS, and **81%** of Upper School faculty hold advanced degrees. The school hosted ~150 college reps and visited 50+ campuses, a real two-way flow. A deep UK/Europe pipeline (Oxford, St Andrews, UCL, LSE, Trinity Dublin, Bocconi, Toronto) fits its Global Studies focus.
strings.t: **Relasyon nan de sans ak manbraj** — lekòl la manm NAIS, NCAIS, SAIS, ERB, NACAC, SACAC, **ACCIS** ak College Board, plis Global Online Academy. Li akredite pa SAIS ak SACS, epi **81%** nan pwofesè Upper School yo gen yon diplòm siperyè. Lekòl la resevwa ~150 reprezantan inivèsite epi li vizite 50+ kanpis, yon vrè echanj nan de sans. Yon rezo UK/Ewòp pwofon (Oxford, St Andrews, UCL, LSE, Trinity Dublin, Bocconi, Toronto) matche ak konsantrasyon Global Studies li.

strings.text: No class rank — a published quintile table gives colleges rank-like context without pitting classmates against each other, so several students can present as top candidates.
strings.t: Pa gen ran nan klas — yon tab senkyèm ki pibliye bay inivèsite yo yon kontèks tankou yon ran san mete kanmarad klas kont youn lòt, kidonk plizyè elèv ka prezante kòm bon kandida.

strings.text: It is also the most revealing and honest table the school prints. A 338-point SAT gap between the top and bottom fifths shows a large class with a wide range of students, not one that is elite all the way through.
strings.t: Se tab ki pi revelatè e ki pi onèt lekòl la enprime tou. Yon diferans 338 pwen SAT ant senkyèm anwo a ak sa anba a montre yon gwo klas ak yon gran varyete elèv, se pa youn ki elit nèt ale.

strings.text: All five quintiles are the school’s own published figures — nothing here is estimated. Read the spread: 4.507 → 3.204 is a 1.303 weighted-GPA gap and 1454 → 1116 a 338-point SAT gap. Because AP adds a full point, a 4.017 middle fifth is not a straight-A unweighted transcript — part of it is honours and AP weight. Note the quintiles describe the Class of 2027 while the test scores above describe the Class of 2026 — different classes, so do not blend them.
strings.t: Tout senk senkyèm yo se pwòp chif lekòl la pibliye — pa gen anyen isit la ki estime. Li diferans lan: 4.507 → 3.204 se yon diferans GPA ak pwa 1.303 epi 1454 → 1116 yon diferans 338 pwen SAT. Paske AP ajoute yon pwen konplè, yon senkyèm mitan 4.017 se pa yon relve nòt san pwa ki plen A — yon pati se pwa honours ak AP. Note senkyèm yo dekri Klas 2027 la pandan nòt tès ki anwo yo dekri Klas 2026 la — klas diferan, kidonk pa melanje yo.

strings.text: Learning Specialists at every division

strings.text: Two are dedicated to the Upper School (Sarah Ramsden, Emily Young), working alongside school counselors Claire Bell and Marissa Kohn. The published role is helping students “become successful learners and self-advocates”.
strings.t: De dedye a Upper School la (Sarah Ramsden, Emily Young), k ap travay ansanm ak konseye lekòl Claire Bell ak Marissa Kohn. Wòl ki pibliye a se ede elèv “vin moun k ap aprann ak siksè epi ki ka defann tèt yo”.

strings.text: Why it matters
strings.t: Poukisa sa enpòtan

strings.text: Self-advocacy is precisely the skill the college transition demands. Specialists act as resource consultants to administrators, counselors, teachers and parents, and facilitate access to school-based and outside services.
strings.t: Defann tèt ou se presizeman konpetans tranzisyon nan inivèsite a mande. Espesyalis yo aji kòm konsiltan resous pou administratè, konseye, pwofesè ak paran, epi yo fasilite aksè a sèvis nan lekòl la ak deyò.

strings.text: Where it stops
strings.t: Kote li kanpe

strings.text: This is a **consultative** model. It is not a set programme for students with learning differences. No LD track, resource room or accommodations course is published. On-site occupational therapy exists, but speech-language services are not published.
strings.t: Sa a se yon modèl **konsiltatif**. Se pa yon pwogram fiks pou elèv ki gen diferans nan aprantisaj. Pa gen okenn pis LD, sal resous oswa kou akomodasyon ki pibliye. Terapi okipasyonèl egziste sou plas, men sèvis lapawòl ak lang pa pibliye.

strings.text: The list matches the distribution
strings.t: Lis la matche ak distribisyon an

strings.text: The 383-institution list runs from Williams, MIT and Harvard down through Catawba, Brevard, Lees-McRae, Pfeiffer and Central Piedmont Community College. Just as important, many less selective options are **bolded**, meaning students enrolled there. They include App State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, UNC–Greensboro, Western Carolina, High Point, Wingate, Gardner-Webb, Belmont Abbey and Central Piedmont. So students in the fourth and fifth quintiles really are enrolling, not just appearing on the list.
strings.t: Lis 383 enstitisyon an kouvri Williams, MIT ak Harvard desann rive nan Catawba, Brevard, Lees-McRae, Pfeiffer ak Central Piedmont Community College. Epi sa ki enpòtan tou, anpil opsyon ki mwens selektif **an gra**, sa vle di elèv te enskri la. Pami yo gen App State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, UNC–Greensboro, Western Carolina, High Point, Wingate, Gardner-Webb, Belmont Abbey ak Central Piedmont. Kidonk elèv nan katriyèm ak senkyèm senkyèm yo vrèman ap enskri, se pa sèlman parèt sou lis la.

strings.text: Fit over prestige
strings.t: Sa ki apwopriye pi lwen pase prestij

strings.text: A named **Gap Year Fair** runs as standing programming, alongside the alternating athletic-recruiting and arts-in-college sessions.
strings.t: Yon **Gap Year Fair** ki gen non fèt kòm pwogramasyon pèmanan, ansanm ak sesyon rekritman atletik ak atizay nan inivèsite ki fèt an altènans.

strings.text: When direction changes
strings.t: Lè direksyon an chanje

strings.text: Conservatories: Berklee, RISD, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, School of Visual Arts and UNCSA. Four of the five federal service academies. A deep international list: Oxford, St Andrews, Edinburgh, UCL, LSE, King’s College London, Trinity Dublin, Leiden, Amsterdam, Bocconi and Toronto.
strings.t: Konsèvatwa: Berklee, RISD, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, School of Visual Arts ak UNCSA. Kat nan senk akademi sèvis federal yo. Yon lis entènasyonal pwofon: Oxford, St Andrews, Edinburgh, UCL, LSE, King’s College London, Trinity Dublin, Leiden, Amsterdam, Bocconi ak Toronto.

strings.text: No breakdown of outcomes BY quintile is published. The table gives inputs (GPA, SAT, ACT per fifth) but never says where the middle and bottom fifths actually enroll. That is the single biggest gap in a profile that otherwise shares unusually much.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn dekoupaj rezilta PA senkyèm ki pibliye. Tab la bay sa ki antre (GPA, SAT, ACT pa senkyèm) men li pa janm di kote senkyèm mitan yo ak sa anba yo enskri vre. Se pi gwo mank nan yon pwofil ki otreman pataje anpil enfòmasyon yon fason ki pa abityèl.

strings.text: A mature, stable, high-touch college programme that delivers elite outcomes at the top and real placement through the middle — and hands colleges a transcript built to be trusted.
strings.t: Yon pwogram inivèsitè ki mi, estab, ak anpil kontak ki bay rezilta elit nan tèt la ak vrè plasman nan mitan an — epi ki bay inivèsite yo yon relve nòt bati pou yo fè l konfyans.

strings.text: The open questions are about the current year and the unpublished operational details — exactly what a campus visit answers.
strings.t: Kesyon ki rete yo se sou ane aktyèl la ak detay operasyonèl ki pa pibliye — egzakteman sa yon vizit sou kanpis la reponn.

strings.text: A transcript engineered to be readable
strings.t: Yon relve nòt fèt pou li ka li

strings.text: no rank, but a quintile table carrying mean GPA, SAT and ACT for each fifth, the exact weighting formula, and explicit AP-load norms. Most no-rank schools publish far less.
strings.t: pa gen ran, men yon tab senkyèm ki pote GPA, SAT ak ACT mwayèn pou chak senkyèm, fòmil pwa egzak la, ak nòm chay AP eksplisit. Pifò lekòl san ran pibliye anpil mwens.

strings.text: 1,282 exams, with 93% scoring 3+ and 76% scoring 4–5. And 94% of the 497 students who sat them earned a 3 or higher. The full score spread for each subject is printed, weak spots included. Because the exam is required, those figures count every AP student, not just the ones who chose to test.
strings.t: 1,282 egzamen, ak 93% ki fè 3+ ak 76% ki fè 4–5. Epi 94% nan 497 elèv ki te pase yo fè 3 oswa plis. Distribisyon konplè nòt pou chak matyè enprime, pwen fèb yo enkli. Paske egzamen an obligatwa, chif sa yo konte chak elèv AP, se pa sèlman sa ki te chwazi pase tès la.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 33.3% in Fall 2025 — 23 of 69 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.

strings.text: The Class of 2026 alone produced 12 Semifinalists — more than half the 20 recorded across the three preceding classes combined. Note tou ke de dènye edisyon pwofil la rapòte Semifinalis ak Commended sèlman: ni youn ni lòt pa rapòte Finalis, kidonk kantite Finalis pou 2023, 2025 ak 2026 pa pibliye.

strings.text: The ceiling is **AP Calculus BC** — there is no multivariable calculus and no linear algebra. Honors Data Analytics, Honors Intro to Probability & Statistics and Honors Graphs, Governance & Games: Applied Mathematics run alongside rather than beyond it. A genuine ceiling worth noting.
strings.t: Plafon an se **AP Calculus BC** — pa gen kalkil miltivaryab epi pa gen aljèb lineyè. Honors Data Analytics, Honors Intro to Probability & Statistics ak Honors Graphs, Governance & Games: Applied Mathematics kouri akote olye ke pi lwen pase l. Yon vrè plafon ki vo lapèn note.

strings.text: **Honors Java Data Structures** goes beyond AP CS A. **AP Cybersecurity** and **AP Networking Fundamentals** are now listed as two separate APs. Both are very new College Board courses, and they set Latin apart.
strings.t: **Honors Java Data Structures** ale pi lwen pase AP CS A. **AP Cybersecurity** ak **AP Networking Fundamentals** kounye a liste kòm de AP separe. Tou de se kou College Board ki fenk parèt, epi yo fè Latin diferan.

strings.text: The jump from 48 AP Scholars with Distinction (2018–20) to 192 (2024–26) is very large. Part is real growth, but the magnitude suggests the counting basis may differ between editions — the school does not define it. Do not present the two as directly comparable.
strings.t: Sote soti 48 AP Scholars with Distinction (2018–20) rive 192 (2024–26) trè gwo. Yon pati reyèl kwasans, men grandè a sijere baz konte a ka diferan ant edisyon yo — lekòl la pa defini l. Pa prezante de yo kòm dirèkteman konparab.

strings.text: The 2025–26 edition carried an unremoved internal editorial note; the 2026–27 edition has removed it, and adds AP results, test means, grade distributions and the grading scale — a substantial reversal of the school’s earlier non-disclosure.

strings.text: Both ratios are derived (589 Upper Schoolers ÷ 4, and 151 seniors ÷ 4); the school publishes neither. Because counselors are assigned in freshman year, the ~1:147 all-grades figure is arguably the more honest load measure and ~1:38 describes senior-year intensity. No biographies, prior employers, degrees or credentials are published for any staff member — names and titles only.
strings.t: Tou de rapò yo derive (589 elèv Upper School ÷ 4, ak 151 elèv dènye ane ÷ 4); lekòl la pa pibliye ni youn ni lòt. Paske yo asiyen konseye nan premye ane, chif ~1:147 pou tout nivo yo se sanble mezi chay ki pi onèt la epi ~1:38 dekri entansite dènye ane a. Pa gen okenn byografi, ansyen patwon, diplòm oswa kalifikasyon ki pibliye pou okenn manm estaf — non ak tit sèlman.

strings.text: No count of campus visits made by counselors is published — only the qualitative claim that they “stay current by attending conferences, visiting colleges, and speaking extensively with college representatives”.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kantite vizit sou kanpis konseye yo fè ki pibliye — sèlman reklamasyon kalitatif la ke yo “rete ajou lè yo ale nan konferans, vizite inivèsite, epi pale anpil ak reprezantan inivèsite”.

strings.text: Four graduating classes earned acceptances at 337 institutions. On the newest list, 132 carry an asterisk showing that at least one Latin student enrolled there in 2024–26.
strings.t: Kat klas ki gradye te jwenn aksepte nan 337 enstitisyon. Sou lis ki pi resan an, 132 pote yon zetwal ki montre omwen yon elèv Latin te enskri la an 2024–26.

strings.text: The striking number is breadth. 61 of the 68 Power Four universities appear. The ones missing are Minnesota, Nebraska, BYU, UCF, Houston, Kansas State and UT Austin (the lists write only “University of Texas”). Seven of the eight Ivies appear, and Columbia is the only one missing.
strings.t: Chif ki frapan an se jan lis la laj. 61 nan 68 inivèsite Power Four yo parèt. Sa ki manke yo se Minnesota, Nebraska, BYU, UCF, Houston, Kansas State ak UT Austin (lis yo ekri sèlman “University of Texas”). Sèt nan uit Ivy yo parèt, epi Columbia se sèl ki manke.

strings.text: The school stopped publishing its merit-dollar total after the Class of 2023. The 2024, 2025 and 2026 write-ups carry no figure. It is unclear whether the school stopped collecting the figure or only stopped publishing it. Morehead-Cain belongs to the Class of 2022, outside this list’s window. QuestBridge, Robertson, Jefferson, Belk, Stamps and Coca-Cola were not found for any recent class. Robertson, Jefferson and Belk appear only in a 2017–18 history paragraph, so they should not be read as current pipelines. The 2026–27 profile carries no merit figures either.
strings.t: Lekòl la sispann pibliye total dola merit li apre Klas 2023 la. Rezime 2024, 2025 ak 2026 yo pa pote okenn chif. Nou pa konnen si lekòl la sispann ranmase chif la oswa si li sispann pibliye l sèlman. Morehead-Cain makonnen ak Klas 2022, ki deyò peryòd lis sa a. Nou pa t jwenn QuestBridge, Robertson, Jefferson, Belk, Stamps ak Coca-Cola pou okenn klas resan. Robertson, Jefferson ak Belk parèt sèlman nan yon paragraf istorik 2017–18, kidonk yo pa dwe li kòm rezo aktyèl. Pwofil 2026–27 la pa pote okenn chif merit non plis.

strings.text: Latin’s strengths are narrow and deep, and truly elite in two places: a top-20 national debate programme and a Fab Lab that follows MIT’s model. The school leaves it almost entirely to the student to build a standout strength.
strings.t: Fòs Latin yo etwat ak pwofon, epi vrèman elit nan de kote: yon pwogram deba nan top-20 nasyonal ak yon Fab Lab ki swiv modèl MIT. Lekòl la kite prèske tout travay pou bati yon fòs espesyal nan men elèv la.

strings.text: There is no required capstone or senior project that manufactures one, which makes the two flagship programmes carry more weight than they would elsewhere.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kapston oswa pwojè dènye ane obligatwa ki fabrike youn, sa ki fè de pwogram pòtdrapo yo pote plis pwa pase yo ta genyen lòt kote.

strings.text: **Speech & Debate — the strongest documented spike.** An NSDA **Debate School of Excellence Award**, one of the top 20 programmes in the country; NSDA **charter status**; **200 Club** membership in 2025. Director Bilal Butt has earned a second Diamond award with 30,000+ NSDA points over ten years. At 2025 Nationals, 7 debaters competed and 6 earned recognition against 6,700+ students — including a **5th place in Public Forum**.
strings.t: **Speech & Debate — espesyalite ki pi byen dokimante a.** Yon NSDA **Debate School of Excellence Award**, youn nan top 20 pwogram nan peyi a; **estati chat** NSDA; manbraj **200 Club** an 2025. Direktè Bilal Butt genyen yon dezyèm prim Diamond ak plis pase 30,000 pwen NSDA sou dis ane. Nan Nationals 2025, 7 debatè te konpetisyone epi 6 te genyen rekonesans kont plis pase 6,700 elèv — ki enkli yon **5yèm plas nan Public Forum**.

strings.text: **It is curricular, not merely a club.** The courses carry a competition mandate: the intro course requires participation in two tournaments a year, and the advanced course requires six.
strings.t: **Li kourikoulè, se pa senpleman yon klib.** Kou yo pote yon mandat konpetisyon: kou entwodiksyon an egzije patisipasyon nan de tounwa pa ane, epi kou avanse a egzije sis.

strings.text: **Innovation & Design / Fab Lab** — an official Fab Lab school that traces back to **MIT’s Center for Bits and Atoms**. It has been an active Fab Academy site since 2016. Engineering has been taught here since 1989. The lab runs 3D printing, CNC milling, circuit production, laser and precision milling. Upper School courses are taught “like a professional software engineering firm”. Students present to outside panels of industry experts.
strings.t: **Innovation & Design / Fab Lab** — yon lekòl Fab Lab ofisyèl ki soti nan liyaj **Center for Bits and Atoms MIT la**. Li se yon sit Fab Academy aktif depi 2016. Yo anseye enjenyri isit la depi 1989. Laboratwa a fè enprime 3D, fresaj CNC, pwodiksyon sikwi, koupe ak lazè ak fresaj presi. Kou Upper School yo ansenye “tankou yon konpayi enjenyri lojisyèl pwofesyonèl”. Elèv yo prezante devan panèl ekspè endistri ki soti deyò.

strings.text: **Malone Scholars School** — North Carolina’s only one, endowed by the Malone Family Foundation, which selects 50 independent schools nationally partly for their “excellent accommodations for gifted and talented students”.
strings.t: **Malone Scholars School** — sèl la nan North Carolina, ak dotasyon nan men Malone Family Foundation, ki chwazi 50 lekòl endepandan nan tout peyi a an pati pou “akomodasyon eksèlan yo pou elèv dwe ak talan”.

strings.text: **Internships do exist**, despite a common belief that they do not. A **Biomedical Internship Program** places seniors with Atrium Health as part of the Advanced Topics in Engineering course. There is also a Student Internship Program elective.
strings.t: **Estaj egziste vre**, menm si anpil moun kwè yo pa egziste. Yon **Biomedical Internship Program** plase elèv dènye ane ak Atrium Health kòm yon pati nan kou Advanced Topics in Engineering. Genyen tou yon kou opsyonèl Student Internship Program.

strings.text: There is still no required internship, capstone, senior project, independent study or school-wide research project. To graduate, a student needs only the required course credits. There is no global-studies certificate or diploma. Help with sports recruiting and with arts in college is limited to sharing information. No named recruiting coordinator, highlight-film service, conservatory-prep track or portfolio review is published.
strings.t: Toujou pa gen estaj obligatwa, kapston, pwojè dènye ane, etid endepandan oswa pwojè rechèch pou tout lekòl la. Pou gradye, yon elèv bezwen sèlman kredi kou obligatwa yo. Pa gen sètifika oswa diplòm nan etid mondyal. Èd pou rekritman espò ak pou atizay nan inivèsite limite a pataje enfòmasyon. Pa gen kòdonatè rekritman ki gen non, sèvis videyo pwen enpòtan, pis preparasyon pou konsèvatwa oswa revizyon pòtfèy ki pibliye.

strings.text: **The School Profile argues with numbers again.** It is the one document every admissions office reads. The 2026–27 edition restores the grading scale, the weighting statement and the class-rank policy. It also adds AP results and SAT and ACT averages after years without them. It still leaves out a CEEB code, the share of graduates who enrolled at four-year colleges and National Merit Finalists.
strings.t: **School Profile la diskite ak chif ankò.** Se sèl dokiman chak biwo admisyon li. Edisyon 2026–27 la remete echèl nòt la, deklarasyon sou pwa a ak politik ran nan klas la. Li ajoute tou rezilta AP ak mwayèn SAT ak ACT apre plizyè ane san yo. Li toujou kite deyò kòd CEEB la, pati gradye ki te enskri nan kolèj kat ane ak Finalis National Merit yo.

strings.text: **The integrity block was deleted wholesale.** All three archived editions carried, verbatim: “Reflecting our emphasis on ‘HONOR ABOVE ALL,’ our policy is to report any **probations, suspensions, and expulsions through time of graduation** to any colleges that request this information. CLS complies with the **NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice**.” None of that survives, and the 2026–27 edition does not restore it.
strings.t: **Blòk sou entegrite a te efase nèt.** Tout twa edisyon achive yo te pote, mo pou mo: “Ki reflete aksan nou sou ‘ONÈ ANWO TOUT BAGAY,’ politik nou se rapòte nenpòt **pwobasyon, sispansyon, ak ekspilsyon jiska moman gradyasyon** bay nenpòt inivèsite ki mande enfòmasyon sa a. CLS konfòm ak **NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice** la.” Anyen nan sa pa siviv, epi edisyon 2026–27 la pa remete l.

strings.text: **Named-scholarship history was deleted too.** The 2017–18 edition told readers the school’s students had won Morehead-Cain, Robertson, B.N. Duke, Jefferson, Belk, Bryan, Chancellor’s, Danforth and Johnson scholarships. It also showed how widely students applied and enrolled. Not one of those sentences survives, and the 2026–27 edition does not restore them.
strings.t: **Istwa bous ki gen non yo te efase tou.** Edisyon 2017–18 la te di moun k ap li ke elèv lekòl la te genyen bous Morehead-Cain, Robertson, B.N. Duke, Jefferson, Belk, Bryan, Chancellor’s, Danforth ak Johnson. Li te montre tou jan elèv yo te aplike ak enskri nan anpil kote. Pa gen yon sèl nan fraz sa yo ki siviv, epi edisyon 2026–27 la pa remete yo.

strings.text: **What remains is genuine and external** — the NSDA recognition, the Fab Academy site and the Malone Family Foundation selection. All three come from outside groups and do not depend on the profile.
strings.t: **Sa ki rete a otantik epi ekstèn** — rekonesans NSDA a, sit Fab Academy a ak seleksyon Malone Family Foundation la. Tou twa soti nan gwoup deyò epi yo pa depann de pwofil la.

strings.text: The net effect is a profile that now argues with numbers again, but still omits the integrity statement and the scholarship history earlier editions carried.
strings.t: Rezilta nèt la se yon pwofil ki diskite ak chif ankò, men ki toujou kite deyò deklarasyon sou entegrite a ak istwa bous ansyen edisyon yo te pote.

strings.text: An unsourced reference to a 2018 national debate champion surfaced during research but could not be corroborated against speechanddebate.org, so it is deliberately excluded here rather than repeated.
strings.t: Yon referans san sous sou yon chanpyon nasyonal deba 2018 te parèt pandan rechèch la men nou pa t kapab koroboure l kont speechanddebate.org, kidonk nou eskli l espre isit la olye ke repete l.

strings.text: As of 2026–27, Latin publishes its class-level numbers — 2026 AP results, SAT and ACT means, and junior and sophomore grade distributions — but still no percentiles, GPA distribution or rank.
strings.t: Apati 2026–27, Latin pibliye chif nivo klas li yo — rezilta AP 2026, mwayèn SAT ak ACT, ak distribisyon nòt ane jinyò ak sofomò — men toujou pa gen pousantil, distribisyon GPA oswa ran.

strings.text: The figures are averages, not distributions. A reader can now compare a test score with the class average, but not with the spread. There is no middle-50% band and no share of the class above any line.
strings.t: Chif yo se mwayèn, se pa distribisyon. Yon moun k ap li kapab kounye a konpare yon nòt tès ak mwayèn klas la, men pa ak jan nòt yo gaye. Pa gen bann mitan 50% epi pa gen pati klas la ki anwo okenn liy.

strings.text: Learning Resources, founded 1985
strings.t: Learning Resources, fonde 1985

strings.text: A real programme with a long history — a K–12 Director plus LR teachers in each division, admission based on a psychoeducational evaluation demonstrating learning differences that impact achievement.
strings.t: Yon vrè pwogram ak yon long istwa — yon Direktè K–12 plis pwofesè LR nan chak divizyon, ak admisyon ki baze sou yon evalyasyon sikoedikatif ki demontre diferans nan aprantisaj ki afekte reyisit.

strings.text: The Upper School model is coaching, not remediation
strings.t: Modèl Upper School la se antrènman, se pa remediyasyon

strings.text: In the school’s own words, the Upper School programme “becomes more of a **consultative and coaching model**”. It coaches skills such as organisation, time management and study strategies. Lower School Learning Resources (LR) is explicitly remedial, but the Upper School is not. That matters most for a family whose 9–12 student needs direct help.
strings.t: Nan pwòp mo lekòl la, pwogram Upper School la “vin plis yon **modèl konsiltatif ak antrènman**”. Li antrene konpetans tankou òganizasyon, jesyon tan ak estrateji etid. Learning Resources (LR) Lower School eksplisitman remedyal, men Upper School la pa ye. Sa konte plis pou yon fanmi ki gen yon elèv 9–12 ki bezwen èd dirèk.

strings.text: Accommodations and cost
strings.t: Akomodasyon ak depans

strings.text: Middle and Upper School students who qualify have a **504 Educational Plan**. Their testing must be no more than three years old. Typical accommodations include extra time and testing in a separate setting. Importantly, **charges for sessions are not included in tuition and are billed per session each month**.
strings.t: Elèv Middle ak Upper School ki kalifye gen yon **504 Educational Plan**. Tès yo pa dwe gen plis pase twa ane. Akomodasyon tipik yo enkli tan anplis ak tès nan yon kote apa. Sa ki enpòtan, **frè pou sesyon yo pa enkli nan frè eskolè a epi yo faktire yo pa sesyon chak mwa**.

strings.text: Do not confuse ATSS with Learning Resources
strings.t: Pa konfonn ATSS ak Learning Resources

strings.text: The Office of Academic Transition and Student Success is a **transition and belonging office**. It serves students new to independent schools, especially those from underrepresented backgrounds. Its page never mentions learning differences, 504 plans or accommodations. Take a student with dyslexia who is not new to Latin and not from an underrepresented background. That student falls fully outside the group the office says it serves.
strings.t: Office of Academic Transition and Student Success la se yon **biwo tranzisyon ak apatenans**. Li sèvi elèv ki nouvo nan lekòl endepandan, sitou sa yo ki soti nan gwoup ki pa byen reprezante. Paj li a pa janm mansyone diferans nan aprantisaj, plan 504 oswa akomodasyon. Pran yon elèv ki gen disleksi ki pa nouvo nan Latin epi ki pa soti nan yon gwoup ki pa byen reprezante. Elèv sa a tonbe nèt deyò gwoup biwo a di li sèvi a.

strings.text: Grades are now published
strings.t: Kounye a yo pibliye nòt yo

strings.text: In the Class of 2027’s junior year, 524 of 833 course grades (63%) were in the A range. In sophomore year it was 457 of 806 (57%). These counts come from the profile’s own tables, which leave out grades below C−. Beyond grades, the 337-institution list is truly broad. It runs from Harvard, MIT and Stanford through Belhaven, Brevard, Catawba, Carson-Newman, Lenoir-Rhyne, Methodist, Saint Leo, Trevecca Nazarene, Wingate and Johnson & Wales. Many carry the asterisk showing a student enrolled.
strings.t: Nan ane jinyò Klas 2027 la, 524 nan 833 nòt kou (63%) te nan bann A a. Nan ane sofomò, se te 457 nan 806 (57%). Kantite sa yo soti nan pwòp tab pwofil la, ki kite deyò nòt ki pi ba pase C−. Pi lwen pase nòt yo, lis 337 enstitisyon an vrèman laj. Li kouvri Harvard, MIT ak Stanford rive nan Belhaven, Brevard, Catawba, Carson-Newman, Lenoir-Rhyne, Methodist, Saint Leo, Trevecca Nazarene, Wingate ak Johnson & Wales. Anpil pote zetwal ki montre yon elèv te enskri.

strings.text: The regional band is real
strings.t: Bann rejyonal la reyèl

strings.text: Nine UNC-system campuses carry a 2024–26 enrollment asterisk: Chapel Hill, NC State, Charlotte, Greensboro, Wilmington, Asheville, the School of the Arts, East Carolina and Appalachian State. So Latin students clearly enroll across the whole range of campuses, not only at the most selective ones.
strings.t: Nèf kanpis sistèm UNC pote yon zetwal enskripsyon 2024–26: Chapel Hill, NC State, Charlotte, Greensboro, Wilmington, Asheville, School of the Arts, East Carolina ak Appalachian State. Kidonk elèv Latin klèman enskri atravè tout kalite kanpis, pa sèlman nan sa ki pi selektif yo.

strings.text: Non-traditional destinations
strings.t: Destinasyon ki pa tradisyonèl

strings.text: The lists include service academies: the Naval Academy and The Citadel, plus a 2025 Air Force Academy appointment. Conservatory and arts schools appear too. So do international universities, including St Andrews, UCL, King’s, Imperial, Leiden, Amsterdam, Queensland, Toronto, McGill and UBC.
strings.t: Lis yo gen akademi sèvis: Naval Academy ak The Citadel, plis yon nominasyon nan Air Force Academy an 2025. Lekòl konsèvatwa ak atistik parèt tou. Menm jan tou pou inivèsite entènasyonal, tankou St Andrews, UCL, King’s, Imperial, Leiden, Amsterdam, Queensland, Toronto, McGill ak UBC.

strings.text: Means only — no percentiles, middle-50% bands, GPA distribution or rank table, and no testing rate.
strings.t: Mwayèn sèlman — pa gen pousantil, bann mitan-50%, distribisyon GPA oswa tab ran, epi pa gen to tès.

strings.text: The testing data was absent from every edition between 2019–20 and 2025–26 and returned in 2026–27.
strings.t: Done tès yo te absan nan chak edisyon ant 2019–20 ak 2025–26 epi yo retounen an 2026–27.

strings.text: Genuinely elite in two narrow places — debate and design engineering — with a stable, unusually well-staffed counseling office — and, from 2026–27, a profile that publishes its numbers again.
strings.t: Vrèman elit nan de kote etwat — deba ak enjenyri konsepsyon — ak yon biwo konsèy estab ak byen estafe yon fason ki pa abityèl — epi, apati 2026–27, yon pwofil ki pibliye chif li yo ankò.

strings.text: The open questions are now about spread and outcomes rather than basic disclosure: the averages are printed, but not the range around them or where each class enrolled.
strings.t: Kesyon ki rete yo kounye a sou jan rezilta yo gaye ak sou kote elèv yo ale, plis pase sou piblikasyon debaz: mwayèn yo enprime, men se pa ranje alantou yo ni kote chak klas te enskri.

strings.text: Two externally validated flagship programmes
strings.t: De pwogram pòtdrapo ki valide depi deyò

strings.text: an NSDA top-20 debate programme with charter and 200 Club status and a 5th-place national finish, and an MIT-lineage Fab Lab running an active Fab Academy node since 2016. Neither validation depends on the school’s own marketing.
strings.t: yon pwogram deba NSDA nan top-20 ak estati chat ak 200 Club ak yon 5yèm plas nasyonal, ak yon Fab Lab nan liyaj MIT k ap fè yon nœud Fab Academy aktif depi 2016. Ni youn ni lòt validasyon pa depann de pwòp maketing lekòl la.

strings.text: An unusually well-staffed counseling office
strings.t: Yon biwo konsèy ki byen estafe yon fason ki pa abityèl

strings.text: nine people for 151 seniors, including **three dedicated essay specialists** — a role most peer offices simply do not have — with counselors assigned in freshman year.
strings.t: nèf moun pou 151 elèv dènye ane, ki enkli **twa espesyalis dedye pou redaksyon** — yon wòl pifò biwo parèy senpleman pa genyen — ak konseye yo asiyen nan premye ane.

strings.text: A written commitment peers avoid
strings.t: Yon angajman alekri lekòl parèy evite

strings.text: the office states it proofreads each essay and application before submission. Most schools describe workshops and meetings but stop short of promising a review.
strings.t: biwo a deklare li korije chak redaksyon ak aplikasyon anvan soumisyon. Pifò lekòl dekri atelye ak reyinyon men yo kanpe anvan yo pwomèt yon revizyon.

strings.text: Low turnover at the top
strings.t: Ti woulman nan tèt la

strings.text: three of the four counselors, including the director, are documented in the same office as far back as the 2017–18 profile.
strings.t: twa nan kat konseye yo, ki enkli direktè a, dokimante nan menm biwo a depi lwen ke pwofil 2017–18 la.

strings.text: Placement breadth across the whole class
strings.t: Etandi plasman atravè tout klas la

strings.text: 337 institutions across four classes, with 61 of the 68 Power Four universities represented. Enrollment asterisks run from the Ivies down through regional colleges.
strings.t: 337 enstitisyon atravè kat klas, ak 61 nan 68 inivèsite Power Four yo reprezante. Zetwal enskripsyon yo gaye soti nan Ivy yo desann rive nan kolèj rejyonal yo.

strings.text: The exam requirement is real
strings.t: Kondisyon egzamen an reyèl

strings.text: students in AP classes must sit the exam, and seven APs are deliberately open-enrollment rather than faculty-gated — so access is broader than the placement gate alone suggests.
strings.t: elèv nan klas AP dwe pase egzamen an, epi sèt AP espre gen enskripsyon lib olye ke pwofesè kontwole yo — kidonk aksè a pi laj pase sa pòtay plasman an pou kont li sijere.

strings.text: Your profile now prints SAT and ACT means. What are the middle-50% ranges, and what share of the class submitted scores?
strings.t: Kounye a pwofil ou a enprime mwayèn SAT ak ACT. Ki ranje mitan-50% yo, epi ki pòsyon nan klas la ki te soumèt nòt?

strings.text: Advanced math and science courses now carry +0.5, applied retroactively from the Class of 2027. How do colleges see that change on a transcript, and are earlier classes’ GPAs restated?
strings.t: Kou Advanced matematik ak syans kounye a pote +0.5, ki aplike retwoaktivman apati Klas 2027 la. Kijan inivèsite yo wè chanjman sa a sou yon relve nòt, epi èske yo rekalkile GPA klas anvan yo?

strings.text: Is there a GPA distribution — quintiles or deciles — that you share with colleges even though it is not in the published profile?
strings.t: Èske gen yon distribisyon GPA — senkyèm oswa dizyèm — ke w pataje ak inivèsite yo menm si li pa nan pwofil ki pibliye a?

strings.text: Who is the current Director of Learning Resources, how many LR staff work with Upper School students, and what does a session cost, since it is billed outside tuition?
strings.t: Kiyès ki Direktè Learning Resources aktyèl la, konbyen estaf LR k ap travay ak elèv Upper School, epi konbyen yon sesyon koute, paske yo faktire l deyò frè eskolè a?

strings.text: Your Acceptances page still shows the Classes of 2023–25. Where did the Class of 2026 enroll, college by college?
strings.t: Paj Acceptances ou a toujou montre Klas 2023–25 yo. Ki kote Klas 2026 la te enskri, inivèsite pa inivèsite?

strings.text: Columbia is the only Ivy absent from both recent acceptance lists. Is that accurate, and how do you read it?
strings.t: Columbia se sèl Ivy ki absan nan tou de dènye lis aksepte yo. Èske sa egzak, epi kijan ou li l?

strings.text: You stopped publishing merit-scholarship totals after the Class of 2023. What did the last three classes receive?
strings.t: Ou te sispann pibliye total bous merit yo apre Klas 2023 la. Kisa twa dènye klas yo te resevwa?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Charlotte Christian School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 54.8% over the last five entering classes — 382 acceptances from 697 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Charlotte Christian School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 54.8% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 382 admisyon sou 697 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 26.3% in Fall 2025 — 10 of 38 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 26.3% nan otòn 2025 — 10 sou 38 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 382 of 697 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 382 sou 697 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 10 of 38, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 10 sou 38, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (38)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (38)

strings.text: Students in AP classes are required to sit the exam, and 94% of 2026’s 435 exams scored 3 or higher — a rate earned on a mandated rather than self-selected pool.
strings.t: Elèv ki nan klas AP yo oblije pase egzamen an, epi 94% nan 435 egzamen 2026 yo te fè 3 oswa plis — yon to ki soti nan yon gwoup ki oblije pase l, pa yon gwoup ki chwazi tèt li.

strings.text: Because the exams are required, the profile’s published exam, student and AP Scholar counts describe every AP student, not just the most confident testers. The transcript stands out most for its four credits of Biblical Studies.
strings.t: Paske egzamen yo obligatwa, kantite egzamen, elèv ak AP Scholars pwofil la pibliye yo dekri chak elèv AP, pa sèlman sa ki pi gen konfyans pou pase tès. Sa ki fè relve nòt la plis diferan se kat kredi Etid Biblik li yo.

strings.text: AP exams taken in 2026 (208 students)
strings.t: egzamen AP yo te pase an 2026 (208 elèv)

strings.t: nan egzamen yo te fè 3+ an 2026

strings.t: AP Scholars an 2026

strings.t: yon tab GPA senk senkyèm ki pibliye ranplase l

strings.t: **12** Finalis · **46** Commended Scholars

strings.t: **1** Commended Scholar (Jack Krause) — près la nonmen apa yon Semifinalis lekòl la pa liste

strings.text: **4** College Board National Recognition awards — 1 African American, 3 Hispanic (Class of 2024: 5)
strings.t: **4** prim College Board National Recognition — 1 Afriken-Ameriken, 3 Hispanic (Klas 2024: 5)

strings.text: All three National Merit figures cover a rolling 15-year window. That is why the Finalist count can fall from 16 to 14 to 12 while Commended moves from 45 to 48 to 46: strong older years drop out of the window. The math allows this, so it is not necessarily an error. But the school does not explain it, and no edition publishes a count for each class year.
strings.t: Tout twa chif National Merit yo kouvri yon fenèt 15 an k ap glise. Se poutèt sa kantite Finalis yo ka desann soti 16 pou rive 14 epi 12 pandan Commended yo pase soti 45 pou rive 48 epi 46: ansyen ane ki te fò yo soti nan fenèt la. Kalkil la pèmèt sa, kidonk se pa nesesèman yon erè. Men lekòl la pa eksplike l, epi pa gen okenn edisyon ki pibliye yon kantite pou chak klas.

strings.text: **Calculus III** is a real course beyond AP. It covers multivariable and vector-valued functions, curvature, double and triple integrals, vector analysis and differential equations. It requires a 93% in AP Calculus AB or completion of BC.
strings.t: **Calculus III** se yon vrè kou pi lwen pase AP. Li kouvri fonksyon miltivaryab ak vektoryèl, koubi, entegral doub ak tripl, analiz vektoryèl ak ekwasyon diferansyèl. Li egzije yon 93% nan AP Calculus AB oswa konplesyon BC.

strings.text: Physics
strings.t: Fizik

strings.text: **AP Physics 1** is the top physics course on both the 2026–27 profile and the 2026–27 Curriculum Guide. AP Physics C, which earlier editions listed, no longer appears on either.
strings.t: **AP Physics 1** se kou fizik ki pi wo a ni nan pwofil 2026–27 la ni nan Curriculum Guide 2026–27 la. AP Physics C, ansyen edisyon yo te konn mete l, pa parèt ankò nan okenn nan de yo.

strings.text: **AP Computer Science** is on the 2026–27 profile, and the Curriculum Guide adds **Computer Science I** and **Computer Science II Honors** beneath it. No post-AP computer-science course is published.
strings.t: **AP Computer Science** parèt nan pwofil 2026–27 la, epi Curriculum Guide la ajoute **Computer Science I** ak **Computer Science II Honors** anba l. Pa gen okenn kou enfòmatik apre AP ki pibliye.

strings.text: AP French, AP Spanish Language and AP Latin on the profile, over Honors ladders running to level IV. The Curriculum Guide adds **AP Spanish Literature**, which the profile does not list. No post-AP language seminar is published.
strings.t: AP French, AP Spanish Language ak AP Latin nan pwofil la, anlè echèl Honors ki monte jiska nivo IV. Curriculum Guide la ajoute **AP Spanish Literature**, pwofil la pa mete l. Pa gen okenn seminè lang apre AP ki pibliye.

strings.text: **Winterim** supplies internships and travel. There is one **dual-enrollment** course: Personal Finance and Biblical Stewardship, taken with Cedarville University.
strings.t: **Winterim** bay estaj ak vwayaj. Gen yon sèl kou **enskripsyon doub**: Personal Finance and Biblical Stewardship, ki fèt ak Cedarville University.

strings.text: Weighted on a 4.0 base
strings.t: Pondere sou yon baz 4.0

strings.text: **+0.5 for Honors and dual enrollment, +1.0 for AP** on a 4.0 base. Every Upper School course counts toward the GPA; grades transferred from another high school do not.
strings.t: **+0.5 pou Honors ak enskripsyon doub, +1.0 pou AP** sou yon baz 4.0. Chak kou Upper School konte nan GPA a; nòt ki transfere soti nan yon lòt lekòl segondè pa konte.

strings.text: No rank → a five-quintile table
strings.t: Pa gen ran → yon tab senk senkyèm

strings.text: “Charlotte Christian School does not rank its students”, stated flatly in every published profile — but a full five-quintile GPA table through the sixth semester is published every year, letting colleges locate a band without a rank.
strings.t: “Charlotte Christian School pa bay elèv li yo ran”, sa deklare klèman nan chak pwofil ki pibliye — men chak ane yo pibliye yon tablo GPA konplè an senk kentil jiska sizyèm semès la, sa ki pèmèt kolèj yo jwenn yon tranch san yo pa bezwen yon ran.

strings.text: A Christian-specific load signature
strings.t: Yon siyati chay ki espesifik a lafwa kretyen

strings.text: Graduation requires **27 credits including 4 of Biblical Studies**. Students also need a January Term credit, a half-credit Junior Seminar and a half-credit Speech course. Those four Biblical Studies credits use up elective space that peer schools spend on other courses. They are the transcript’s most distinctive feature.
strings.t: Pou gradye fòk ou gen **27 kredi, ladan yo 4 nan Etid Biblik**. Elèv yo bezwen tou yon kredi January Term, yon demi kredi Junior Seminar ak yon demi kredi nan yon kou Diskou. Kat kredi Etid Biblik sa yo pran plas kou opsyonèl lòt lekòl yo itilize pou lòt kou. Se karakteristik ki pi diferan nan relve nòt la.

strings.text: Press coverage of the 71st National Merit competition names a Class of 2025 Semifinalist who appears neither in the school’s own National Merit block nor in its senior enrollment roster, which lists only a Commended Scholar. The two sources are inconsistent about who the honorees were.
strings.t: Kouvèti près la sou 71yèm konkou National Merit la nonmen yon Semifinalis Klas 2025 ki pa parèt ni nan pwòp blòk National Merit lekòl la ni nan lis enskripsyon elèv dènye ane li a, ki liste sèlman yon Commended Scholar. De sous yo pa dakò sou kiyès moun yo te onore yo.

strings.text: Only the share scoring 3+ is reported. The share of exams scoring 4 or 5 is not published in any year, so no 4–5 rate should be guessed. The 2026–27 profile also drops the pass count and the AP Scholar breakdown by award level that the 2024–25 edition printed. What counts as a “Most rigorous” course load is not defined either. There is no published rubric and no statement of what share of students take the most demanding programme.
strings.t: Se sèlman pati ki fè 3+ yo rapòte. Pati egzamen ki fè 4 oswa 5 pa pibliye pou okenn ane, kidonk pa dwe devine okenn to 4–5. Pwofil 2026–27 la retire tou kantite moun ki pase ak detay AP Scholars pa nivo distenksyon edisyon 2024–25 la te enprime. Sa ki konte kòm yon chaj kou “ki pi rigoure” pa defini non plis. Pa gen okenn griy ki pibliye ni okenn deklarasyon sou ki pati elèv ki pran pwogram ki pi egzijan an.

strings.text: The profile gives dual enrollment two different weights. Page 1 says dual-enrollment courses receive **0.5** extra quality points; page 3 says the Cedarville course awards **.75**. The profile does not reconcile them.
strings.t: Pwofil la bay enskripsyon doub de pwa diferan. Paj 1 di kou enskripsyon doub yo resevwa **0.5** pwen kalite anplis; paj 3 di kou Cedarville la bay **.75**. Pwofil la pa rekonsilye yo.

strings.text: The 2021–22 and 2024–25 profiles said the school **halved its weighting** with the Class of 2019, down from +1.0 and +2.0, so a pre-2019 GPA is not comparable to a current one. The 2026–27 edition no longer prints that note.
strings.t: Pwofil 2021–22 ak 2024–25 yo te di lekòl la te **koupe ponderasyon li an de** ak Klas 2019, soti nan +1.0 ak +2.0, kidonk yon GPA anvan 2019 pa ka konpare ak yon GPA kounye a. Edisyon 2026–27 la pa enprime nòt sa a ankò.

strings.text: Two college counselors split the alphabet and carry all four grades each — roughly 55 seniors apiece — under a director who has held the seat at least six years.
strings.t: De konseye kolèj separe alfabè a epi chak moun okipe tout kat ane yo — anviwon 55 elèv fen etid pou chak — anba yon direktè ki gen omwen sis an nan pòs la.

strings.text: The distinctive structure is Junior Seminar: a required, graded half-credit course with a mock admission committee and two mandatory college visits, rather than an optional evening programme.
strings.t: Estrikti ki distenktif la se Junior Seminar: yon kou obligatwa ak nòt demi kredi ak yon komite admisyon similye ak de vizit inivèsite obligatwa, olye ke yon pwogram aswè opsyonèl.

strings.text: Both ratios are derived — 442 Upper Schoolers ÷ 2 gives ~221:1 across all four grades, and 110 seniors in the Class of 2026 ÷ 2 gives ~55:1. The school publishes neither. Because the split is alphabetical, each counselor genuinely carries all four grades, so the 221:1 figure is the honest load measure and 55:1 describes senior-year intensity. The two personal counselors are not college counselors and do not belong in the denominator.
strings.t: Tou de rapò yo se kalkil — 442 elèv Upper School ÷ 2 bay ~221:1 sou tout kat ane yo, epi 110 elèv fen etid nan Klas 2026 ÷ 2 bay ~55:1. Lekòl la pa pibliye ni youn ni lòt. Paske separasyon an fèt pa alfabè, chak konseye vrèman okipe tout kat ane yo, kidonk chif 221:1 la se mezi onèt chaj la epi 55:1 dekri entansite dènye ane a. De konseye pèsonèl yo se pa konseye kolèj epi yo pa antre nan denominatè a.

strings.text: The school publishes no counselor’s years in the job, past employer or professional background. No bios appear on the college counseling page. It also publishes no count of visits by college reps or of campus visits by counselors.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye konbyen ane okenn konseye gen nan travay la, ansyen patwon li oswa background pwofesyonèl li. Pa gen byografi ki parèt sou paj konsèy inivèsite a. Li pa pibliye tou kantite vizit reprezantan inivèsite oswa vizit kanpis konseye yo fè.

strings.t: 249 kolèj te aksepte Klas 2023–26 yo, epi 99% gradye yo kontinye nan yon kolèj kat an.

strings.text: The Academic Conservatory is the real differentiator — a transcript-noted arts credential — and Winterim puts every student somewhere off campus each January.
strings.t: Academic Conservatory a se vrè diferans la — yon kalifikasyon atistik ki note sou relve nòt — epi Winterim mete chak elèv yon kote deyò kanpis la chak janvye.

strings.text: The second lever is a Christian-college network most peer schools do not have: NACCAP membership and a named Christian-college tier that 14% of graduates actually use.
strings.t: Dezyèm leviye a se yon rezo inivèsite kretyen pifò lekòl parèy pa genyen: manbraj NACCAP ak yon nivo inivèsite kretyen ki gen non ke 14% nan gradye yo sèvi vre.

strings.text: **Academic Conservatory** — the school’s strongest published credential. Importantly, it is **noted on the transcript**, so it reaches the admissions reader rather than appearing only on a résumé. The 2026–27 profile names six areas: Math and Science; Fine Arts; Bible, Philosophy & Religion; English; Social Studies; World Languages. **20% of the Class of 2026** earned at least one distinction.
strings.t: **Academic Conservatory** — kalifikasyon ki pi solid lekòl la pibliye. Sa ki enpòtan, li **note sou relve nòt la**, kidonk li rive nan men moun k ap li nan admisyon olye ke parèt sèlman sou yon rezime. Pwofil 2026–27 la nonmen sis domèn: Matematik ak Syans; Boza; Bib, Filozofi ak Relijyon; Angle; Syans Sosyal; Lang Mondyal. **20% nan Klas 2026** te jwenn omwen yon distenksyon.

strings.text: **Winterim / January Term** — a required credit every year (0.25 per year toward graduation). It offers internships, travel and job shadowing. The job-shadowing part is small: only about seven placements are published.
strings.t: **Winterim / January Term** — yon kredi obligatwa chak ane (0.25 pa ane vè gradyasyon). Li bay estaj, vwayaj ak swiv metye. Pati swiv metye a piti: se sèlman anviwon sèt plasman ki pibliye.

strings.text: **Junior Seminar** — a required, graded half-credit course containing a mock admission committee and two mandatory college visits. Structurally stronger than the optional evening programming most schools offer.
strings.t: **Junior Seminar** — yon kou obligatwa ak nòt demi kredi ki gen yon komite admisyon similye ak de vizit inivèsite obligatwa. Estriktirèlman pi solid pase pwogramasyon aswè opsyonèl pifò lekòl ofri.

strings.text: **Athletic recruiting at scale** — 21 signees in the Class of 2025, roughly 22% of a 94-student class, with athletic scholarships at Florida State, Queens, Wake Forest, Kentucky and New Hampshire.
strings.t: **Rekritman atletik nan gwo echèl** — 21 moun ki siyen nan Klas 2025 la, apeprè 22% nan yon klas 94 elèv, ak bous atletik nan Florida State, Queens, Wake Forest, Kentucky ak New Hampshire.

strings.text: **Seal of Biliteracy** — started in 2019 and awarded for passing a skills exam in two languages. The share earning it fell from 11% of the Class of 2021 to 4% of the Class of 2024. It then rose to 7% of the Class of 2026.
strings.t: **Seal of Biliteracy** — li te kòmanse an 2019 epi yo bay li pou moun ki pase yon egzamen konpetans nan de lang. Pati ki jwenn li te tonbe soti 11% nan Klas 2021 pou rive 4% nan Klas 2024. Apre sa li te monte rive 7% nan Klas 2026.

strings.text: **Scholastic Art & Writing** — 54 awards over the last five years, per the 2026–27 profile.
strings.t: **Scholastic Art & Writing** — 54 prim nan senk dènye ane yo, dapre pwofil 2026–27 la.

strings.text: **A Christian-college network with its own membership** — Charlotte Christian belongs to **NACCAP**, a counseling group for Christian colleges, as well as NACAC and SACAC. Its brochure lists Christian colleges as their own group, and 14% of graduates enroll at one. Class of 2026 graduates enrolled at Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Gordon, Lipscomb and Baylor.
strings.t: **Yon rezo kolèj kretyen ak pwòp manm li** — Charlotte Christian se manm **NACCAP**, yon gwoup konsèy pou kolèj kretyen, ansanm ak NACAC ak SACAC. Bwochi li mete kolèj kretyen yo nan pwòp gwoup yo, epi 14% gradye yo enskri nan youn. Gradye Klas 2026 yo te enskri nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford, Gordon, Lipscomb ak Baylor.

strings.text: **A named HBCU tier** — Hampton, Howard, Morehouse, NC A&T and Spelman are listed as a distinct group, with confirmed Class of 2025 enrollments at NC A&T and Johnson C. Smith.
strings.t: **Yon nivo HBCU ki gen non** — Hampton, Howard, Morehouse, NC A&T ak Spelman liste kòm yon gwoup apa, ak enskripsyon Klas 2025 konfime nan NC A&T ak Johnson C. Smith.

strings.text: **The School Profile as an instrument** — it publishes the AP exam, student and AP Scholar counts and a five-quintile GPA table. It gives a GPA middle 50% (3.604–4.199 for the Class of 2026). It also prints the grading scale, the weighting formula and the CEEB code 340667.
strings.t: **School Profile la kòm yon zouti** — li pibliye kantite egzamen AP, elèv ak AP Scholars ak yon tablo GPA an senk kentil. Li bay yon GPA 50% nan mitan (3.604–4.199 pou Klas 2026). Li enprime tou echèl nòt la, fòmil ponderasyon an ak kòd CEEB 340667.

strings.text: **Detailed scholarship reporting** — the school published roughly ninety named awards for a single class. That is far more specific than one total dollar figure. It lets a family see which colleges actually fund this school’s students.
strings.t: **Rapò detaye sou bous** — lekòl la te pibliye apeprè katrevendis prim ki gen non pou yon sèl klas. Sa pi espesifik lwen pase yon sèl chif dola total. Li kite yon fanmi wè ki inivèsite ki finanse elèv lekòl sa a vre.

strings.text: The discipline policy is published. The school follows the NACAC Statement of Principles of Good Practice. It “does not permit the reporting of any disciplinary infractions”. But it advises students to report on their own any grade 9–12 infraction that led to an out-of-school suspension.
strings.t: Politik disiplin nan pibliye. Lekòl la swiv Statement of Principles of Good Practice NACAC la. Li “pa pèmèt rapòte okenn enfraksyon disiplinè”. Men li konseye elèv yo deklare pou kont yo nenpòt enfraksyon nan klas 9–12 ki te mennen nan yon sispansyon andeyò lekòl la.

strings.text: A full five-quintile GPA table, published every year — and in the Class of 2026 table it compressed: the top floor eased while the bottom rose sharply.
strings.t: Yon tablo GPA konplè an senk kentil, ki pibliye chak ane — epi nan tablo Klas 2026 la li sere: plafon anwo a desann yon ti kras pandan anba a monte anpil.

strings.text: The middle student sits in the third quintile at roughly 3.80–4.05 weighted. The profile puts the class’s GPA middle 50% at 3.604–4.199 on its GPA scale. Honors adds 0.5 and AP a full point. So a 4.240 floor for the top quintile points to a heavy load of advanced courses, not a perfect record.
strings.t: Elèv nan mitan an chita nan twazyèm kentil la, anviwon 3.80–4.05 pondere. Pwofil la mete GPA 50% nan mitan klas la nan 3.604–4.199 sou echèl GPA li. Honors ajoute 0.5 epi AP yon pwen antye. Kidonk yon plafon 4.240 pou kentil anwo a montre yon gwo chaj kou avanse, se pa yon dosye pafè.

strings.text: — Class of 2026 · 83 testers of 110 graduates (~75%)
strings.t: — Klas 2026 · 83 moun ki pase tès nan 110 gradye (~75%)

strings.text: The school publishes the composite middle-50% band and a tester count only. Those endpoints ARE the 25th and 75th percentiles; the mean, the median and any Reading or Maths section split are unpublished, so none is interpolated here.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye bann konpozit mitan-50% la ak yon kantite moun ki pase tès sèlman. Bout sa yo SE 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantaj yo; mwayèn nan, medyàn nan ak nenpòt separasyon seksyon Lekti oswa Matematik pa pibliye, kidonk nou pa entèpole okenn isit la.

strings.text: — Class of 2026 · 90 testers of 110 graduates (~82%)
strings.t: — Klas 2026 · 90 moun ki pase tès nan 110 gradye (~82%)

strings.text: 83 SAT plus 90 ACT testers against 110 graduates means heavy overlap: many students sat both. ACT testing rose from 33 testers in the Class of 2025 to 90 in the Class of 2026; the profile gives no reason. The school publishes no combined “share who tested” figure.
strings.t: 83 moun ki pase SAT plis 90 ki pase ACT kont 110 gradye vle di anpil chevochman: anpil elèv te pase tou de. Kantite moun ki pase ACT te monte soti 33 nan Klas 2025 pou rive 90 nan Klas 2026; pwofil la pa bay rezon an. Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn chif konbine sou “pati ki te pase tès”.

strings.t: — mekanis san ran an · GPA pondere Klas 2026 jiska sizyèm semès la

strings.t: kou avanse solid

strings.t: planche tab ki pibliye a

strings.text: All five quintiles are the school’s own published figures. Compared with the Class of 2025 table, the spread narrowed in one year. The first-quintile floor eased from 4.277 to 4.240. The third rose from 3.686 to 3.804, the fourth from 3.124 to 3.542 and the fifth from 1.941 to 2.269. The bottom of the class moved up much more than the top moved down. No unweighted distribution is published.
strings.t: Tout senk kentil yo se chif lekòl la li menm pibliye. Konpare ak tablo Klas 2025 la, distribisyon an sere nan yon ane. Plafon premye kentil la desann soti 4.277 pou rive 4.240. Twazyèm nan monte soti 3.686 pou rive 3.804, katriyèm nan soti 3.124 pou rive 3.542 epi senkyèm nan soti 1.941 pou rive 2.269. Anba klas la monte pi plis pase anwo a desann. Pa gen okenn distribisyon ki pa pondere ki pibliye.

strings.text: What is published is counseling, not learning support
strings.t: Sa ki pibliye a se konsèy, se pa sipò aprantisaj

strings.text: Two Upper School counselors teach study skills, help with course choices and track academic progress. They also help with test anxiety and refer students to outside resources. That is general counseling, not a programme for learning differences.
strings.t: De konseye Upper School anseye konpetans etid, ede chwazi kou epi swiv pwogrè akademik. Yo ede tou ak estrès nan tès epi yo voye elèv yo bò kote resous deyò. Sa se konsèy jeneral, se pa yon pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj.

strings.text: Credentials are a genuine strength
strings.t: Kalifikasyon yo se yon vrè fòs

strings.text: All counselors hold master’s degrees in counseling or a related field, and several hold clinical licences — LCMHC or LCSW.
strings.t: Tout konseye yo genyen metriz nan konsèy oswa yon domèn ki gen rapò, epi plizyè genyen lisans klinik — LCMHC oswa LCSW.

strings.text: The named academic-support structures
strings.t: Estrikti sipò akademik ki gen non yo

strings.text: **WIN (“What I Need”) labs** and advisory lessons are the Upper School’s named academic support. The **Media & Writing Center** is free and focused on writing. What WIN Lab actually teaches is not described.
strings.t: **WIN (“What I Need”) labs** ak leson advisory se sipò akademik Upper School ki gen non. **Media & Writing Center** la gratis epi li konsantre sou ekriti. Sa WIN Lab anseye vre pa dekri.

strings.text: The middle may be the best-served group
strings.t: Mitan an ka gwoup ki pi byen sèvi a

strings.text: The list runs from Duke, Harvard and Columbia down to Central Piedmont Community College, Barton, Catawba, Spartanburg Methodist, Belmont Abbey, Wingate and Winthrop. A fourth- or fifth-quintile student at 3.54 or below has real, named places to go. The checklist also tells students to include “every possible type of college that might be of interest”.
strings.t: Lis la ale soti Duke, Harvard ak Columbia desann rive jiska Central Piedmont Community College, Barton, Catawba, Spartanburg Methodist, Belmont Abbey, Wingate ak Winthrop. Yon elèv nan katriyèm oswa senkyèm kentil ki gen 3.54 oswa mwens gen vrè kote ki gen non pou l ale. Lis verifikasyon an mande elèv yo tou pou yo mete “tout kalite kolèj posib ki ta ka enterese yo”.

strings.text: The Christian-college route is real, not decorative
strings.t: Wout inivèsite kretyen an reyèl, se pa dekoratif

strings.text: 14% of recent graduates enroll at a Christian college. Graduates of both the Class of 2025 and the Class of 2026 enrolled at Wheaton, Liberty, Samford and Baylor. Class of 2026 graduates also enrolled at Gordon and Lipscomb, and Class of 2025 graduates at Charleston Southern, Cedarville, Grove City and Abilene Christian.
strings.t: 14% nan dènye gradye yo enskri nan yon kolèj kretyen. Gradye ni Klas 2025 ni Klas 2026 te enskri nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford ak Baylor. Gradye Klas 2026 yo te enskri tou nan Gordon ak Lipscomb, epi gradye Klas 2025 yo nan Charleston Southern, Cedarville, Grove City ak Abilene Christian.

strings.text: Vocational and non-traditional
strings.t: Metye ak sa ki pa tradisyonèl

strings.text: Central Piedmont Community College appears on the acceptance list. Two federal service academies, the **Air Force Academy** and **West Point**, each enrolled a Class of 2026 graduate.
strings.t: Central Piedmont Community College parèt sou lis akseptasyon an. De akademi militè federal, **Air Force Academy** ak **West Point**, chak te resevwa yon gradye Klas 2026.

strings.text: Three things the 2026–27 profile leaves open. Its “GPA distribution” heading carries an asterisk with no matching footnote. The quintile table names no class year; it sits in the Class of 2026 column and runs “through 6th semester”. And it does not say whether the 3.604–4.199 GPA middle 50% is weighted. The printed bands also leave small gaps between them (4.220 to 4.240, for example).
strings.t: Twa bagay pwofil 2026–27 la kite louvri. Tit “GPA distribution” li a gen yon asterisk san okenn nòt anba paj ki koresponn. Tablo kentil la pa nonmen okenn klas; li chita nan kolòn Klas 2026 la epi li ale “jiska 6yèm semès”. Epi li pa di si GPA 50% nan mitan 3.604–4.199 la pondere. Tranch ki enprime yo kite ti espas tou ant yo (soti 4.220 pou rive 4.240, pa egzanp).

strings.text: A demanding, open transcript: required AP exams, a full published quintile table, and published AP exam and Scholar counts. It comes with the thinnest learning-support disclosure among the schools on this site.
strings.t: Yon relve nòt ki egzijan epi ki transparan: egzamen AP obligatwa, yon tablo kentil konplè ki pibliye, ak kantite egzamen AP ak Scholars ki pibliye. Li vini ak divilgasyon sou sipò aprantisaj ki pi mens pami lekòl ki sou sit sa a.

strings.text: The academic reporting is unusually honest. The gaps are concentrated in exactly one place, which makes the tour questions easy to aim.
strings.t: Rapò akademik la onèt yon fason ki pa abityèl. Mank yo konsantre nan yon sèl kote, sa ki fè kesyon pou vizit yo fasil pou vize.

strings.text: AP exams are mandatory, so the pass rate means something
strings.t: Egzamen AP obligatwa, kidonk to reyisit la vle di yon bagay

strings.text: “Students in AP classes are required to take the AP exam” — so 94% scoring 3+ in 2026, after 89% in 2024 and 78% in 2021, rests on a non-self-selected pool rather than only confident testers.
strings.t: “Elèv ki nan klas AP yo oblije pase egzamen AP a” — kidonk 94% ki fè 3+ an 2026, apre 89% an 2024 ak 78% an 2021, chita sou yon gwoup ki pa chwazi tèt li olye sèlman elèv ki gen konfyans yo.

strings.text: The AP counts are published with the rate
strings.t: Kantite AP yo pibliye ansanm ak to a

strings.text: the 2026–27 profile prints 435 exams, 208 students and 90 AP Scholars beside the 94%, so the rate can be read against the size of the group that earned it.
strings.t: pwofil 2026–27 la enprime 435 egzamen, 208 elèv ak 90 AP Scholars bò kote 94% la, kidonk yo ka li to a konpare ak gwosè gwoup ki te rive fè l la.

strings.text: A real quintile table, published annually
strings.t: Yon vrè tab senkyèm, pibliye chak ane

strings.text: five quintiles through the sixth semester, so colleges can locate a student’s band without a rank — and comparing editions makes year-to-year grade movement visible rather than hidden.
strings.t: senk kentil jiska sizyèm semès la, kidonk kolèj yo ka jwenn tranch yon elèv san ran — epi konpare edisyon yo fè mouvman nòt ane an ane yo vizib olye kache.

strings.text: Junior Seminar is a requirement, not an invitation
strings.t: Junior Seminar se yon kondisyon, se pa yon envitasyon

strings.text: a graded half-credit course carrying a mock admission committee and two mandatory college visits — more structured than the optional evening programming peers offer.
strings.t: yon kou ak nòt demi kredi ki pote yon komite admisyon similye ak de vizit inivèsite obligatwa — pi estriktire pase pwogramasyon aswè opsyonèl lekòl parèy ofri.

strings.text: The Conservatory reaches the reader
strings.t: Conservatory a rive nan men moun k ap li a

strings.text: it is noted on the transcript, so the credential lands in the admissions file rather than only on a résumé.
strings.t: yo note l sou relve nòt la, kidonk kalifikasyon an rive nan dosye admisyon an olye ke sèlman sou yon rezime.

strings.text: A distinctive network the others do not have
strings.t: Yon rezo distenktif lòt yo pa genyen

strings.text: NACCAP membership plus named Christian-college and HBCU tiers, with 14% of graduates actually enrolling at a Christian college and confirmed pipelines to Wheaton, Liberty, Samford and Baylor.
strings.t: manbraj NACCAP plis nivo inivèsite kretyen ak HBCU ki gen non, ak 14% nan gradye yo ki vrèman enskri nan yon inivèsite kretyen ak rezo konfime nan Wheaton, Liberty, Samford ak Baylor.

strings.text: You publish no named learning specialist, no learning-differences programme and no accommodations policy. Who supports a student with a diagnosed learning difference, and who coordinates College Board accommodations?
strings.t: Ou pa pibliye okenn espesyalis aprantisaj ki gen non, okenn pwogram pou diferans nan aprantisaj ak okenn politik akomodasyon. Kiyès ki sipòte yon elèv ki gen yon diferans nan aprantisaj ki dyagnostike, epi kiyès ki kòdone akomodasyon College Board?

strings.text: Honors and AP placement requires an A in the prerequisite course and AP exams are mandatory. How does that combination work for a student with accommodations?
strings.t: Plasman nan Honors ak AP egzije yon A nan kou kondisyon anvan an epi egzamen AP obligatwa. Kijan konbinezon sa a mache pou yon elèv ki gen akomodasyon?

strings.text: What share of AP exams scored 4 or 5? Only the 3+ threshold is published.
strings.t: Ki pòsyon nan egzamen AP yo ki te fè 4 oswa 5? Se sèlman sèy 3+ la ki pibliye.

strings.text: Your marketing says “45+ AP and honors courses” but roughly 23 AP courses can be enumerated. What is the actual count?
strings.t: Maketing ou di “45+ kou AP ak honors” men apeprè 23 kou AP ka konte. Ki vrè kantite a?

strings.text: Your profile reports 12 National Merit finalists on a rolling 15-year window, down from 16 six years earlier. What were the per-class counts for the last five years?
strings.t: Pwofil ou a rapòte 12 finalis National Merit sou yon fenèt 15 an k ap glise, desann soti 16 sis ane pi bonè. Ki kantite pa klas te genyen pou senk dènye ane yo?

strings.text: The school lists one Commended Scholar for the Class of 2025 while press coverage names a Semifinalist you do not list. Which is right?
strings.t: Lekòl la liste yon Commended Scholar pou Klas 2025 la pandan kouvèti près la nonmen yon Semifinalis ou pa liste. Kiyès nan yo ki kòrèk?

strings.text: You state 99% attend a four-year college, but the Class of 2025’s named senior roster showed about five of 94 elsewhere. How is that 99% calculated for the 110 graduates of the Class of 2026?
strings.t: Ou di 99% ale nan yon kolèj kat an, men lis non elèv fen etid Klas 2025 la te montre anviwon senk sou 94 yon lòt kote. Kijan yo kalkile 99% sa a pou 110 gradye Klas 2026 yo?

strings.text: Your profile gives dual enrollment +0.5 on page 1 and +.75 on page 3. Which applies?
strings.t: Pwofil ou a bay enskripsyon doub +0.5 nan paj 1 ak +.75 nan paj 3. Kiyès ki aplike?

strings.text: Where did the Class of 2024 enroll? The two published lists mark only Class of 2025 and Class of 2026 enrollments.
strings.t: Ki kote Klas 2024 la te enskri? De lis ki pibliye yo make sèlman enskripsyon Klas 2025 ak Klas 2026.

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Charlotte Catholic High School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 56.0% over the last five entering classes — 1,175 acceptances from 2,100 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Charlotte Catholic High School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 56.0% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 1,175 admisyon sou 2,100 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 23.3% in Fall 2025 — 24 of 103 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 23.3% nan otòn 2025 — 24 sou 103 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 1,175 of 2,100 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 1,175 sou 2,100 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 24 of 103, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 24 sou 103, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (141)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (141)

strings.text: A weighted-only transcript, no class rank, and an AP program where the exam is not optional.
strings.t: Yon relve nòt ki pondere sèlman, pa gen ran nan klas, ak yon pwogram AP kote egzamen an pa opsyonèl.

strings.text: CCHS adds one quality point for AP, Honors and Dual Enrollment and shows only the weighted GPA — so the number a college reads is already the school-adjusted one. 69% of the Class of 2026 scored 3 or above on at least one AP exam.
strings.t: CCHS ajoute yon pwen kalite pou AP, Honors ak Dual Enrollment epi li montre sèlman GPA pondere a — kidonk chif yon inivèsite li a se deja sa lekòl la ajiste a. 69% nan Klas 2026 la te jwenn 3 oswa pi wo nan omwen yon egzamen AP.

strings.text: AP exams taken in 2026 (393 students, grades 11–12)

strings.t: Honors Calculus, AP Calculus AB, AP Calculus BC ak AP Statistics chita anwo Honors Pre-Calculus — kat opsyon apre Pre-Calc.

strings.t: AP Biology, AP Chemistry, AP Environmental Science, AP Physics 1 ak AP Physics C: Mechanics, plis Honors Anatomy and Physiology, Honors Nutritional Science, Biotechnology, Forensic Science ak Sports Medicine.

strings.text: Classical pathway
strings.t: Pis klasik

strings.text: The St. Augustine Scholars Program began with a 9th-grade class in 2025-26 and now runs 10th-grade courses. It adds a four-year classical track: philosophy, logic, Latin, primary texts and Socratic seminars.
strings.t: St. Augustine Scholars Program lan te kòmanse ak yon gwoup 9yèm ane an 2025-26 epi kounye a li gen kou 10yèm ane. Li ajoute yon pis klasik kat ane: filozofi, lojik, Laten, tèks orijinal ak seminè Sokratik.

strings.text: How the grade is engineered to be read
