strings.text: Weighted only
strings.t: Pondere sèlman

strings.text: One additional quality point for AP, Honors and Dual Enrollment classes. Only the weighted GPA appears on the transcript — there is no unweighted figure to compare against.
strings.t: Yon pwen kalite anplis pou klas AP, Honors ak Dual Enrollment. Se sèlman GPA pondere a ki parèt sou relve nòt la — pa gen okenn chif ki pa pondere pou konpare avè l.

strings.text: No class rank
strings.t: Pa gen ran nan klas

strings.text: The profile states plainly that "Charlotte Catholic does not rank students." A 10-decile GPA chart is published instead, so a college can place a student without a rank.
strings.t: Pwofil la di klèman ke “Charlotte Catholic does not rank students.” Yo pibliye yon tablo GPA ak 10 desil nan plas li, kidonk yon inivèsite ka plase yon elèv san yon ran.

strings.text: Load norms stated
strings.t: Nòm chay yo deklare

strings.text: "Most demanding" is defined by the school as 2 AP courses in junior year plus 4 in senior year — the reader is told the ceiling rather than left to guess it.
strings.t: Lekòl la defini “most demanding” kòm 2 kou AP nan twazyèm ane plis 4 nan katriyèm ane — yo di moun k ap li a plafon an olye ke kite l devine l.

strings.text: AP entry is competitive
strings.t: Antre nan AP mande seleksyon

strings.text: Students apply for each AP course; placement weighs prior coursework and grades, PSAT results and teacher feedback. AP is not open enrollment here.
strings.t: Elèv yo aplike pou chak kou AP; plasman an konsidere kou ak nòt anvan yo, rezilta PSAT ak kòmantè pwofesè. AP pa louvri a tout moun isit la.

strings.text: Honors is rationed early
strings.t: Yo rasyone Honors depi bonè

strings.text: A maximum of 1 honors class in 9th grade and 5 in 10th — so an underclass transcript is capped by policy, not by ambition.
strings.t: Yon maksimòm de 1 klas honors nan 9yèm ane ak 5 nan 10yèm — kidonk politik la limite relve nòt premye ane yo, se pa anbisyon.

strings.text: Transfer credit excluded
strings.t: Kredi transfè eskli

strings.text: Transcripts reflect only classes completed at Charlotte Catholic; transfer transcripts are not added to the CCHS record.
strings.t: Relve nòt yo reflete sèlman klas ki fèt nan Charlotte Catholic; yo pa ajoute relve nòt transfè nan dosye CCHS la.

strings.text: No AP Scholar tier counts are published. Instead, the profile gives results by exam (94% scoring 3+ across 1,184 exams in 2026). That tells you more. But it means the Scholar/Scholar with Distinction ledger other schools show cannot be built here.
strings.t: Yo pa pibliye okenn kantite pa nivo AP Scholar. Olye de sa, pwofil la bay rezilta pa egzamen (94% ki jwenn 3+ atravè 1,184 egzamen an 2026). Sa di w plis bagay. Men sa vle di nou pa ka bati rejis Scholar/Scholar with Distinction lòt lekòl yo montre a isit la.

strings.text: The AP figures are the 2026 exam session, the testing and decile figures are the Class of 2027, and the outcomes are the Class of 2026. Each is as published; they are not combined into a single claim.
strings.t: Chif AP yo se sesyon egzamen 2026 la, chif tès ak desil yo se Klas 2027 la, epi rezilta yo se Klas 2026 la. Chak se jan yo pibliye l; nou pa konbine yo nan yon sèl deklarasyon.

strings.text: A director and five counselors for 336 seniors — about 56 seniors each.
strings.t: Yon direktè ak senk konseye pou 336 elèv dènye ane — apeprè 56 elèv chak.

strings.text: The caseload is computed from the profile’s own two figures, not published as a ratio by the school.
strings.t: Nou kalkile chay la apati de chif pwofil la li menm, lekòl la pa pibliye l kòm yon rapò.

strings.text: Foundation
strings.t: Fondasyon

strings.text: Placement is set by prior coursework, standardized testing and teacher feedback rather than by student request.
strings.t: Se kou anvan yo, tès estandadize ak kòmantè pwofesè ki detèmine plasman an, se pa demann elèv la.

strings.text: Honors access is capped at one course.
strings.t: Aksè nan Honors limite a yon sèl kou.

strings.text: Philosophy (0.5 credit) is taken in freshman year starting with the Class of 2028.
strings.t: Yo pran Philosophy (0.5 kredi) nan premye ane a apati Klas 2028 la.

strings.text: Service begins immediately — 10 hours due, at least 5 of them parish service, by March 1.
strings.t: Sèvis kòmanse touswit — 10 èdtan pou remèt, omwen 5 nan yo se sèvis nan parwas, anvan 1ye mas.

strings.text: Focus: establish the weighted GPA that the decile chart will later place.
strings.t: Konsantrasyon: etabli GPA pondere a ke tablo desil la ap plase pi devan.

strings.t: Aksè nan Honors elaji anpil — jiska senk kou honors.

strings.text: PSAT results begin to feed AP placement decisions.
strings.t: Rezilta PSAT kòmanse antre nan desizyon plasman AP yo.

strings.text: Service rises to 20 hours a year, the level it holds through graduation.
strings.t: Sèvis monte a 20 èdtan pa ane, nivo li kenbe jiska gradyasyon.

strings.text: Journalism and Yearbook open as electives, the school’s two publication courses.
strings.t: Journalism ak Yearbook louvri kòm elektif, de kou piblikasyon lekòl la.

strings.text: AP courses become available for the first time; students apply per course.
strings.t: Kou AP yo vin disponib pou premye fwa; elèv yo aplike pou chak kou.

strings.text: Two AP courses in junior year is the school-stated "most demanding" benchmark.
strings.t: De kou AP nan twazyèm ane se referans “most demanding” lekòl la deklare a.

strings.text: AP exams are mandatory in each AP course taken.
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo obligatwa nan chak kou AP yon elèv pran.

strings.text: College admissions representatives visit campus — NC State lists CCHS as a named recruiting venue.
strings.t: Reprezantan admisyon inivèsite yo vizite kanpis la — NC State liste CCHS kòm yon kote rekritman ki gen non.

strings.t: Biwo oryantasyon an pibliye sijè disètasyon Common Application yo epi li sipòte redaksyon an kont yo.

strings.text: Transcripts carry the weighted GPA and no rank; the decile chart travels with the profile.
strings.t: Relve nòt yo pote GPA pondere a epi pa gen ran; tablo desil la vwayaje ak pwofil la.

strings.text: Final service hours are due March 1, completing the 70-hour graduation requirement.
strings.t: Dènye èdtan sèvis yo dwe remèt 1ye mas, sa ki konplete kondisyon 70 èdtan pou gradyasyon an.

strings.text: Dual Enrollment (college courses taken while in high school) through Central Piedmont Community College opens. Students take one course per semester on their own schedule, with the same extra quality point as AP and Honors.
strings.t: Dual Enrollment (kou kolèj yo pran pandan yo lekòl segondè) atravè Central Piedmont Community College louvri. Elèv yo pran yon kou pa semès dapre pwòp orè yo, ak menm pwen kalite anplis ak AP ak Honors.

strings.t: Chay ~56:1 pou elèv dènye ane a KALKILE apati 336 elèv dènye ane pwofil 2026-27 la (Klas 2027) ak sis konseye li nonmen yo. Lekòl la pa pibliye yon rapò, epi nou konte direktè a kòm yon konseye isit la.

strings.text: The junior and senior college-planning pages embed Prezi presentations, whose content is not reachable as text. The four-year timeline above is therefore built from published policy, not from the office’s own process deck.
strings.t: Paj planifikasyon inivèsite pou twazyèm ak katriyèm ane yo entegre prezantasyon Prezi, ke nou pa ka jwenn kontni yo kòm tèks. Se poutèt sa nou bati kalandriye kat ane ki anwo a apati politik ki pibliye, se pa apati pwòp dosye pwosesis biwo a.

strings.text: The scholarship total is the class-wide figure the school publishes; it is not broken out by institution, by merit-versus-need, or per student.
strings.t: Total bous la se chif pou tout klas la lekòl la pibliye; yo pa detaye l pa enstitisyon, pa merit kont bezwen, ni pa elèv.

strings.text: No per-institution enrollment counts are published, so no college on this list can be marked as enrolling more than one graduate.
strings.t: Yo pa pibliye okenn kantite enskripsyon pa enstitisyon, kidonk nou pa ka make okenn inivèsite sou lis sa a kòm ki enskri plis pase yon moun ki gradye.

strings.text: Bucket membership is scored against the app’s master U.S. News 2027 table rather than by the school, which publishes the institution names only.
strings.t: Nou evalye apatenans nan gwoup yo kont tab prensipal U.S. News 2027 app la olye ke pa lekòl la, ki pibliye non enstitisyon yo sèlman.

strings.text: The list merges the 2025-26 profile (Classes of 2023–2025, 169 institutions) with the 2026-27 profile (Classes of 2024–2026, 168): 137 shared, 31 new, 32 kept from the older list, 200 in all. Nothing is removed. Where the two editions spell an institution differently, the 2025-26 spelling is kept.
strings.t: Lis la mete ansanm pwofil 2025-26 la (Klas 2023–2025, 169 enstitisyon) ak pwofil 2026-27 la (Klas 2024–2026, 168): 137 an komen, 31 nouvo, 32 ki rete nan ansyen lis la, 200 an tout. Nou pa retire anyen. Lè de edisyon yo ekri non yon enstitisyon diferan, nou kenbe òtograf 2025-26 la.

strings.text: What actually moves a CCHS application.
strings.t: Sa ki reyèlman fè yon aplikasyon CCHS avanse.

strings.text: One lever the student builds, one the school supplies by being a 79-championship NCHSAA program inside a diocesan system.
strings.t: Yon levye elèv la bati, yon lòt lekòl la bay lè li se yon pwogram NCHSAA ak 79 chanpyona anndan yon sistèm dyosèz.

strings.text: what a student controls
strings.t: sa yon elèv kontwole

strings.text: Take the AP load the school names as most demanding — 2 in junior year, 4 in senior year — and clear the competitive application for each course.
strings.t: Pran chay AP lekòl la rele ki pi egzijan an — 2 nan twazyèm ane, 4 nan katriyèm ane — epi pase aplikasyon ak seleksyon an pou chak kou.

strings.text: Take the AP exam in every AP course. It is mandatory here, so the 94% scoring 3+ counts every AP student. No one can opt out of it.
strings.t: Pase egzamen AP la nan chak kou AP. Li obligatwa isit la, kidonk 94% ki jwenn 3+ la konte chak elèv AP. Pèsonn pa ka chwazi pa pase l.

strings.text: Go past 70 service hours. The requirement is universal, so the hours themselves do not differentiate — the parish and leadership roles behind them do.
strings.t: Ale pi lwen pase 70 èdtan sèvis. Egzijans lan menm pou tout moun, kidonk èdtan yo pou kont yo pa fè diferans — se wòl nan parwas la ak nan lidèchip ki dèyè yo ki fè l.

strings.text: Use the 76-club directory to build depth rather than breadth: seven honor societies carry published GPA thresholds, from NHS at 3.9 to Mu Alpha Theta at 4.5 in mathematics.
strings.t: Sèvi ak anyè 76 klib la pou bati pwofondè olye ke lajè: sèt sosyete onè pote papòt GPA ki pibliye, soti nan NHS a 3.9 rive nan Mu Alpha Theta a 4.5 nan matematik.

strings.text: For a classical or theology-facing application, the St. Augustine Scholars Program is a four-year differentiator that few applicants anywhere will carry.
strings.t: Pou yon aplikasyon ki oryante nan klasik oswa teoloji, St. Augustine Scholars Program lan se yon eleman kat ane ki fè diferans ke tikras aplikan okenn kote ap genyen.

strings.text: what CCHS supplies
strings.t: sa CCHS bay

strings.text: Athletic recruiting reach is real and unusual: 79 state championships since 2000, 10 Wells Fargo Cups, and 1000+ alumni who went on to play at NCAA, NAIA or junior-college level.
strings.t: Pòte rekritman atletik la reyèl epi li pa abityèl: 79 chanpyona eta depi 2000, 10 Wells Fargo Cups, ak 1000+ ansyen elèv ki te ale jwe nan nivo NCAA, NAIA oswa kolèj de zan.

strings.text: CCHS is one of only four parochial (church-run) schools in the NCHSAA, the sports association for public schools. So its athletes are measured against the state’s biggest programs, not a private-school bracket.
strings.t: CCHS se youn nan sèlman kat lekòl parwasyal (legliz dirije) nan NCHSAA, asosyasyon espò lekòl piblik yo. Kidonk yo mezire atlèt li yo kont pi gwo pwogram eta a, se pa nan yon gwoup lekòl prive.

strings.text: The school profile does the interpretive work for an admissions reader: decile chart, stated load norms, explicit no-rank policy and a defined "most demanding" benchmark.
strings.t: Pwofil lekòl la fè travay entèpretasyon an pou yon moun k ap li nan admisyon: tablo desil, nòm chay ki deklare, politik eksplisit pou pa bay ran ak yon referans “most demanding” ki defini.

strings.text: The school’s size as a diocesan school shows up in outcomes. There were Naval Academy appointments in back-to-back classes (three in 2025, one in 2026 alongside a West Point appointment). Graduates have also enrolled at all three service academies.
strings.t: Gwosè lekòl la kòm lekòl dyosèz parèt nan rezilta yo. Te gen nominasyon nan Naval Academy nan klas youn apre lòt (twa an 2025, youn an 2026 ansanm ak yon nominasyon nan West Point). Gradye yo te enskri tou nan tou twa akademi militè yo.

strings.text: A 650-seat Fine Arts Center dedicated in 2022, a Charlotte Symphony partnership, and a band that performs quadrennially in Dublin give arts applicants a portfolio venue.
strings.t: Yon Fine Arts Center 650 plas ki dedye an 2022, yon patenarya ak Charlotte Symphony, ak yon fanfa ki jwe chak kat ane nan Dublin bay aplikan nan atizay yon kote pou montre travay yo.

strings.text: No published Naviance/SCOIR-style scattergram exists, so a family cannot see admit rates by GPA band for this school.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn dyagram tankou Naviance/SCOIR ki pibliye, kidonk yon fanmi pa ka wè to admisyon pa bann GPA pou lekòl sa a.

strings.text: CCHS publishes no admissions-outcome tool (no scattergrams, no admit rates by band), so "what it takes" cannot be answered quantitatively from the school’s own materials.
strings.t: CCHS pa pibliye okenn zouti sou rezilta admisyon (pa gen dyagram, pa gen to admisyon pa bann), kidonk nou pa ka reponn “kisa sa mande” ak chif apati pwòp materyèl lekòl la.

strings.text: The whole class, not just the top of it.
strings.t: Tout klas la, se pa sèlman tèt li.

strings.text: CCHS publishes mid-50% test ranges and a 10-decile GPA chart — enough to place a student honestly, and it refuses to rank them.
strings.t: CCHS pibliye entèval mitan-50% pou tès yo ak yon tablo GPA ak 10 desil — ase pou plase yon elèv onètman, epi li refize klase yo.

strings.text: SAT and ACT, mid-50% ranges
strings.t: SAT ak ACT, entèval mitan-50%

strings.text: Class of 2027 · 290 SAT takers · 322 ACT takers
strings.t: Klas 2027 · 290 moun ki pase SAT · 322 moun ki pase ACT

strings.text: The school publishes a mid-50% RANGE, not percentiles and not an average. The two ends of a mid-50% range are by definition the 25th and 75th percentiles, so those two columns are real. The 10th, 50th, 90th and mean are not published. They are shown as em-dashes rather than estimated. No section-level (EBRW / Math) split is published. With 336 seniors, 290 SAT takers and 322 ACT takers, most of the class took both tests.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye yon ENTÈVAL mitan 50%, se pa pousantil ni yon mwayèn. De bout yon entèval mitan 50% se pa definisyon 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantil yo, kidonk de kolòn sa yo reyèl. 10yèm, 50yèm, 90yèm ak mwayèn nan pa pibliye. Nou montre yo kòm tirè olye ke estime yo. Pa gen okenn divizyon pa seksyon (EBRW / Math) ki pibliye. Ak 336 elèv dènye ane, 290 ki pase SAT ak 322 ki pase ACT, pifò nan klas la te pase de tès yo.

Desil ki pibliye yo se 1ye 4.38–4.59, 2yèm 4.23–4.37, 3yèm 4.09–4.22, 4yèm 3.98–4.08, 5yèm 3.83–3.97, 6yèm 3.70–3.82, 7yèm 3.54–3.69, 8yèm 3.35–3.53, 9yèm 3.16–3.34, 10yèm 2.22–3.15. Chak chif pondere, ak yon pwen kalite ajoute pou AP, Honors ak Dual Enrollment.

strings.text: A one-semester course (508 for grades 9–10, 509 for 11–12) in planning, organizing and focus skills and in speaking up for yourself. It is for Academic Achievement students — the step before Guided Academic Support.
strings.t: Yon kou yon semès (508 pou grad 9–10, 509 pou 11–12) sou konpetans planifikasyon, òganizasyon ak konsantrasyon, ak sou jan pou pale pou tèt ou. Li pou elèv Academic Achievement yo — etap ki vini anvan Guided Academic Support.

strings.text: Guided Academic Support
strings.t: Sipò akademik gide

strings.text: A scheduled course (511) rather than a pull-out service — support sits inside the timetable.
strings.t: Yon kou nan orè a (511) olye ke yon sèvis kote yo retire elèv la nan klas — sipò a chita anndan orè a.

strings.text: Options Program
strings.t: Options Program

strings.text: A full parallel track — Options English 9–12, Options Year 1–4, Options PE, Math Life 1–2, Options Personal Finance and Options Financial Management: 14 courses in all.
strings.t: Yon pis paralèl konplè — Options English 9–12, Options Year 1–4, Options PE, Math Life 1–2, Options Personal Finance ak Options Financial Management: 14 kou antou.

strings.text: Pathway Program
strings.t: Pathway Program

strings.t: Yon kou pathway apa (507) akote pis Options la.

strings.text: Study Hall
strings.t: Study Hall

strings.text: Timetabled (100), so a supported schedule need not sacrifice an elective slot.
strings.t: Nan orè a (100), kidonk yon orè ak sipò pa bezwen sakrifye yon plas elektif.

strings.text: The middle band is published
strings.t: Bann mitan an pibliye

strings.text: The 5th and 6th deciles run 3.83–3.97 and 3.70–3.82 — a family can locate a median student, which a school publishing only averages would hide.
strings.t: 5yèm ak 6yèm desil yo ale 3.83–3.97 ak 3.70–3.82 — yon fanmi ka jwenn kote yon elèv medyàn ye, sa yon lekòl ki pibliye sèlman mwayèn ta kache.

strings.text: The bottom decile is not hidden
strings.t: Desil ki anba a pa kache

strings.text: The 10th decile is published as 2.22–3.15 rather than truncated, which is unusually candid for a school profile.
strings.t: Yo pibliye 10yèm desil la kòm 2.22–3.15 olye ke koupe l, sa ki onèt yon fason ki pa abityèl pou yon pwofil lekòl.

strings.text: 98% continue immediately
strings.t: 98% kontinye touswit

strings.text: Of the Class of 2026, 98% went straight to post-secondary education and 2% to two-year institutions.
strings.t: Nan Klas 2026 la, 98% te ale dirèkteman nan edikasyon apre segondè epi 2% nan enstitisyon de zan.

strings.text: Public-university weighted
strings.t: Peze plis sou inivèsite piblik

strings.text: 76% of the Class of 2026 enrolled at public universities and 24% at private ones — an outcome pattern closer to a strong public high school than to an independent day school.
strings.t: 76% nan Klas 2026 la te enskri nan inivèsite piblik epi 24% nan inivèsite prive — yon modèl rezilta ki pi pre yon bon lekòl segondè piblik pase yon lekòl endepandan lajounen.

strings.text: No mean or median SAT/ACT is published, so this school cannot be placed on an averages-based comparison with schools that publish one. The mid-50% range is what exists.
strings.t: Yo pa pibliye okenn mwayèn ni medyàn SAT/ACT, kidonk nou pa ka plase lekòl sa a nan yon konparezon ki baze sou mwayèn ak lekòl ki pibliye youn. Entèval mitan-50% la se sa ki egziste.

strings.text: A large, transparent, athletically dominant Catholic high school that publishes more than most.
strings.t: Yon gwo lekòl segondè Katolik, transparan, ki domine nan espò epi ki pibliye plis pase pifò.

strings.text: The profile answers the questions a family actually asks — and the tuition structure answers one no other school on this roster raises.
strings.t: Pwofil la reponn kesyon yon fanmi poze vre — epi estrikti frè eskolè a reponn youn okenn lòt lekòl sou lis sa a pa poze.

strings.text: The disclosure is genuinely strong
strings.t: Divilgasyon an vrèman solid

strings.text: A **10-decile GPA chart including the bottom decile**, stated load norms, an explicit no-rank policy and exam-level AP performance. Most schools publish less and frame it more favourably.
strings.t: Yon **tablo GPA ak 10 desil ki enkli desil ki anba a**, nòm chay ki deklare, yon politik eksplisit pou pa bay ran ak pèfòmans AP nan nivo egzamen. Pifò lekòl pibliye mwens epi prezante l yon fason ki pi favorab.

strings.text: The AP rate cannot be flattered
strings.t: Yo pa ka anbeli to AP a

strings.text: **94% of scores at 3+** across **1,184 exams** in 2026 covers every AP student, because **the exam is mandatory in every AP course**. Weaker students cannot be quietly left out of the count.
strings.t: **94% nan nòt yo a 3+** atravè **1,184 egzamen** an 2026 kouvri chak elèv AP, paske **egzamen an obligatwa nan chak kou AP**. Yo pa ka trankilman kite elèv ki pi fèb yo deyò kont lan.

strings.text: Read the college list as enrollments
strings.t: Li lis inivèsite a kòm enskripsyon

strings.text: **200 institutions** across the Classes of 2023–2026 is where graduates actually *enrolled*, a smaller measure than an acceptance list by construction. CCHS looks stronger, not weaker, once that is understood.
strings.t: **200 enstitisyon** atravè Klas 2023–2026 yo se kote moun ki gradye yo *enskri* vre, yon mezi ki pi piti pase yon lis aksèptasyon nan estrikti l. CCHS parèt pi fò, se pa pi fèb, yon fwa ou konprann sa.

strings.text: Athletics is the standout
strings.t: Espò se sa ki pi remakab

strings.text: **79 state championships** since 2000 and **10 Wells Fargo Cups**, won inside the **NCHSAA** against public schools rather than in a private-school bracket.
strings.t: **79 chanpyona eta** depi 2000 ak **10 Wells Fargo Cups**, genyen anndan **NCHSAA** kont lekòl piblik olye ke nan yon gwoup lekòl prive.

strings.text: Tuition turns on parish participation
strings.t: Frè eskolè a depann de patisipasyon nan parwas la

strings.text: **$15,041** for a participating Catholic family against **$21,562** at the community rate — a ~30% difference driven by parish involvement rather than financial need, and the single biggest cost variable here.
strings.t: **$15,041** pou yon fanmi Katolik k ap patisipe kont **$21,562** nan to kominote a — yon diferans ~30% ki soti nan patisipasyon nan parwas la olye ke bezwen finansye, epi se pi gwo varyab depans isit la.

strings.text: The gaps are structural, not sloppy
strings.t: Mank yo estriktirèl, se pa neglijans

strings.text: No per-school aid figures (MACS publishes diocese-wide only), **no Form 990** (the diocese is exempt as a religious organization), and no published tuition history.
strings.t: Pa gen chif èd pa lekòl (MACS pibliye pou tout dyosèz la sèlman), **pa gen Form 990** (dyosèz la egzante kòm yon òganizasyon relijye), epi pa gen istorik frè eskolè ki pibliye.

strings.text: Are we a participating Catholic family for tuition purposes — and what exactly does the parish require to qualify?
strings.t: Èske nou se yon fanmi Katolik k ap patisipe pou rezon frè eskolè — epi kisa parwas la mande egzakteman pou kalifye?

strings.text: What did Family Individualized Tuition actually award families like ours last year? The diocese publishes no per-school aid figures.
strings.t: Kisa Family Individualized Tuition te bay fanmi tankou pa nou an ane pase vre? Dyosèz la pa pibliye okenn chif èd pa lekòl.

strings.text: My child wants AP courses — what does the application for each course weigh, and how many applicants are turned away?
strings.t: Pitit mwen an vle kou AP — kisa aplikasyon pou chak kou konsidere, epi konbyen aplikan yo refize?

strings.text: AP exams are mandatory here. What happens to a student who takes an AP course and does poorly on the exam?
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo obligatwa isit la. Kisa k ap rive yon elèv ki pran yon kou AP epi ki fè mal nan egzamen an?

strings.text: Counselors are assigned by last name and stay with a student all four years. How does each one balance about 56 seniors through application season?
strings.t: Yo bay konseye yo selon non fanmi epi yo rete ak yon elèv pandan tout kat ane yo. Kijan chak konseye jere anviwon 56 elèv dènye ane pandan sezon aplikasyon yo?

strings.text: What does a typical Options Program student’s day look like, and how much of it is spent in classes alongside peers?
strings.t: Kijan yon jounen tipik ye pou yon elèv Options Program, e konbyen tan li pase nan klas ansanm ak lòt elèv yo?

strings.text: The band performs in Dublin every four years — what does a family pay for that, and when is the next one?
strings.t: Fanfa a jwe nan Dublin chak kat ane — konbyen yon fanmi peye pou sa, epi kilè pwochen an?

strings.text: Which sports hold separate fall and spring signing days, and where are those results published?
strings.t: Ki espò ki gen jou siyati otòn ak prentan apa, epi ki kote yo pibliye rezilta sa yo?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Charlotte Country Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 46.7% over the last five entering classes — 328 acceptances from 702 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Charlotte Country Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 46.7% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 328 admisyon sou 702 aplikasyon.

strings.text: NC State University is the hard one: 22.9% in Fall 2025 — 11 of 48 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: NC State University se sa ki difisil la: 22.9% nan otòn 2025 — 11 sou 48 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 328 of 702 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 328 sou 702 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at NC State University — 11 of 48, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan NC State University — 11 sou 48, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: 589 AP exams in 2026 at 96% scoring 3+ and 87% at 4 or 5 — an average score of 4.2 — and the school publishes those results discipline by discipline.
strings.t: 589 egzamen AP an 2026 ak 96% ki fè 3+ ak 87% nan 4 oswa 5 — yon nòt mwayèn 4.2 — epi lekòl la pibliye rezilta sa yo disiplin pa disiplin.

strings.text: Country Day was the first school in North Carolina to offer the IB Diploma. So a student has two clear routes to the hardest course load, not one. The profile also names the top course in every subject.
strings.t: Country Day se te premye lekòl nan North Carolina ki te ofri Diplòm IB la. Kidonk yon elèv gen de wout klè pou rive nan chaj kou ki pi difisil la, se pa youn sèlman. Pwofil la nonmen tou kou ki pi wo a nan chak matyè.

strings.text: AP exams sat in May 2026 (230 students)
strings.t: egzamen AP yo pase nan mwa me 2026 (230 elèv)

strings.t: te fè 3+ · 87% te genyen 4 oswa 5 · mwayèn 4.2

strings.t: kou AP (28 Honors) plis yon Diploma Programme IB konplè, 2026–27

strings.t: **7** Semifinalis · **7** Finalis · **2** Commended · 1 Scholar, 1 College-Sponsored Scholar

strings.t: **9** Semifinalis · **8** Commended — 17 nan 97yèm pousantaj la oswa pi wo

strings.t: **7** Semifinalis · **8** Commended

strings.text: The Class of 2025 line is the school’s own published figure but sits three times below the classes on either side of it, so it is flagged rather than smoothed. Note also that Semifinalists are named each autumn of senior year, which is why the 2026–27 profile already carries the Class of 2027. College Board National Recognition Program counts are not published in any year.
strings.t: Liy Klas 2025 la se pwòp chif lekòl la pibliye men li chita twa fwa pi ba pase klas ki toutbò l yo, kidonk nou make l olye ke lise l. Note tou ke yo nonmen Semifinalis yo chak otòn nan dènye ane a, epi se poutèt sa pwofil 2026–27 la deja gen Klas 2027 la. Kantite College Board National Recognition Program pa pibliye nan okenn ane.

strings.text: **Calculus III** (dual-listed with IB Analysis HL) tops the sequence, and there is a rare post-AP statistics path — **Advanced AP Statistics with R and R Studio**.
strings.t: **Calculus III** (ki liste doub ak IB Analysis HL) nan tèt sekans lan, epi gen yon pis estatistik pòs-AP ki ra — **Advanced AP Statistics with R and R Studio**.

strings.text: Sciences
strings.t: Syans

strings.text: **Organic Chemistry** and **Physical Computational Biochemistry** are one-semester electives taken after AP. Organic Chemistry is stated to be for students who have finished AP or IB Chemistry. **AP Physics 1** replaced Honors Physics in 2026–27. It is now the course students must take before AP Physics C.
strings.t: **Organic Chemistry** ak **Physical Computational Biochemistry** se kou opsyonèl yon semès elèv yo pran apre AP. Yo di Organic Chemistry se pou elèv ki fini AP oswa IB Chemistry. **AP Physics 1** te ranplase Honors Physics an 2026–27. Kounye a se kou elèv yo dwe pran anvan AP Physics C.

strings.text: The top course is AP Computer Science A. **AP Computer Science Principles** joins in 2026–27 as a starting course in 10th grade. There is still **no post-AP CS course**. That is a real gap next to the depth in maths and science.
strings.t: Kou ki pi wo a se AP Computer Science A. **AP Computer Science Principles** antre an 2026–27 kòm yon kou kòmansman nan 10yèm ane. Toujou **pa gen okenn kou CS apre AP**. Sa se yon vrè mank bò kote pwofondè matematik ak syans yo.

strings.text: The ceiling is AP or IB HL across Chinese, French, Spanish and Latin. No post-AP language seminar is listed, and German has dropped out of the roster since 2015–16.
strings.t: Plafon an se AP oswa IB HL atravè Chinwa, Franse, Panyòl ak Laten. Pa gen okenn seminè lang pòs-AP ki liste, epi Alman sòti nan lis la depi 2015–16.

strings.text: **School Year Abroad** (France, Spain, Italy), **Maine Coast Semester at Chewonki**, and **ALZAR** (Patagonia and Idaho) all carry credit back to the transcript. There is no Global Online Academy membership.
strings.t: **School Year Abroad** (Frans, Espay, Itali), **Maine Coast Semester at Chewonki**, ak **ALZAR** (Patagoni ak Idaho) tout pote kredi tounen sou relve nòt la. Pa gen manbraj Global Online Academy.

strings.text: Weighted on a flat bump
strings.t: Ak pwa sou yon ogmantasyon fiks

strings.text: **+0.5 for Honors, +1.0 for AP/IB** on a 4.0 base. Every profile edition reviewed uses this same scale. The 2026–27 edition also gives the +1.0 to the post-AP Organic Chemistry and Calculus III. There is no separate quality-point table.
strings.t: **+0.5 pou Honors, +1.0 pou AP/IB** sou yon baz 4.0. Chak edisyon pwofil nou egzamine itilize menm echèl sa a. Edisyon 2026–27 la bay +1.0 a tou pou Organic Chemistry ak Calculus III ki vini apre AP. Pa gen okenn tab pwen kalite apa.

strings.text: Country Day has published a quintile table (a split of the class into fifths) every year since at least 2015–16. The 2025–26 edition tied each fifth to a median SAT and ACT score. The 2026–27 edition goes back to **GPA medians alone**. Beside them it prints a **whole-class SAT/ACT middle 50%**.
strings.t: Country Day pibliye yon tab senkyèm (klas la divize an senk pati) chak ane depi omwen 2015–16. Edisyon 2025–26 la te makonnen chak senkyèm ak yon nòt SAT ak ACT medyàn. Edisyon 2026–27 la retounen nan **medyàn GPA sèlman**. Bò kote yo, li enprime yon **mitan 50% SAT/ACT pou tout klas la**.

strings.text: “Most rigorous” shown, not defined
strings.t: “Pi rijid la” montre, men yo pa defini l

strings.text: There is no number-based rubric. Instead, a **“Notably Rigorous Courses by Discipline”** table names the top course in each subject. The profile also sorts seniors into AP-load groups: 0–2 / 3–5 / 6–8 / 9+ (Class of 2027: 22 / 22 / 39 / 14 of the 97 non-IB seniors with seven-plus semesters). These let a reader place a student among classmates.
strings.t: Pa gen griy ki baze sou chif. Olye de sa, yon tab **“Notably Rigorous Courses by Discipline”** nonmen kou ki pi wo a nan chak matyè. Pwofil la klase elèv dènye ane yo tou pa gwoup chaj AP: 0–2 / 3–5 / 6–8 / 9+ (Klas 2027: 22 / 22 / 39 / 14 nan 97 elèv dènye ane ki pa nan IB ki gen sèt semès oswa plis). Sa pèmèt yon moun k ap li plase yon elèv pami kanmarad klas li.

strings.text: Standard means college-prep
strings.t: Standard vle di preparasyon pou kolèj

strings.text: Every course that is not Honors, AP or IB is labelled **“Regular/Standard”** on transcripts and STARS forms. The profile says every course is college-prep in difficulty. AP is closed to 9th graders. 10th graders generally take only AP Human Geography and AP Computer Science Principles.
strings.t: Chak kou ki pa Honors, AP oswa IB make **“Regular/Standard”** sou relve nòt yo ak fòm STARS yo. Pwofil la di chak kou gen nivo difikilte preparasyon pou kolèj. AP fèmen pou elèv 9yèm ane. Elèv 10yèm ane jeneralman pran sèlman AP Human Geography ak AP Computer Science Principles.

strings.text: No mandatory-AP-exam policy is published, so the 96% rests on an unstated denominator. The curriculum page says the exam “is the driver for the curriculum”, which implies a strong expectation but is not a stated requirement. AP Scholar counts have not been published since 2021.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn politik egzamen AP obligatwa ki pibliye, kidonk 96% la chita sou yon baz kalkil ki pa deklare. Paj kourikoulòm nan di egzamen an “se sa k ap kondwi kourikoulòm nan”, sa ki sijere yon gwo atant men se pa yon kondisyon ki deklare. Kantite AP Scholar pa pibliye depi 2021.

strings.text: The 26 AP is the profile’s own count: its rigorous-courses table prints 25 AP titles, with AP US and Comparative Government on one line. The Course Offerings catalogue (2025–26, the latest posted) holds 23; no 2026–27 catalogue was posted as of 2026-11-07.
strings.t: 26 AP a se pwòp kantite pwofil la: tab kou rigoure li a enprime 25 tit AP, ak AP US ak Comparative Government sou yon sèl liy. Katalòg Course Offerings la (2025–26, dènye ki afiche a) gen 23; pa t gen okenn katalòg 2026–27 ki afiche nan dat 2026-11-07.

strings.text: Five full-time counselors for 536 Upper Schoolers — roughly 27 seniors each — with more than 100 years of combined admissions experience between them.
strings.t: Senk konseye aplentan pou 536 elèv Upper School — apeprè 27 elèv dènye ane chak — ak plis pase 100 ane eksperyans nan admisyon konbine ant yo.

strings.text: The office changed directors in July 2026, and the 2026–27 profile is the first edition to show the new office. But the office still holds a decade of experience. Two of the five have worked there since at least 2015–16.
strings.t: Biwo a te chanje direktè nan jiyè 2026, epi pwofil 2026–27 la se premye edisyon ki montre nouvo biwo a. Men biwo a toujou gen yon deseni eksperyans. De nan senk yo travay la depi omwen 2015–16.

strings.t: konseye pou elèv dènye ane (derive — 137 ÷ 5; lekòl la pa pibliye okenn rapò)

strings.text: full-time college counselors, plus a registrar
strings.t: konseye inivèsite aplentan, plis yon anrejistrè

strings.text: college admissions officers hosted each year
strings.t: ofisye admisyon inivèsite yo resevwa chak ane

strings.text: platform for students and for rep-visit scheduling

strings.text: Both ratios are derived (536 ÷ 5 and 137 ÷ 5, from the 2026–27 profile); the school publishes no ratio. The real caseload is probably juniors plus seniors, nearer 1:54. The counseling page’s intro says “four full-time college counselors”, while that page and the profile both list five. No counselor bios, tenures, degrees or prior employers are published — the team page gives names, titles and contact details only.
strings.t: Tou de rapò yo derive (536 ÷ 5 ak 137 ÷ 5, nan pwofil 2026–27 la); lekòl la pa pibliye okenn rapò. Vrè chay la se pwobableman elèv twazyèm ane plis dènye ane, pi pre 1:54. Entwodiksyon paj konsèy la di “kat konseye kolèj aplentan”, alòske menm paj sa a ak pwofil la tou de bay lis senk. Pa gen okenn byografi konseye, ansyènte, diplòm oswa ansyen patwon ki pibliye — paj ekip la bay non, tit ak enfòmasyon kontak sèlman.

strings.text: No count of campus visits made by counseling staff is published anywhere, and no named scholarship-search tool or database is described.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kantite vizit sou kanpis estaf konsèy la fè ki pibliye okenn kote, epi yo pa dekri okenn zouti oswa baz done rechèch bous ki gen non.

strings.text: Treat the “34 Morehead-Cain recipients” figure with care. The College Counseling main page shows it next to Class of 2026 numbers. But the Class of 2026 had exactly one Morehead-Cain Scholar. The 34 is an all-time total, and the school never says what years it covers. Robertson Scholars and NC State Park Scholars appear only in the 2015–16 profile. They should not be shown as awards students win today.
strings.t: Trete chif “34 moun ki resevwa Morehead-Cain” la avèk atansyon. Paj prensipal College Counseling la montre l bò kote chif Klas 2026. Men Klas 2026 la te gen egzakteman yon sèl Morehead-Cain Scholar. 34 la se yon total pou tout tan, epi lekòl la pa janm di ki ane li kouvri. Robertson Scholars ak NC State Park Scholars parèt sèlman nan pwofil 2015–16 la. Yo pa dwe prezante kòm prim elèv yo genyen jodi a.

strings.text: Bold read from the font runs of both 2023–2026 editions: the May edition (5/28/2026) and the final edition each carry 69 bold names. Lafayette lost bold in the final edition; Central Piedmont and Wesleyan gained it; Northeastern is bold in both. The earlier Yale marker was a transcription slip — Yale is bold in neither edition. The school’s “70 institutions” enrolling figure is one more than either edition’s 69 bold names.
strings.t: Nou li gra a nan seri polis tou de edisyon 2023–2026 yo: edisyon me a (5/28/2026) ak edisyon final la chak gen 69 non an gra. Lafayette pèdi gra a nan edisyon final la; Central Piedmont ak Wesleyan jwenn li; Northeastern an gra nan tou de. Ansyen mak Yale la se te yon erè transkripsyon — Yale pa an gra nan okenn edisyon. Chif “70 enstitisyon” lekòl la bay pou enskripsyon an se youn plis pase 69 non an gra nenpòt nan de edisyon yo.

strings.text: States: the 2026–27 profile says the Class of 2026 is in 24 states, DC and Canada; the Class of 2026 page (May 2026) says 23. The profile is the later document and is used.
strings.t: Eta: pwofil 2026–27 la di Klas 2026 la nan 24 eta, DC ak Kanada; paj Klas 2026 la (me 2026) di 23. Pwofil la se dokiman ki pi resan an epi se li yo itilize.

strings.text: The IB Diploma is what sets the school apart: a second route to the hardest course load. And the Senior Externship turns 175+ local employers into a network only this school has.
strings.t: Diplòm IB la se sa ki fè lekòl la diferan: yon dezyèm wout pou rive nan chaj kou ki pi difisil la. Epi Senior Externship la fè 175+ patwon lokal vin yon rezo se sèlman lekòl sa a ki genyen.

strings.text: What Country Day does not have is a required capstone or research thesis; its spike-building is programme breadth rather than a single mandated credential.
strings.t: Sa Country Day pa genyen se yon kapston oswa yon tèz rechèch obligatwa; konstriksyon espesyalite li se etandi pwogram olye ke yon sèl kalifikasyon obligatwa.

strings.text: **IB Diploma Programme** — Country Day was the **first school in North Carolina** to offer it. **26 seniors in the Class of 2027** take the full diploma from junior year. Its five-year pass rate is 88%. For a student whose strengths do not fit the AP model, it is a second clear path to the hardest course load. It also has an Extended Essay built in.
strings.t: **IB Diploma Programme** — Country Day se te **premye lekòl nan North Carolina** ki te ofri l. **26 elèv dènye ane nan Klas 2027 la** pran diplòm konplè a apati ane jinyò. To reyisit li sou senk ane se 88%. Pou yon elèv ki gen fòs ki pa koresponn ak modèl AP a, se yon dezyèm wout klè pou rive nan chaj kou ki pi difisil la. Li gen yon Extended Essay ladan l tou.

strings.text: **Senior Externship** — a January job-shadowing program that started in 2017. It works with **175+ local employers across 20+ industries**. In a recent year **136 seniors** were placed with 68 Charlotte-area employers. Most hosts were current and past parents and alumni.
strings.t: **Senior Externship** — yon pwogram swiv travay nan janvye ki te kòmanse an 2017. Li travay ak **175+ patwon lokal atravè 20+ endistri**. Nan yon ane resan, **136 elèv dènye ane** te plase ak 68 patwon nan zòn Charlotte. Pifò moun ki te resevwa yo se te paran aktyèl ak ansyen paran ak ansyen elèv.

strings.text: **Science Outreach Program** — rising juniors and seniors work with science professors at local institutions on primary research over the summer, then present at the annual Science Symposium.
strings.t: **Science Outreach Program** — elèv k ap antre nan twazyèm ak dènye ane travay ak pwofesè syans nan enstitisyon lokal sou rechèch prensipal pandan ete a, apre sa yo prezante nan Science Symposium anyèl la.

strings.text: **Weddington Farm** — a **330-acre living classroom** with crops, farm animals, beekeeping, mushroom farming and a ten-mile trail system. It is used for lessons in green farming, ecology and starting a business. Few city private schools have anything like it.
strings.t: **Weddington Farm** — yon **sal klas vivan 330 kawo tè** ak rekòt, bèt fèm, apikilti, kilti djondjon ak yon sistèm santye dis mil. Yo itilize l pou leson sou agrikilti dirab, ekoloji ak kòmanse yon biznis. Gen kèk lekòl prive nan vil ki gen yon bagay konsa.

strings.text: **Special Olympics Mecklenburg County Spring Games** — the Upper School has paused classes for two days every April **since 1984** to host them. To an admissions office, a 40-year commitment by the whole school reads very differently than a service club.
strings.t: **Special Olympics Mecklenburg County Spring Games** — Upper School la kanpe klas pandan de jou chak avril **depi 1984** pou resevwa yo. Pou yon biwo admisyon, yon angajman 40 ane tout lekòl la li byen diferan pase yon klib sèvis.

strings.text: There is no required internship, capstone or independent research thesis. The Senior Externship is a single day, and the school never says it is required. Still, 136 of ~141 seniors took part, which suggests nearly every senior does it in practice.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn estaj, kapston oswa tèz rechèch endepandan obligatwa. Senior Externship la se yon sèl jou, epi lekòl la pa janm di li obligatwa. Sepandan, 136 nan ~141 elèv dènye ane te patisipe, sa ki sijere prèske chak elèv dènye ane fè l an pratik.

strings.text: **The School Profile as an instrument** — the 2026–27 edition names the top course in every subject. It states the weighting formula. It shows AP results by subject, including the low end (Fine Arts at 91%/61%). Its AP-load groups grew to four. It dropped the 2025–26 edition’s test medians for each fifth, but it brought back a whole-class SAT/ACT middle 50%. That openness itself builds trust.
strings.t: **School Profile la kòm yon zouti** — edisyon 2026–27 la nonmen kou ki pi wo a nan chak matyè. Li bay fòmil pwa a. Li montre rezilta AP pa matyè, ki enkli bout ki pi ba a (Fine Arts nan 91%/61%). Gwoup chaj AP li yo vin kat. Li retire medyàn tès pou chak senkyèm edisyon 2025–26 la te bay, men li remete yon mitan 50% SAT/ACT pou tout klas la. Ouvèti sa a li menm bati konfyans.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — an Honor Code students pledge every year, a student-run Honor Council, and membership in ACCIS, NACAC and SACAC. Signs of strong teachers matter here too. The Upper School’s **83 teaching and administrative staff** include **AP exam readers**, National Board graders and Klingenstein Fellows. 82% hold advanced degrees, and 100% take part in teacher training each year.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — yon Kòd Onè elèv yo pran angajman pou li chak ane, yon Honor Council elèv yo dirije, ak manbraj nan ACCIS, NACAC ak SACAC. Siy pwofesè solid enpòtan isit la tou. **83 manm pèsonèl ansèyman ak administrasyon** Upper School la enkli **moun k ap korije egzamen AP**, korektè National Board ak Klingenstein Fellows. 82% genyen diplòm avanse, epi 100% patisipe nan fòmasyon pwofesè chak ane.

strings.text: **A dominant UNC–Chapel Hill pipeline** — 32 Class of 2026 students enrolled there, 23% of the class. The school also counts 34 Morehead-Cain recipients all-time. Add a lasting Jefferson Scholar link to UVA and a decade of service-academy appointments.
strings.t: **Yon rezo UNC–Chapel Hill ki domine** — 32 elèv Klas 2026 te enskri la, 23% nan klas la. Lekòl la konte tou 34 moun ki resevwa Morehead-Cain pou tout tan. Ajoute yon lyen Jefferson Scholar dirab ak UVA ak yon deseni nominasyon nan akademi sèvis.

strings.text: **A substantial HBCU pipeline** — North Carolina A&T, Howard, Hampton and Clark Atlanta all enrolled Class of 2026 students. The list holds 19 HBCUs (historically Black colleges and universities), with Claflin new. Recent awards include a February One Scholarship and a Ron Brown Scholar.
strings.t: **Yon gwo rezo HBCU** — North Carolina A&T, Howard, Hampton ak Clark Atlanta tout te gen elèv Klas 2026 ki enskri. Lis la gen 19 HBCU (kolèj ak inivèsite istorikman Nwa), ak Claflin ki nouvo. Prim resan yo enkli yon February One Scholarship ak yon Ron Brown Scholar.

strings.text: The school does not publish its policy on reporting discipline. That policy would say whether, and how, Honor Council findings or suspensions reach the secondary school report (the form the school sends to colleges). The school lists NACAC membership, so this gap is a sharp question to ask on a tour.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye politik li sou rapò disiplin. Politik sa a ta di si, ak kijan, konklizyon Honor Council oswa sispansyon rive nan rapò lekòl segondè a (fòm lekòl la voye bay inivèsite yo). Lekòl la bay manbraj NACAC li, kidonk mank sa a se yon kesyon file pou poze pandan yon vizit.

strings.text: The quintile table gives the honest answer for the middle of the class. The fourth fifth has a 3.655 median GPA, and the bottom fifth 3.012. The whole-class middle 50% is a 1170–1400 SAT.
strings.t: Tab senkyèm nan bay repons onèt la pou mitan klas la. Katriyèm senkyèm nan gen yon GPA medyàn 3.655, epi senkyèm ki anba a 3.012. Mitan 50% tout klas la se yon SAT 1170–1400.

strings.text: Country Day publishes what most schools hide. Its acceptance list shows the same spread: Harvard, Princeton and MIT at one end, and Cape Fear and Central Piedmont community colleges at the other.
strings.t: Country Day pibliye sa pifò lekòl kache. Lis aksepte li a montre menm diferans lan: Harvard, Princeton ak MIT nan yon bout, ak inivèsite kominotè Cape Fear ak Central Piedmont nan lòt bout la.

strings.text: — Class of 2027 · middle 50% printed in the 2026–27 profile beside the Class of 2027 GPA table
strings.t: — Klas 2027 · mitan 50% ki enprime nan pwofil 2026–27 la bò kote tab GPA Klas 2027 la

strings.text: The middle-50% endpoints are the 25th and 75th percentiles; the 10th, 50th and 90th are shown as “—” because the school has never published them, nor a mean. Section scores were last published for the Class of 2024 (EBRW 585–700, Math 590–690); the number of testers never. The 2025–26 edition had dropped the whole-class range for per-fifth medians; the 2026–27 edition restores it without naming the class.
strings.t: Bout mitan-50% yo se 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantaj yo; 10yèm, 50yèm ak 90yèm yo montre kòm “—” paske lekòl la pa janm pibliye yo, ni yon mwayèn. Nòt pa seksyon yo te pibliye pou dènye fwa pou Klas 2024 la (EBRW 585–700, Math 590–690); kantite moun ki pase tès, janm. Edisyon 2025–26 la te ranplase ranje tout klas la ak medyàn pa senkyèm; edisyon 2026–27 la remete l san li pa nonmen klas la.

strings.text: English 23–32 and Math 22–29 were last published for the Class of 2024, whose composite was 24–31; the Class of 2015’s was 26–31, so the floor is back where it was a decade ago.
strings.t: English 23–32 ak Math 22–29 te pibliye pou dènye fwa pou Klas 2024 la, ki te gen yon konpozit 24–31; pa Klas 2015 la se te 26–31, kidonk planche a retounen kote l te ye sa gen yon deseni.

strings.text: — the no-rank mechanism · Class of 2027 median weighted GPA (120 of 137 seniors with seven-plus semesters at the school)
strings.t: — mekanis san ran an · GPA ak pwa medyàn Klas 2027 la (120 nan 137 elèv dènye ane ki gen sèt semès oswa plis nan lekòl la)

strings.text: All five quintiles are the school’s own published figures — nothing is interpolated. Grades reflect work done at Country Day only, as of the end of junior year, for students with at least seven semesters at the school. The 2025–26 edition tied each fifth to a median SAT and ACT for the Class of 2025 (4.472/1470/33 down to 2.991/1110/24); the 2026–27 edition drops that pairing. Over ten years the distribution has stretched at both ends: the top-quintile mean rose from 4.198 to 4.540 while the bottom-quintile floor fell from 2.546 to 2.076.
strings.t: Tout senk senkyèm yo se pwòp chif lekòl la pibliye — pa gen anyen ki entèpole. Nòt yo reflete travay ki fèt nan Country Day sèlman, dapre fen twazyèm ane a, pou elèv ki gen omwen sèt semès nan lekòl la. Edisyon 2025–26 la te makonnen chak senkyèm ak yon SAT ak yon ACT medyàn pou Klas 2025 la (soti 4.472/1470/33 desann rive 2.991/1110/24); edisyon 2026–27 la abandone makonnen sa a. Sou dis ane distribisyon an lonje nan tou de bout: mwayèn senkyèm anwo a te monte soti 4.198 rive 4.540 pandan planche senkyèm anba a te tonbe soti 2.546 rive 2.076.

strings.text: The Educational Resource Program
strings.t: Educational Resource Program nan

strings.text: A named JK–12 structure covering tutoring, accommodations, assessments and evaluation referrals, delivered as hourly sessions before, during or after the school day.
strings.t: Yon estrikti JK–12 ki gen non ki kouvri titora, akomodasyon, evalyasyon ak referans pou evalyasyon, ki bay kòm sesyon pa èdtan anvan, pandan oswa apre jounen lekòl la.

strings.text: The Upper School model
strings.t: Modèl Upper School la

strings.text: **Academic coaches** help with subjects and with planning, organizing and focus skills. **Learning specialists** work one-on-one so students “recognize and utilize their strengths”. The goal is for students to learn on their own and speak up for themselves.
strings.t: **Antrenè akademik** ede ak matyè yo ak ak konpetans planifikasyon, òganizasyon ak konsantrasyon. **Espesyalis aprantisaj** travay youn a youn pou elèv yo “rekonèt epi sèvi ak fòs yo”. Objektif la se pou elèv yo aprann pou kont yo epi pale pou tèt yo.

strings.text: Where it reaches the application
strings.t: Kote li rive nan aplikasyon an

strings.text: Uniquely among the schools here, the ERP explicitly **“assists in requesting accommodations with the College Board, ACT, and IB”** — the hand-off into admissions testing is stated rather than left implicit.
strings.t: Inikman pami lekòl isit yo, ERP la eksplisitman **“ede nan mande akomodasyon nan College Board, ACT, ak IB”** — pasaj la nan tès admisyon an deklare olye ke kite l enplisit.

strings.text: The colleges where students enrolled are not just a top-25 highlight reel. Appalachian State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, High Point, Queens, Liberty, Tampa, Mississippi, Kentucky and Southwest Minnesota State all appear. **55% of the Class of 2026 enrolled at public universities**, and 32% stayed in North Carolina.
strings.t: Kolèj kote elèv yo enskri yo se pa sèlman yon lis top-25 pou fè bèl. Appalachian State, East Carolina, UNC–Charlotte, High Point, Queens, Liberty, Tampa, Mississippi, Kentucky ak Southwest Minnesota State tout parèt. **55% nan Klas 2026 la te enskri nan inivèsite piblik**, epi 32% te rete nan North Carolina.

strings.text: Community colleges published
strings.t: Inivèsite kominotè ki pibliye

strings.text: Cape Fear and Central Piedmont both appear on the acceptance list. Many peer schools quietly omit their community-college acceptances; publishing them is a meaningful transparency signal.
strings.t: Cape Fear ak Central Piedmont tou de parèt sou lis aksepte a. Anpil lekòl parèy kite aksepte nan inivèsite kominotè yo deyò an silans; pibliye yo se yon siy transparans enpòtan.

strings.text: There are about eighteen arts and music schools, and Berklee is one where a student enrolled. The list also has CalArts, Cooper Union, Ringling, Oberlin Conservatory, Manhattan School of Music, RISD, Pratt and SAIC. It has Parsons in New York and Paris, and UNCSA. All three federal service academies appear, with a Naval Academy appointment. There are also around twenty-one international universities. They include Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, UCL, McGill, Trinity College Dublin, Toronto, St Andrews, Edinburgh and Durham.
strings.t: Gen anviwon dizwit lekòl atizay ak mizik, epi Berklee se youn kote yon elèv te enskri. Lis la gen tou CalArts, Cooper Union, Ringling, Oberlin Conservatory, Manhattan School of Music, RISD, Pratt ak SAIC. Li gen Parsons nan New York ak Pari, ak UNCSA. Tout twa akademi sèvis federal yo parèt, ak yon nominasyon nan Naval Academy. Genyen tou anviwon venteyen inivèsite entènasyonal. Ladan yo gen Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, UCL, McGill, Trinity College Dublin, Toronto, St Andrews, Edinburgh ak Durham.

strings.text: The 2026–27 profile brings back a whole-class SAT and ACT middle 50%. But it does not say which class it covers or how many students took the tests. It also drops the 2025–26 edition’s medians for each fifth. The number of test-takers has never been published in any year. A range without a count shows a shape, but not how many students stand behind it.
strings.t: Pwofil 2026–27 la remete yon mitan 50% SAT ak ACT pou tout klas la. Men li pa di ki klas li kouvri ni konbyen elèv ki te pase tès yo. Li retire tou medyàn pou chak senkyèm edisyon 2025–26 la te bay. Kantite moun ki pase tès pa janm pibliye nan okenn ane. Yon ranje san kantite montre yon fòm, men li pa montre konbyen elèv ki dèyè l.

strings.text: No gap-year counselling, placement count or deferral policy is published, and neither is any direct-to-work or enlistment outcome.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn konsèy, kantite plasman oswa politik sou ane apre diplòm ki pibliye, epi pa gen okenn rezilta sou ale dirèk nan travay oswa nan lame non plis.

strings.text: A deep, stable office and an unusually open profile. Country Day gives admissions readers more useful context than almost any peer school. The 2026–27 edition also brings back the whole-class SAT and ACT ranges it had dropped.
strings.t: Yon biwo solid ak estab ak yon pwofil ki ouvè yon fason ki pa abityèl. Country Day bay moun k ap li nan admisyon plis kontèks itil pase prèske nenpòt lekòl parèy. Edisyon 2026–27 la remete tou ranje SAT ak ACT tout klas la li te retire yo.

strings.text: The strengths are structural and durable; the gaps are disclosure choices, which is exactly what a tour can put pressure on.
strings.t: Fòs yo estriktirèl epi dirab; mank yo se chwa nan divilgasyon, sa ki se egzakteman sa yon vizit ka peze sou li.

strings.text: The profile gives readers more context than peers
strings.t: Pwofil la bay moun k ap li plis kontèks pase lekòl parèy

strings.text: a quintile table of Class of 2027 median GPAs from 4.516 down to 3.012, with a 1170–1400 SAT and 26–31 ACT middle 50% printed beside it. No rank is ever assigned, yet a reader can place any candidate precisely — though the 2025–26 edition’s per-fifth test medians are gone.
strings.t: yon tab senkyèm medyàn GPA Klas 2027 la soti 4.516 desann rive 3.012, ak yon mitan 50% SAT 1170–1400 ak ACT 26–31 ki enprime bò kote l. Yo pa janm bay okenn ran, poutan yon moun k ap li ka plase nenpòt kandida avèk presizyon — byenke medyàn tès pa senkyèm edisyon 2025–26 la disparèt.

strings.text: AP performance is high, improving and candidly disclosed
strings.t: Pèfòmans AP wo, k ap amelyore epi divilge fransman

strings.text: 589 exams at 96% scoring 3+ and 87% at 4–5, up from 530 at 93%/74% a year earlier — published discipline by discipline, Fine Arts at 91%/61% rather than hidden.
strings.t: 589 egzamen ak 96% ki fè 3+ ak 87% nan 4–5, monte soti 530 nan 93%/74% yon ane anvan — pibliye disiplin pa disiplin, Fine Arts nan 91%/61% olye ke kache l.

strings.text: The IB Diploma is a real structural differentiator
strings.t: Diplòm IB la se yon vrè diferans estriktirèl

strings.text: first in North Carolina to offer it, 26 full-diploma seniors in the Class of 2027, 88% five-year pass rate. It is a second clear path to the hardest course load for students whose strengths do not fit the AP model.
strings.t: premye nan North Carolina ki te ofri l, 26 elèv dènye ane nan diplòm konplè a nan Klas 2027 la, to reyisit 88% sou senk ane. Se yon dezyèm wout klè pou rive nan chaj kou ki pi difisil la pou elèv ki gen fòs ki pa koresponn ak modèl AP a.

strings.text: The office is deep and stable through a director change
strings.t: Biwo a pwofon epi estab malgre yon chanjman direktè

strings.text: five counselors, 100+ years of combined experience, and 150+ college reps a year through a structured Scoir Visits programme. The July 2026 change has happened. Allison Slater Tate leads, and Catherine Odum, in the office for a decade-plus, is Senior Associate. So the new leaders build on long experience, not a blank slate.
strings.t: senk konseye, 100+ ane eksperyans konbine, ak 150+ reprezantan inivèsite pa ane atravè yon pwogram Scoir Visits estriktire. Chanjman jiyè 2026 la fèt. Allison Slater Tate ap dirije, epi Catherine Odum, ki nan biwo a depi plis pase yon deseni, se Senior Associate. Kidonk nouvo lidè yo bati sou yon long eksperyans, se pa sou yon paj vid.

strings.text: The timeline starts genuinely early
strings.t: Kalandriye a kòmanse vrèman bonè

strings.text: Freshman Seminar and Scoir in 9th grade. PreACT and the Charlotte Area Case Studies mock committee in 10th. One-on-one meetings from the second semester of junior year. An essay workshop in August before senior year.
strings.t: Freshman Seminar ak Scoir nan 9yèm ane. PreACT ak komite similye Charlotte Area Case Studies nan 10yèm. Reyinyon youn a youn apati dezyèm semès ane jinyò. Yon atelye redaksyon nan out anvan dènye ane a.

strings.text: The outcomes are honest across the whole distribution
strings.t: Rezilta yo onèt atravè tout distribisyon an

strings.text: 70 destinations for 141 seniors across 24 states, DC and Canada, 55% public and 45% private. Community colleges are listed alongside Princeton and MIT. 32 students enrolled at UNC–Chapel Hill. And a substantial HBCU pipeline, with students enrolling at four of them.
strings.t: 70 destinasyon pou 141 elèv dènye ane atravè 24 eta, DC ak Kanada, 55% piblik ak 45% prive. Inivèsite kominotè parèt sou lis la ansanm ak Princeton ak MIT. 32 elèv te enskri nan UNC–Chapel Hill. Epi yon gwo rezo HBCU, ak elèv ki enskri nan kat ladan yo.

strings.text: Your 2026–27 profile prints a 1170–1400 SAT and 26–31 ACT middle 50% beside the Class of 2027 GPA table. Which class and how many test-takers does that cover? And why were the medians for each fifth dropped?
strings.t: Pwofil 2026–27 ou a enprime yon mitan 50% SAT 1170–1400 ak ACT 26–31 bò kote tab GPA Klas 2027 la. Ki klas ak konbyen moun ki pase tès sa kouvri? Epi poukisa medyàn pou chak senkyèm yo te retire?

strings.text: The Class of 2025 had 2 National Merit Semifinalists where the classes either side had 7 and 6. What happened that year?
strings.t: Klas 2025 la te gen 2 Semifinalis National Merit kote klas ki toutbò l yo te gen 7 ak 6. Kisa ki te pase ane sa a?

strings.text: Harvard appears on the 2023–2026 list for the first time in the final edition, and still no Class of 2026 student enrolled at an Ivy. How do you read that, and what does Ivy enrollment look like year over year?
strings.t: Harvard parèt sou lis 2023–2026 la pou premye fwa nan edisyon final la, epi toujou okenn elèv Klas 2026 pa t enskri nan yon Ivy. Kijan ou li sa, epi kijan enskripsyon nan Ivy ye ane apre ane?

strings.text: What exactly does the “34 Morehead-Cain recipients” figure cover — how many years? The Class of 2026 post names exactly one.
strings.t: Kisa egzakteman chif “34 moun ki resevwa Morehead-Cain” la kouvri — konbyen ane? Piblikasyon Klas 2026 la nonmen egzakteman youn.

strings.text: How many learning specialists and academic coaches work with Upper School students, what are their credentials, and what is the caseload?
strings.t: Konbyen espesyalis aprantisaj ak antrenè akademik k ap travay ak elèv Upper School, ki kalifikasyon yo, epi ki chay la?

strings.text: How do you report Honor Council findings and disciplinary actions on the secondary school report?
strings.t: Kijan ou rapòte konklizyon Honor Council ak aksyon disiplinè sou rapò lekòl segondè a?

strings.text: How many colleges do your counselors visit each year, is the Senior Externship required, and what gap-year, post-AP computer science, or capstone-research options exist?
strings.t: Konbyen inivèsite konseye ou yo vizite chak ane, èske Senior Externship la obligatwa, epi ki opsyon ki egziste pou ane apre diplòm, syans enfòmatik pòs-AP, oswa rechèch kapston?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Cannon School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 60.8% over the last five entering classes — 479 acceptances from 788 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Cannon School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 60.8% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 479 admisyon sou 788 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 31.7% in Fall 2025 — 20 of 63 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 31.7% nan otòn 2025 — 20 sou 63 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: Cannon publishes something almost no peer does — an explicit maximum AP/AT load by grade, capping a four-year transcript at twelve advanced courses and barring freshmen entirely.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bagay prèske okenn lekòl parèy pa fè — yon chay maksimòm AP/AT eksplisit pa nivo, ki limite yon relve nòt kat ane a douz kou avanse epi ki entèdi elèv premye ane nèt.

strings.text: That ceiling is the key to reading a Cannon transcript. Here, “most rigorous” has a hard, published limit. And the 90% scoring 3+ comes from students who chose to take an optional exam.
strings.t: Plafon sa a se kle pou li yon relve nòt Cannon. Isit la, “pi rijid la” gen yon limit fiks ki pibliye. Epi 90% ki fè 3+ la soti nan elèv ki te chwazi pase yon egzamen opsyonèl.

strings.text: The ceiling is now **AT: Mathematics & Calculus**, which the 2026–27 Course Catalog describes as a seminar for students who have completed AP Calculus BC. AP Precalculus also appears. No multivariable calculus or linear algebra course is published by name.
strings.t: Plafon an kounye a se **AT: Mathematics & Calculus**, ke Course Catalog 2026–27 la dekri kòm yon seminè pou elèv ki fin fè AP Calculus BC. AP Precalculus parèt tou. Pa gen okenn kou kalkil miltivaryab oswa aljèb lineyè ki pibliye pa non.

strings.text: **AP Computer Science plus AT: Principles of Computer Science & Coding**, still with no data-structures or post-AP course — thin relative to the rest of the advanced catalogue.
strings.t: **AP Computer Science plis AT: Principles of Computer Science & Coding**, toujou san okenn kou estrikti done oswa kou pòs-AP — mens parapò ak rès katalòg avanse a.

strings.t: **Kou AT lekòl la konsevwa** yo chita akote AP yo epi yo pote menm 1.0 pwen kalite a, plizyè san okenn egzamen College Board korespondan ditou — pa egzanp AT: Design Thinking for Entrepreneurship.

strings.text: **Zero Hour** runs Varsity Chorus and Varsity Orchestra, pass/fail, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday before school. **Summer Term** offers Geometry Acceleration pass/fail, and Honors Biology and Honors Chemistry for a grade. Summer courses are marked as Summer Term on the transcript. BIOREX is not offered in the summer section.
strings.t: **Zero Hour** la fè Varsity Chorus ak Varsity Orchestra, pase/echwe, lendi, mèkredi ak vandredi anvan lekòl. **Summer Term** la ofri Geometry Acceleration pase/echwe, ak Honors Biology ak Honors Chemistry pou yon nòt. Kou ete yo make kòm Summer Term sou relve nòt la. BIOREX pa ofri nan seksyon ete a.

strings.text: Weighted narrowly, and deliberately
strings.t: Ak pwa etwat, epi espre

strings.text: Three tiers: AT and AP courses carry **1.0 quality point**, **Honors Accelerated 0.5** (new for 2026–27), and Honors **none at all**. Both weighted and unweighted GPAs are calculated from Cannon coursework only.
strings.t: Twa nivo: kou AT ak AP pote **1.0 pwen kalite**, **Honors Accelerated 0.5** (nouvo pou 2026–27), epi Honors **pa gen anyen ditou**. Yo kalkile GPA ak pwa ak san pwa apati kou Cannon sèlman.

strings.text: No rank, and a modest ceiling
strings.t: Pa gen ran, ak yon plafon modès

strings.text: No rank, no decile or quintile table — but the narrow weighting plus the twelve-course cap means the weighted top decile tops out around **4.28**. Cannon does not produce inflated 4.9 GPAs, which needs context for readers used to heavier schemes.
strings.t: Pa gen ran, pa gen tab dizyèm oswa senkyèm — men pwa etwat la plis limit douz kou a vle di dizyèm anwo ak pwa a rive nan tèt otou **4.28**. Cannon pa pwodui GPA anfle 4.9, sa ki bezwen kontèks pou moun ki abitye ak sistèm pi lou.

strings.text: A key to the hardest courses in each subject
strings.t: Yon kle pou kou ki pi difisil yo nan chak matyè

strings.text: Bold entries in the profile’s course table mark the “most demanding coursework in that discipline per appropriate grade level”, so a reader can see the ceiling subject by subject rather than guessing.
strings.t: Antre an gra nan tab kou pwofil la make “kou ki pi egzijan nan disiplin sa a pou nivo ki apwopriye a”, kidonk yon moun k ap li ka wè plafon an matyè pa matyè olye ke devine.

strings.text: AP exams are OPTIONAL — “students in AT/AP classes have the option of sitting for the appropriate AP exam”. The 90.16% scoring 3+ therefore rests on a self-selected pool and is not directly comparable with schools that mandate the exam. The denominator is also undefined: the profile labels the figure “Students with Scores 3+” while giving both 195 students and 446 exams, so whether it is a share of students or of exams is not stated.
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo OPSYONÈL — “elèv nan klas AT/AP gen opsyon pou pase egzamen AP ki apwopriye a”. 90.16% ki fè 3+ la kidonk chita sou yon gwoup ki chwazi tèt li epi li pa dirèkteman konparab ak lekòl ki egzije egzamen an. Baz kalkil la pa defini tou: pwofil la rele chif la “Students with Scores 3+” pandan li bay ni 195 elèv ni 446 egzamen, kidonk li pa di si se yon pòsyon elèv oswa yon pòsyon egzamen.

strings.text: No National Merit ledger of any kind is published — no Semifinalist, Finalist or Commended counts in any year, on any profile or in news posts. Repeated searches surfaced only a 2011 item naming a single Scholar. AP Scholar counts and the share scoring 4–5 are likewise unpublished; Cannon reports only the 3+ threshold.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn lis National Merit ditou ki pibliye — pa gen kantite Semifinalis, Finalis oswa Commended nan okenn ane, ni sou okenn pwofil ni nan piblikasyon nouvèl. Rechèch repete te bay sèlman yon atik 2011 ki nonmen yon sèl Scholar. Kantite AP Scholar ak pòsyon ki fè 4–5 la pa pibliye menm jan an; Cannon rapòte sèlman sèy 3+ la.

strings.text: Cannon promises something structural that most schools do not: a student keeps the same college counselor for all four years, rather than being handed off in junior year.
strings.t: Cannon pwomèt yon bagay estriktirèl pifò lekòl pa fè: yon elèv kenbe menm konseye inivèsite a pandan tout kat ane yo, olye ke yo pase l bay yon lòt nan twazyèm ane.

strings.text: Cannon’s differentiator is a set of course-embedded research experiences that end in a public defence — including one judged by an external committee of science professionals and business leaders.
strings.t: Sa ki fè Cannon diferan se yon seri eksperyans rechèch ki entegre nan kou yo ki fini nan yon defans piblik — ki enkli youn yon komite ekstèn pwofesyonèl syantifik ak lidè biznis jije.

strings.text: The spike here is built inside the curriculum rather than bolted on: take the course, and the defensible artefact is a requirement rather than an option.
strings.t: Espesyalite a bati anndan kourikoulòm nan olye ke kole sou li: pran kou a, epi rezilta ou ka defann nan se yon kondisyon olye ke yon opsyon.

strings.text: **BIOREX** — the Biological Research Experience, built into Honors Biology. Students form a hypothesis, test it and analyse the results with statistics. Then they present to a committee of **faculty, science professionals and local business leaders**. Outside judges are what set this apart from a class project.
strings.t: **BIOREX** — Biological Research Experience la, ki fè pati Honors Biology. Elèv yo fòme yon ipotèz, teste l epi analize rezilta yo ak estatistik. Apre sa yo prezante bay yon komite **pwofesè, pwofesyonèl syantifik ak lidè biznis lokal**. Jij ki soti deyò yo se sa ki fè sa a diferan de yon pwojè klas.

strings.text: **Symposium and Portfolio Defense** — two projects. In the spring of junior year, students in AT: U.S. History defend an original history argument. Students in AT: American Language and Composition present a digital portfolio, built through many drafts.
strings.t: **Symposium ak Portfolio Defense** — de pwojè. Nan prentan ane jinyò a, elèv nan AT: U.S. History defann yon agiman istorik orijinal. Elèv nan AT: American Language and Composition prezante yon pòtfèy dijital, ki fèt atravè plizyè bouyon.

strings.text: **Independent Study** — petition-based, and unusually the student **co-develops the course content and the assessment rubric**, then produces an end-of-year artefact.
strings.t: **Independent Study** — baze sou demann, epi yon fason ki pa abityèl elèv la **ko-devlope kontni kou a ak rubrik evalyasyon an**, apre sa li pwodui yon rezilta nan fen ane a.

strings.text: **Senior Capstone** — a service project for a charitable cause. It ends with a public talk to faculty, staff, peers and community. It is the one thing nearly every senior does, though the school says plainly that service itself is not required to graduate.
strings.t: **Senior Capstone** — yon pwojè sèvis pou yon kòz charitab. Li fini ak yon prezantasyon piblik bay pwofesè, anplwaye, kanmarad ak kominote a. Se sèl bagay prèske chak elèv dènye ane fè, byenke lekòl la di klèman sèvis li menm pa obligatwa pou gradye.

strings.text: **Global Education Certificate** — the steps are fully spelled out. Students take World History I–II and three levels of a world language. They take a senior **Glocal Perspectives** course with a capstone essay and presentation. They also do at least two of three global experiences. It is awarded at Senior Night.
strings.t: **Global Education Certificate** — etap yo byen eksplike. Elèv yo pran World History I–II ak twa nivo yon lang etranje. Yo pran yon kou **Glocal Perspectives** nan dènye ane ak yon redaksyon kapston ak yon prezantasyon. Yo fè tou omwen de nan twa eksperyans mondyal. Yo bay li nan Senior Night.

strings.text: Entrepreneurship and Engineering are course tracks with real depth: Honors Design Thinking & Entrepreneurship Lab, Creative Design and Engineering I–III, and The Mill makerspace. But the school publishes no award or credential for either. So read them as tracks, not certificates. No required internship or externship programme is published.
strings.t: Antreprenarya ak Enjenyri se pis kou ki gen vrè pwofondè: Honors Design Thinking & Entrepreneurship Lab, Creative Design and Engineering I–III, ak makerspace The Mill. Men lekòl la pa pibliye okenn distenksyon oswa kalifikasyon pou ni youn ni lòt. Kidonk li yo kòm pis, se pa sètifika. Pa gen okenn pwogram estaj oswa externship obligatwa ki pibliye.

strings.text: **The profile publishes its own ceiling** — the most AP/AT courses allowed in each grade. A footnote says maths placement decides whether a student can reach that limit. Printing the cap protects students. They will not be judged against an unlimited course load they were never allowed to try.
strings.t: **Pwofil la pibliye pwòp plafon pa l** — kantite maksimòm kou AP/AT ki pèmèt nan chak nivo. Yon nòt anba paj di plasman matematik deside si yon elèv ka rive nan limit sa a. Enprime limit la pwoteje elèv yo. Yo p ap jije yo kont yon chaj kou san limit yo pa t janm gen dwa eseye.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — the office “reports out-of-school suspensions and expulsions through time of graduation to any colleges and universities that request this information”: a disclose-on-request posture consistent with current NACAC norms.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — biwo a “rapòte sispansyon deyò lekòl ak ekspilsyon jiska moman gradyasyon bay nenpòt inivèsite ak kolèj ki mande enfòmasyon sa a”: yon pozisyon divilge-sou-demann ki konsistan ak nòm NACAC aktyèl yo.

strings.text: **Institutional memberships** — **SAIS** accreditation; NAIS, NCAIS, CSEE, **ACCIS**, NACAC and SACAC; and a **National Honor Society** chapter awarded in 2025.
strings.t: **Manbraj enstitisyonèl** — akreditasyon **SAIS**; NAIS, NCAIS, CSEE, **ACCIS**, NACAC ak SACAC; ak yon chapit **National Honor Society** yo te akòde an 2025.

strings.text: **Hosting regional admissions traffic** — Cannon hosts the Lake Norman case-studies programme and fair. That brings visiting admissions officers to its own campus for a regional event. It does not only send its students out.
strings.t: **Resevwa trafik admisyon rejyonal** — Cannon se kote pwogram Lake Norman case-studies la ak fwa a fèt. Sa mennen ofisye admisyon k ap vizite sou pwòp kanpis li pou yon evènman rejyonal. Li pa sèlman voye elèv li yo deyò.

strings.text: Cannon publishes a top-10% band and a middle-50% band for both tests and both GPAs — a genuinely useful shape, reported in a format that is not percentiles.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bann top-10% ak yon bann mitan-50% pou tou de tès ak tou de GPA — yon fòm ki vrèman itil, rapòte nan yon fòma ki pa pousantaj.

strings.text: The most informative figure is the unweighted middle 50% of 3.76–3.94: the median Cannon student sits in the A-minus range before any weighting.
strings.t: Chif ki pi enfòmatif la se mitan 50% san pwa a ki se 3.76–3.94: elèv medyàn Cannon chita nan ranje A-mwens anvan okenn pwa.

strings.text: — Class of 2026 · number of testers not published
strings.t: — Klas 2026 · kantite moun ki pase tès pa pibliye

strings.text: Cannon publishes a middle-50% band and a top-10% band only. The middle-50% endpoints conventionally ARE the 25th and 75th percentiles, so those columns are real; the top-10% figure is shown in the 90th column as the floor of that band (1510–1560). No mean, median, section subscores, or tester counts are published for either test.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon bann mitan-50% ak yon bann top-10% sèlman. Bout mitan-50% yo konvansyonèlman SE 25yèm ak 75yèm pousantaj yo, kidonk kolòn sa yo reyèl; chif top-10% la montre nan kolòn 90yèm nan kòm planche bann sa a (1510–1560). Pa gen mwayèn, medyàn, sou-nòt seksyon, oswa kantite moun ki pase tès ki pibliye pou ni youn ni lòt tès.

strings.text: Same reporting format: the 90th column shows the floor of the published top-10% band (33–36). Without a tester count there is no way to tell what share of 105 seniors sat either exam, which materially limits how far these bands can be read.
strings.t: Menm fòma rapò: kolòn 90yèm nan montre planche bann top-10% ki pibliye a (33–36). San yon kantite moun ki pase tès pa gen okenn fason pou di ki pòsyon nan 105 elèv dènye ane yo ki te pase nenpòt nan de egzamen yo, sa ki limite materyèlman jiskaki kote ou ka li bann sa yo.

strings.text: GPA distribution
strings.t: Distribisyon GPA

strings.text: — Class of 2026, cumulative through grade 11 · transfers excluded
strings.t: — Klas 2026, kimilatif jiska nivo 11 · elèv transfè eskli

strings.text: Weighted · top 10%
strings.t: Ak pwa · top 10%

strings.text: a modest ceiling, by design
strings.t: yon plafon modès, espre

strings.t: Ak pwa · mitan 50%

strings.t: mitan klas la

strings.text: Unweighted · top 10%
strings.t: San pwa · top 10%

strings.t: ranje A
