strings.text: These are bands, not a quintile table (a split of the class into fifths). The school publishes no full quintile or decile breakdown, no median GPA and no count of students in each band. The weighted top is modest because of two limits: the 1.0-quality-point cap and the twelve-course AP/AT maximum. Publishing these limits counts in Cannon’s favour. But readers used to schools that add more weight will need that context. As printed, the weighted top-10% band (from 4.08) begins below the top of the middle 50% (4.11). The profile does not explain the overlap.
strings.t: Sa yo se bann, se pa yon tab senkyèm (klas la divize an senk pati). Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn dekoupaj senkyèm oswa dizyèm konplè, okenn GPA medyàn ni okenn kantite elèv pa bann. Tèt ak pwa a modès akoz de limit: plafon 1.0 pwen kalite a ak maksimòm douz kou AP/AT la. Pibliye limit sa yo konte an favè Cannon. Men moun k ap li ki abitye ak lekòl ki ajoute plis pwa ap bezwen kontèks sa a. Jan li enprime a, bann 10% anwo ak pwa a (soti 4.08) kòmanse anba tèt mitan 50% la (4.11). Pwofil la pa eksplike chevochman sa a.

strings.text: Two named Upper School learning-support staff
strings.t: De manm estaf sipò aprantisaj Upper School ki gen non

strings.text: **Michelle Donah**, Upper School Learning Specialist, and **Jennifer Ridenhour**, Upper School Dean of Academic Support. That is substantial staffing for 421 Upper School students. It is also some of the best-documented learning support of the schools on this site.
strings.t: **Michelle Donah**, espesyalis aprantisaj Upper School, ak **Jennifer Ridenhour**, dwayen sipò akademik Upper School. Sa se yon gwo estaf pou 421 elèv Upper School. Se tou pami sipò aprantisaj ki pi byen dokimante nan lekòl ki sou sit sa a.

strings.text: The student owns the plan
strings.t: Elèv la responsab plan an

strings.text: Students **actively participate in creating their own personalized learning plans** with specific accommodations. A formal team backs each plan. It is made up of the student, parents, teachers, the Assistant Head for Academics, the Student Dean, the Upper School Counselor and the advisor.
strings.t: Elèv yo **patisipe aktivman nan kreye pwòp plan aprantisaj pèsonalize pa yo** ak akomodasyon espesifik. Yon ekip fòmèl sipòte chak plan. Li fòme ak elèv la, paran yo, pwofesè yo, Assistant Head for Academics la, Student Dean an, Upper School Counselor la ak konseye a.

strings.text: For **juniors and seniors** the programme provides guidance on **requesting College Board and ACT testing accommodations** — the specific service that converts learning support into college-application support.
strings.t: Pou **elèv twazyèm ak dènye ane** pwogram nan bay konsèy sou **mande akomodasyon tès College Board ak ACT** — sèvis espesifik la ki konvèti sipò aprantisaj an sipò pou aplikasyon inivèsitè.

strings.text: The surrounding structure
strings.t: Estrikti ki toutbò a

strings.text: The **Academic Resource Center** for maths, writing, science and world languages; 1:1 **academic coaching** on planning, organizing and focus skills; and a peer-led **Academic Lab** that faculty oversee.
strings.t: **Academic Resource Center** la pou matematik, ekri, syans ak lang etranje; **antrènman akademik** 1:1 sou konpetans planifikasyon, òganizasyon ak konsantrasyon; ak yon **Academic Lab** kanmarad yo dirije epi pwofesè yo sipèvize.

strings.text: The list is printed honestly
strings.t: Lis la enprime onètman

strings.text: At one end of the acceptance list are MIT, Caltech, Stanford, Princeton and Yale. At the other are Rowan-Cabarrus, Cape Fear, Central Piedmont and Davidson-Davie community colleges. That end also includes Brevard, Barton, Catawba, Mars Hill, Wingate, Charleston Southern, Coastal Carolina, Lenoir-Rhyne, Queens, Western Carolina, UNC Pembroke and USC Beaufort. A school chasing prestige would leave these out. Cannon prints them, and it shows its 2% two-year figure rather than burying it.
strings.t: Nan yon bout lis aksepte a gen MIT, Caltech, Stanford, Princeton ak Yale. Nan lòt bout la gen inivèsite kominotè Rowan-Cabarrus, Cape Fear, Central Piedmont ak Davidson-Davie. Bout sa a gen tou Brevard, Barton, Catawba, Mars Hill, Wingate, Charleston Southern, Coastal Carolina, Lenoir-Rhyne, Queens, Western Carolina, UNC Pembroke ak USC Beaufort. Yon lekòl k ap kouri dèyè prestij ta kite sa yo deyò. Cannon enprime yo, epi li montre chif 2% de ane li a olye ke antere l.

strings.text: A design-weighted arts pathway
strings.t: Yon wout atistik ki panche vè konsepsyon

strings.text: Pratt, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, Ringling, FIT, FIDM, UNCSA and Emerson — deep and visual/design-weighted rather than music-conservatory-weighted, despite strong ensemble offerings.
strings.t: Pratt, Parsons, SAIC, SCAD, Ringling, FIT, FIDM, UNCSA ak Emerson — pwofon epi ki panche vè vizyèl/konsepsyon olye ke vè konsèvatwa mizik, malgre bon ofrann ansanm.

strings.text: Other non-traditional destinations
strings.t: Lòt destinasyon ki pa tradisyonèl

strings.text: International universities: St Andrews, Edinburgh, Aberdeen (a confirmed 2023 enrollment), Manchester, King’s College London and Trinity College Dublin. Also University College Dublin, The American University of Paris, McGill, Toronto, Montreal and Western. Service academies and the military: the Air Force, Naval and Coast Guard academies, The Citadel and VMI. Technical institutes: Caltech, Rose-Hulman, Stevens, Colorado School of Mines, RPI, WPI, Illinois Tech, RIT and Embry-Riddle. HBCUs (historically Black colleges and universities): Alabama A&M, Clark Atlanta, Elizabeth City State, Howard, NC A&T and NC Central. Also South Carolina State, Southern University and A&M, Spelman, West Virginia State and Winston-Salem State.
strings.t: Inivèsite entènasyonal: St Andrews, Edinburgh, Aberdeen (yon enskripsyon 2023 konfime), Manchester, King’s College London ak Trinity College Dublin. Genyen tou University College Dublin, The American University of Paris, McGill, Toronto, Montreal ak Western. Akademi sèvis ak lame a: akademi Air Force, Naval ak Coast Guard yo, The Citadel ak VMI. Enstiti teknik: Caltech, Rose-Hulman, Stevens, Colorado School of Mines, RPI, WPI, Illinois Tech, RIT ak Embry-Riddle. HBCU (kolèj ak inivèsite istorikman Nwa): Alabama A&M, Clark Atlanta, Elizabeth City State, Howard, NC A&T ak NC Central. Genyen tou South Carolina State, Southern University and A&M, Spelman, West Virginia State ak Winston-Salem State.

strings.text: A stable programme that is honest by design. Students keep the same counselor for all four years. It also has a published course-load ceiling, real research defences and a genuine list of where graduates enrolled. But it shares less about outcomes than its larger peers.
strings.t: Yon pwogram estab ki onèt nan fason li bati. Elèv yo kenbe menm konseye a pandan tout kat ane yo. Li gen tou yon plafon chaj kou ki pibliye, vrè defans rechèch ak yon vrè lis kote gradye yo te enskri. Men li pataje mwens sou rezilta pase pi gwo lekòl parèy li yo.

strings.text: Most of what is missing here is publication rather than practice, which makes almost every gap a question a tour can answer.
strings.t: Pifò nan sa ki manke isit la se piblikasyon olye ke pratik, sa ki fè prèske chak mank yon kesyon yon vizit ka reponn.

strings.text: Four-year counselor continuity, stated in writing
strings.t: Kontinwite konseye kat ane, deklare alekri

strings.text: students keep the same college counselor for all of Upper School, rather than being handed off in junior year. The roster also shows the same four directors across three published profiles (only the coordinator changed).
strings.t: elèv yo kenbe menm konseye inivèsite a pandan tout Upper School olye ke yo pase yo bay yon lòt nan ane jinyò. Lis la montre tou menm kat direktè yo atravè twa pwofil ki pibliye (se sèlman kowòdonatè a ki chanje).

strings.text: The course-load ceiling is disclosed, not implied
strings.t: Plafon chaj kou a divilge, se pa sijere

strings.text: a published maximum of 0/1/5/6 AP or AT courses by grade caps a transcript at twelve, so colleges read “most rigorous” against a limit the school itself states.
strings.t: yon maksimòm ki pibliye 0/1/5/6 kou AP oswa AT pa nivo limite yon relve nòt a douz, kidonk inivèsite yo li “pi rijid la” kont yon limit lekòl la li menm deklare.

strings.text: Research experiences with real external judging
strings.t: Eksperyans rechèch ak vrè jijman ekstèn

strings.text: BIOREX is presented to a committee including science professionals and local business leaders, Symposium demands an original historical argument, and Independent Study has the student writing the rubric.
strings.t: BIOREX prezante bay yon komite ki enkli pwofesyonèl syantifik ak lidè biznis lokal, Symposium egzije yon agiman istorik orijinal, epi Independent Study fè elèv la ekri rubrik la.

strings.text: It publishes a list of where graduates actually enrolled
strings.t: Li pibliye yon lis kote gradye yo te vrèman enskri

strings.text: 58 institutions where a Class of 2023 graduate genuinely enrolled, including Stanford, Duke, Penn, UCLA, USC, Vanderbilt, Middlebury, Vassar, Georgia Tech, UNC, UVA, William & Mary and the Air Force Academy. That is stronger evidence than any list of acceptances. The acceptance list beside it now runs 2022–2026.
strings.t: 58 enstitisyon kote yon gradye Klas 2023 te vrèman enskri, tankou Stanford, Duke, Penn, UCLA, USC, Vanderbilt, Middlebury, Vassar, Georgia Tech, UNC, UVA, William & Mary ak Air Force Academy. Sa se yon prèv pi solid pase nenpòt lis aksepte. Lis aksepte ki akote l la kounye a kouvri 2022–2026.

strings.text: Learning support is named and reaches the application
strings.t: Sipò aprantisaj gen non epi li rive nan aplikasyon an

strings.text: two named Upper School learning-support staff, student-authored personalised learning plans, and explicit guidance for juniors and seniors on requesting College Board and ACT accommodations.
strings.t: de manm estaf sipò aprantisaj Upper School ki gen non, plan aprantisaj pèsonalize elèv yo ekri, ak konsèy eksplisit pou elèv twazyèm ak dènye ane sou mande akomodasyon College Board ak ACT.

strings.text: Grades are not inflated
strings.t: Nòt yo pa anfle

strings.text: Honors courses carry no weight, Honors Accelerated adds half a point and only AT/AP add a full point, so the weighted top decile tops out at 4.28.
strings.t: Kou Honors pa pote okenn pwa, Honors Accelerated ajoute yon demi pwen epi se sèlman AT/AP ki ajoute yon pwen antye, kidonk dizyèm anwo ak pwa a rive nan tèt nan 4.28.

strings.text: The newest acceptance list covers 2024–26, but the newest list of where graduates enrolled is for the Class of 2023. Where did the Classes of 2024–2026 actually enroll?
strings.t: Lis aksepte ki pi nouvo a kouvri 2024–26, men lis ki pi nouvo sou kote gradye yo te enskri a se pou Klas 2023. Kote Klas 2024–2026 yo te vrèman enskri?

strings.text: With 105 seniors and four counselors, what is the actual caseload per counselor across all four Upper School grades?
strings.t: Avèk 105 elèv dènye ane ak kat konseye, ki vrè chay pa konseye a atravè tout kat nivo Upper School yo?

strings.text: Has Cannon had any National Merit Semifinalists, Finalists or Commended Students in recent years? Nothing is published in any year.
strings.t: Èske Cannon te gen okenn Semifinalis, Finalis oswa Commended Students National Merit nan ane resan yo? Pa gen anyen ki pibliye nan okenn ane.

strings.text: AP exams are optional here. What share of students in AP and AT courses actually sit the exam, what share scored 4 or 5 rather than just 3+ — and does the 90.16% count students or exams?
strings.t: Egzamen AP yo opsyonèl isit la. Ki pòsyon elèv nan kou AP ak AT ki vrèman pase egzamen an, ki pòsyon ki te fè 4 oswa 5 olye ke sèlman 3+ — epi èske 90.16% la konte elèv oswa egzamen?

strings.text: What were the total merit-scholarship offers for the last graduating class? No dollar figure is published anywhere.
strings.t: Ki total òf bous merit pou dènye klas ki gradye a? Pa gen okenn chif dola ki pibliye okenn kote.

strings.text: Your 2024–25 profile declined to report Class of 2025 test scores on test-optional principle, then the 2025–26 profile published them for that same class. What changed?
strings.t: Pwofil 2024–25 ou a te refize rapòte nòt tès Klas 2025 sou prensip tès opsyonèl, apre sa pwofil 2025–26 la te pibliye yo pou menm klas sa a. Kisa ki chanje?

strings.text: As printed, the Class of 2026 weighted top-10% band (4.08–4.28) overlaps the middle 50% (3.93–4.11). How is the top 10% defined?
strings.t: Jan li enprime a, bann 10% anwo ak pwa Klas 2026 la (4.08–4.28) chevoche mitan 50% la (3.93–4.11). Kijan yo defini 10% anwo a?

strings.text: What does the student-facing counseling curriculum look like grade by grade — how many one-on-one meetings, and when do essays start?
strings.t: Kijan kourikoulòm konsèy la ye pou elèv yo nivo pa nivo — konbyen reyinyon youn a youn, epi kilè redaksyon yo kòmanse?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Covenant Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 60.3% over the last five entering classes — 301 acceptances from 499 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Covenant Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 60.3% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 301 admisyon sou 499 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 27.3% in Fall 2025 — 9 of 33 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 27.3% nan otòn 2025 — 9 sou 33 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 301 of 499 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 301 sou 499 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 9 of 33, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 9 sou 33, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (42)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (42)

strings.text: 96% of AP exam scores were a 3 or higher in 2026 — the top of a five-year climb from 84% — and every AP student must sit the exam.
strings.t: 96% nan nòt egzamen AP yo te yon 3 oswa plis an 2026 — anlè yon monte senk ane depi 84% — epi chak elèv AP dwe pase egzamen an.

strings.text: A gated AP program: none for freshmen, one for sophomores, with dual enrollment through Covenant College layered on top.
strings.t: Yon pwogram AP ki gen baryè: okenn pou premye ane, youn pou dezyèm ane, ak doub enskripsyon atravè Covenant College anlè.

strings.text: of AP exams scored 3+ in 2026 (401 exams, 179 students)
strings.t: nan egzamen AP te jwenn 3+ an 2026 (401 egzamen, 179 elèv)

strings.text: of AP scores were a 4 or 5
strings.t: nan nòt AP yo te yon 4 oswa 5

strings.text: Class of 2026 SAT / ACT averages
strings.t: Mwayèn SAT / ACT Klas 2026

strings.text: of HS faculty hold advanced degrees
strings.t: nan pwofesè HS gen diplòm avanse

strings.text: The five-year AP line, as the profile charts it
strings.t: Liy AP senk ane a, jan pwofil la trase l

strings.text: 84% of AP exam scores 3+
strings.t: 84% nan nòt egzamen AP 3+

strings.text: 93% — Class of 2023: 161 students, 324 exams; SAT 1268 / ACT 26
strings.t: 93% — Klas 2023: 161 elèv, 324 egzamen; SAT 1268 / ACT 26

strings.text: 92% — Class of 2024: 168 students, 344 exams; SAT 1243 / ACT 27
strings.t: 92% — Klas 2024: 168 elèv, 344 egzamen; SAT 1243 / ACT 27

strings.text: 96% — 38 AP Scholars with Distinction, 27 with Honor, 33 Scholars
strings.t: 96% — 38 AP Scholars with Distinction, 27 ak Honor, 33 Scholars

strings.text: Since 2006, the year of its first graduating class, the school counts 28 National Merit Finalists and 70 Commended students. That count grew by two Finalists and nine Commended between the last two profile editions.
strings.t: Depi 2006, ane premye klas ki gradye a, lekòl la konte 28 National Merit Finalists ak 70 elèv Commended. Kantite sa a te grandi de Finalists ak nèf Commended ant de dènye edisyon pwofil yo.

strings.text: How the course load is built
strings.t: Kijan chaj kou a bati

strings.text: Weighting
strings.t: Pwa

strings.text: A+ = 4.33 unweighted; Honors +0.5; Dual Enrollment and AP +1.0. GPA computed on all subjects, grades 9–12.
strings.t: A+ = 4.33 san pwa; Honors +0.5; Dual Enrollment ak AP +1.0. GPA kalkile sou tout matyè, grad 9–12.

strings.text: AP gating
strings.t: Baryè AP

strings.text: No AP for freshmen; sophomores capped at one. The profile itself calls two junior-year and four senior-year APs "a very demanding course load."
strings.t: Pa gen AP pou premye ane; dezyèm ane limite a youn. Pwofil la li menm rele de AP twazyèm ane ak kat AP dènye ane "yon chay kou ki egzijan anpil."

strings.text: Dual enrollment
strings.t: Doub enskripsyon

strings.text: Honors Calculus, Statistics, and Literature & Philosophy carry Covenant College credit; SevenStar Academy extends the catalog online, noted on the transcript.
strings.t: Honors Calculus, Statistics, ak Literature & Philosophy pote kredi Covenant College; SevenStar Academy pwolonje katalòg la anliy, note sou relve nòt la.

strings.text: Graduation
strings.t: Gradyasyon

strings.text: 25 Carnegie Units, including 3 units of Bible (a Bible course every year) and a Fine Arts unit.
strings.t: 25 Carnegie Units, ki gen ladan 3 inite Bib (yon kou Bib chak ane) ak yon inite Bozar.

strings.text: Why colleges can read the grades
strings.t: Poukisa inivèsite yo ka li nòt yo

strings.text: Every AP student tests
strings.t: Chak elèv AP fè tès

strings.text: All students enrolled in AP courses are required to take the exams — so the 96% pass rate covers the whole AP population, not a self-selected slice.
strings.t: Tout elèv ki enskri nan kou AP oblije pran egzamen yo — kidonk to reyisit 96% la kouvri tout popilasyon AP la, se pa yon tranch ki chwazi tèt li.

strings.text: No rank, stated in full
strings.t: Pa gen ran, deklare nèt

strings.text: "Due to the small class size and the college-bound nature of Covenant Day’s population, we believe that class rank is not a strong discriminator… Therefore, we do not rank."
strings.t: "Akoz ti gwosè klas la ak nati popilasyon Covenant Day ki pral nan inivèsite a, nou kwè ran nan klas la se pa yon diskriminan solid… Se poutèt sa, nou pa bay ran."

strings.text: The AP course count moves with enrollment: 15 APs in the 2026–27 profile matrix, but up to 18 in the 2024–25 edition (which carried AP Calculus BC, Human Geography and French). Ask which APs actually run in your student’s year.
strings.t: Kantite kou AP a deplase ak enskripsyon: 15 AP nan matris pwofil 2026–27 la, men jiska 18 nan edisyon 2024–25 la (ki te pote AP Calculus BC, Human Geography ak French). Mande ki AP ki reyèlman fonksyone nan ane elèv ou a.

strings.text: One dedicated college counseling director — in her 23rd year at the school — for 85 seniors, the heaviest caseload in this comparison.
strings.t: Yon sèl direktè konsèy inivèsite dedye — nan 23yèm ane li nan lekòl la — pou 85 elèv finisan, chay ki pi lou nan konparezon sa a.

strings.text: The office is relational rather than productized: a NACCAP Professional of the Year with thirty years in guidance, meeting juniors and seniors throughout.
strings.t: Biwo a relasyonèl olye ke pwodwitize: yon NACCAP Professional of the Year ak trant ane nan oryantasyon, ki rankontre elèv twazyèm ane ak finisan toupatou.

strings.text: seniors per dedicated college counselor
strings.t: elèv finisan pa konseye inivèsite dedye

strings.text: The profile is the office’s application artifact: weighting key, rank policy, AP gating and the acceptance list in a two-page PDF, refreshed annually — three editions verified.
strings.t: Pwofil la se atifak aplikasyon biwo a: kle pwa, politik ran, baryè AP ak lis aksepte a nan yon PDF de paj, mete ajou chak ane — twa edisyon verifye.

strings.text: No grade-by-grade counseling timeline is published — only the junior/senior meeting cadence — and no college-counseling platform (Naviance, Scoir) is named anywhere on the public site.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kalandriye konsèy grad-pa-grad ki pibliye — sèlman kadans reyinyon twazyèm ane/finisan an — epi pa gen okenn platfòm konsèy inivèsite (Naviance, Scoir) ki nonmen okenn kote sou sit piblik la.

strings.text: The 85:1 ratio is derived (85 seniors ÷ 1 dedicated director). The second guidance counselor carries non-college load, so the effective college caseload may be lighter than the headline — but the school never states one.
strings.t: Rapò 85:1 la derive (85 elèv finisan ÷ 1 direktè dedye). Dezyèm konseye oryantasyon an pote chay ki pa pou inivèsite, kidonk chay inivèsite efektif la ka pi lejè pase tit la — men lekòl la pa janm deklare youn.

strings.text: Marking enrollments in bold is itself an unusual level of openness. Both published lists use it, and they overlap on the classes of 2023–24. So acceptances and enrollments can be checked against each other across editions.
strings.t: Make enskripsyon yo an gra se li menm yon nivo ouvèti ki pa abityèl. Tou de lis ki pibliye yo itilize l, epi yo chevoche sou klas 2023–24 yo. Kidonk yo ka verifye aksepte ak enskripsyon youn kont lòt atravè edisyon yo.

strings.text: The bolded matriculation names were recovered from the PDF’s font data (plain text extraction drops bold) — spot-checked but machine-extracted. The acceptance list itself extracted cleanly.
strings.t: Non enskripsyon an gra yo te rekipere nan done fon PDF la (ekstraksyon tèks senp la pèdi gra) — verifye pa echantiyon men ekstrè pa machin. Lis aksepte a li menm te ekstrè pwòp.

strings.text: The differentiators are depth stories: a department no other school has, a housing build on Pine Ridge, and college credit from the PCA’s own college.
strings.t: Diferansyatè yo se istwa pwofondè: yon depatman okenn lòt lekòl pa genyen, yon konstriksyon lojman sou Pine Ridge, ak kredi inivèsite ki soti nan pwòp inivèsite PCA a.

strings.text: No research-program or Olympiad credentials — the edge here is distinctiveness and legibility, not national competition results.
strings.t: Pa gen kalifikasyon pwogram rechèch oswa Olympiad — avantaj isit la se distenksyon ak lizibilite, se pa rezilta konpetisyon nasyonal.

strings.text: The enrollments in bold run from Dartmouth and Duke through Covenant College, Cedarville, Montreat, community colleges and trade-related programs. A school placing only its top quarter of students would not produce that spread.
strings.t: Enskripsyon an gra yo soti nan Dartmouth ak Duke rive nan Covenant College, Cedarville, Montreat, kolèj kominotè ak pwogram ki gen rapò ak metye. Yon lekòl ki plase sèlman katriyèm elèv ki pi fò li yo pa ta bay yon varyete konsa.

strings.text: The NC-public backbone
strings.t: Kolòn vètebral piblik-NC la

strings.text: The deepest enrolled concentrations are Chapel Hill, NC State, UNC Charlotte, App State and East Carolina — the destinations that serve the broad middle of a North Carolina class.
strings.t: Konsantrasyon enskri ki pi pwofon yo se Chapel Hill, NC State, UNC Charlotte, App State ak East Carolina — destinasyon ki sèvi laj mitan yon klas North Carolina.

strings.text: Nothing about how results are spread is published anywhere: no GPA breakdowns, no score percentiles and no enrollment rates for each class. This card shows the summary figures above because they are genuinely useful. But the shape of the class cannot be worked out from public sources. That follows from the school’s own no-rank policy.
strings.t: Pa gen anyen sou jan rezilta yo gaye ki pibliye okenn kote: pa gen dekoupaj GPA, pa gen pousantil nòt, pa gen to enskripsyon pou chak klas. Kat sa a montre chif rezime ki anwo yo paske yo vrèman itil. Men yo pa ka konprann fòm klas la apati sous piblik. Sa swiv pwòp politik san ran lekòl la.

strings.text: A demanding, clearly documented academic program with an unusually heavy counselor caseload. It shares excellent detail about outcomes but is silent about process.
strings.t: Yon pwogram akademik egzijan ki byen dokimante, ak yon chaj konseye ki lou yon fason ki pa abityèl. Li pataje detay ekselan sou rezilta, men li an silans sou pwosesis la.

strings.text: The profile tells colleges nearly everything; the website tells parents much less about how the counseling actually works.
strings.t: Pwofil la di inivèsite yo prèske tout bagay; sit entènèt la di paran yo mwens sou kijan konsèy la reyèlman fonksyone.

strings.text: The AP story is genuinely strong
strings.t: Istwa AP a vrèman solid

strings.text: 96% of exams at 3+, 78% at 4–5, with a required-exam policy that makes the number honest, and a five-year rising line to back it.
strings.t: 96% nan egzamen a 3+, 78% a 4–5, ak yon politik egzamen obligatwa ki fè chif la onèt, ak yon liy k ap monte senk ane pou soutni li.

strings.text: The heaviest caseload in this comparison
strings.t: Chay ki pi lou nan konparezon sa a

strings.text: One dedicated college counselor for 85 seniors — cushioned by a 23-year director with NACCAP standing, but a ratio a parent should ask about directly.
strings.t: Yon sèl konseye inivèsite dedye pou 85 elèv finisan — soutni pa yon direktè 23-ane ak estati NACCAP, men yon rapò yon paran ta dwe mande sou li dirèkteman.

strings.text: You can actually see where graduates enrolled
strings.t: Ou ka wè vre kote gradye yo te enskri

strings.text: Bold marks on two overlapping multi-year lists let you verify where students enrolled, not just where they were accepted — disclosure peers rarely offer.
strings.t: Mak an gra sou de lis plizyè ane ki chevoche kite w verifye kote elèv yo enskri, se pa sèlman kote yo te aksepte yo — divilgasyon kanmarad yo raman ofri.

strings.text: The ceiling is real but episodic
strings.t: Plafon an reyèl men epizodik

strings.text: Dartmouth, Penn and Duke enrollments in the current window; Stanford/MIT/Princeton belong to earlier windows. The dependable strength is NC publics and the Christian-college network.
strings.t: Enskripsyon Dartmouth, Penn ak Duke nan fenèt aktyèl la; Stanford/MIT/Princeton apatni a fenèt pi bonè. Fòs ou ka konte sou li a se lekòl piblik NC ak rezo inivèsite kretyen an.

strings.text: Process disclosure is thin
strings.t: Divilgasyon pwosesis mèg

strings.text: No counseling timeline, no platform named, no essay or application programming published — the model rides on the director’s relationships.
strings.t: Pa gen kalandriye konsèy, pa gen platfòm ki nonmen, pa gen esè oswa pwogram aplikasyon ki pibliye — modèl la woule sou relasyon direktè a.

strings.text: How does one director manage 85 seniors at peak season — what does the junior spring / senior fall calendar actually look like?
strings.t: Kijan yon sèl direktè jere 85 elèv finisan nan sezon pik la — ki jan kalandriye prentan twazyèm ane / otòn finisan an reyèlman ye?

strings.text: Which platform do families use — Naviance, Scoir, something else — and when do students get access?
strings.t: Ki platfòm fanmi yo itilize — Naviance, Scoir, yon lòt bagay — epi ki lè elèv yo jwenn aksè?

strings.text: Which AP courses will actually run next year? The matrix moved from 18 to 15 between editions.
strings.t: Ki kou AP ki pral reyèlman fonksyone ane pwochèn? Matris la te deplase soti 18 rive 15 ant edisyon yo.

strings.text: What did last year’s class look like beyond the averages — how many tested, and where did the middle of the class land?
strings.t: Ki jan klas ane pase a te ye pi lwen pase mwayèn yo — konbyen ki te fè tès, epi kote mitan klas la te tonbe?

strings.text: How does the NC Opportunity Scholarship prerequisite interact with the aid timeline for a family also applying elsewhere?
strings.t: Kijan prekondisyon NC Opportunity Scholarship la entèraji ak kalandriye èd la pou yon fanmi k ap aplike lòt kote tou?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Davidson Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 59.4% over the last five entering classes — 177 acceptances from 298 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Davidson Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 59.4% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 177 admisyon sou 298 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 40.0% in Fall 2025 — 10 of 25 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 40.0% nan otòn 2025 — 10 sou 25 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 177 of 298 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 177 sou 298 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 10 of 25, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 10 sou 25, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (25)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (25)

strings.text: Davidson Day publishes how its grades work in full: the scale, the weighting, and an unusually clear list of what the GPA leaves out. But it publishes no AP exam results and no National Merit record at all.
strings.t: Davidson Day pibliye kijan nòt li yo mache nèt: echèl la, pwa a, ak yon lis ki klè yon fason ki pa abityèl sou sa GPA a kite deyò. Men li pa pibliye okenn rezilta egzamen AP ni okenn dosye National Merit ditou.

strings.text: The School Profile does the work test scores would otherwise do: full quality-point table, +0.5 Honors / +1.0 AP, a stated no-rank policy, and a three-point GPA distribution that discloses a 2.58 floor.
strings.t: School Profile la fè travay nòt tès yo ta fè otreman: tab pwen kalite konplè, +0.5 Honors / +1.0 AP, yon politik san ran ki deklare, ak yon distribisyon GPA twa pwen ki divilge yon planche 2.58.

strings.text: AP courses offered in 2026–27 (derived count — the school publishes no total)
strings.t: Kou AP yo ofri an 2026–27 (kantite derive — lekòl la pa pibliye okenn total)

strings.text: Not published
strings.t: Pa pibliye

strings.text: AP exams sat, % scoring 3+, and exam policy
strings.t: egzamen AP yo pase, % ki fè 3+, ak politik egzamen

strings.text: “Davidson Day does not rank its students”
strings.t: “Davidson Day pa bay elèv li yo ran”

strings.text: Class of 2027 GPA — highest, median, lowest
strings.t: GPA Klas 2027 — pi wo, medyàn, pi ba

strings.text: Calculus III (Post AP) — the only named post-AP course, and explicitly weighted +1.0 like an AP.
strings.t: Calculus III (Pòs AP) — sèl kou pòs-AP ki gen non, epi eksplisitman ak pwa +1.0 tankou yon AP.

strings.text: Tops out at AP Computer Science A; there is no post-AP CS course. Both AP Computer Science Principles and AP Computer Science A are taught online through North Carolina Virtual Public School rather than on campus. Intro to AI is listed but still flagged as not offered in 2026–27.
strings.t: Li rive nan tèt nan AP Computer Science A; pa gen okenn kou CS pòs-AP. Ni AP Computer Science Principles ni AP Computer Science A anseye anliy atravè North Carolina Virtual Public School olye sou kanpis la. Intro to AI liste men yo toujou make l kòm pa ofri an 2026–27.

strings.text: AP Spanish Language and AP French Language run; AP Spanish Literature is listed but not offered this year. Honors sequences reach Spanish V and French V.
strings.t: AP Spanish Language ak AP French Language kouri; AP Spanish Literature liste men yo pa ofri l ane sa a. Sekans Honors rive nan Spanish V ak French V.

strings.text: Independent Studies and online courses not sponsored by the school are excluded from the GPA. No dual-enrollment partnership is published — notable given Davidson College sits one mile away. The real off-campus depth is AFAR international field research.
strings.t: Etid Endepandan ak kou anliy lekòl la pa patwone eskli nan GPA a. Pa gen okenn patenarya enskripsyon doub ki pibliye — sa ki remakab paske Davidson College chita yon mil lwen. Vrè pwofondè deyò kanpis la se rechèch teren entènasyonal AFAR.

strings.text: Weighted, with a published table
strings.t: Ak pwa, ak yon tab ki pibliye

strings.text: A 93–100, A− 3.67, down to D− 0.67, all printed. Honors carry +0.5, AP +1.0, and Calculus III +1.0 — the post-AP course is explicitly given AP weight.
strings.t: A 93–100, A− 3.67, desann rive D− 0.67, tout enprime. Honors pote +0.5, AP +1.0, epi Calculus III +1.0 — yo bay kou pòs-AP la pwa AP eksplisitman.

strings.text: No rank → three summary points
strings.t: Pa gen ran → twa pwen rezime

strings.text: The Profile gives the Class of 2027 highest (4.67), median (3.93) and lowest (2.58) GPA, transfers excluded. There is no quintile or decile table, so the shape of the distribution stays hidden.
strings.t: Pwofil la bay Klas 2027 la pi wo (4.67), medyàn (3.93) ak pi ba (2.58) GPA, elèv transfè eskli. Pa gen tab senkyèm oswa dizyèm, kidonk fòm distribisyon an rete kache.

strings.text: Unusually explicit exclusions
strings.t: Eksklizyon ki eksplisit yon fason ki pa abityèl

strings.text: The GPA leaves out transfer courses, Upper School courses taken in Middle School, Independent Studies, and online courses the school does not sponsor. It counts only work done at Davidson Day.
strings.t: GPA a kite deyò kou transfè, kou Upper School yo pran nan Middle School, Etid Endepandan ak kou anliy lekòl la pa patwone. Li konte sèlman travay ki fèt nan Davidson Day.

strings.text: The 22-AP figure is a derived count of distinct College Board courses in the 2026–27 Profile’s table, excluding three marked “not offered in 26-27”, Calculus III and “AP w/ WE Service”. Against 2025–26: Physics II and Microeconomics are now offered, Macroeconomics is not, Business with Personal Finance is new, and AP Studio Art is no longer printed on the Profile (the 2026–27 course catalog still lists it). Two of the 22, CS Principles and CS A, are taught through North Carolina Virtual Public School. The school prints no AP total, and PrivateSchoolReview reports a non-reconciling “23 AP/advanced courses”.
strings.t: Chif 22 AP la se yon kantite derive nan kou College Board diferan nan tab Pwofil 2026–27 la, ki eskli twa ki make “pa ofri an 26-27”, Calculus III ak “AP w/ WE Service”. Konpare ak 2025–26: Physics II ak Microeconomics ofri kounye a, Macroeconomics pa ofri, Business with Personal Finance nouvo, epi AP Studio Art pa enprime sou Pwofil la ankò (katalòg kou 2026–27 la toujou liste l). De nan 22 yo, CS Principles ak CS A, anseye atravè North Carolina Virtual Public School. Lekòl la pa enprime okenn total AP, epi PrivateSchoolReview rapòte yon “23 kou AP/avanse” ki pa rekonsilye.

strings.text: The 2026–27 Profile prints this note under its Class of 2027 GPA figures: “Figures calculated from the 9/1/26 roster export (47 of 50 students with a GPA on file); confirm against final records and transfer-student exclusions before printing.” As published, the 4.67 / 3.93 / 2.58 figures are provisional and cover 47 of 50 students.
strings.t: Pwofil 2026–27 la enprime nòt sa a anba chif GPA Klas 2027 la: “Chif yo kalkile apati ekspòtasyon lis elèv 9/1/26 la (47 sou 50 elèv ki gen yon GPA nan dosye); verifye yo ak dosye final yo ak esklizyon elèv transfere yo anvan ou enprime.” Jan yo pibliye yo, chif 4.67 / 3.93 / 2.58 yo pwovizwa epi yo kouvri 47 sou 50 elèv.

strings.text: No AP exam results of any kind are published. The school does not give the number of exams taken, the number of students, or the share scoring 3+. Nor does it say whether students in an AP course must take the exam. The course list tells you what a student may take. It says nothing about results.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn rezilta egzamen AP ditou ki pibliye. Lekòl la pa bay kantite egzamen yo pase, kantite elèv yo, oswa pati ki fè 3+. Li pa di non plis si elèv nan yon kou AP oblije pase egzamen an. Lis kou yo di w sa yon elèv ka pran. Li pa di anyen sou rezilta.

strings.text: No National Merit or College Board recognition record could be found in the school’s materials, its news feed, or National Merit Scholarship Corporation listings. Unpublished does not mean zero. In a class of ~50, a count of zero or just a few would be normal.
strings.t: Nou pa t kapab jwenn okenn dosye National Merit oswa rekonesans College Board nan materyèl lekòl la, nan fil nouvèl li, oswa nan lis National Merit Scholarship Corporation. Pa pibliye pa vle di zewo. Nan yon klas ~50, yon kantite zewo oswa jis kèk ta nòmal.

strings.text: “Most rigorous course load” is never defined. There is no stated AP maximum and no published rule for who may take AP. Nor does the school describe how it answers the Common App’s question on curriculum rigor (how demanding a student’s courses are).
strings.t: Yo pa janm defini “chay kou ki pi rijid la”. Pa gen maksimòm AP ki deklare ni okenn règ ki pibliye sou kiyès ki ka pran AP. Lekòl la pa dekri non plis kijan li reponn kesyon Common App la sou rigè kourikoulòm (jan kou yon elèv egzijan).

strings.text: Two counselors for 184 Upper Schoolers — roughly 1:92, and about 1:25 across the 50 seniors — with the office’s stated start point in 9th grade rather than junior year.
strings.t: De konseye pou 184 elèv Upper School — apeprè 1:92, epi anviwon 1:25 atravè 50 elèv dènye ane yo — ak pwen kòmansman biwo a ki deklare nan 9yèm ane olye ke twazyèm ane.

strings.text: The small caseload is the believable part. What is missing is any written promise about what the office actually guarantees. It publishes no promise to review applications before they are sent, no stance on Early Decision or Early Action, and no process for recommendations.
strings.t: Ti chaj la se pati ki kredib la. Sa ki manke se nenpòt pwomès alekri sou sa biwo a vrèman garanti. Li pa pibliye okenn pwomès pou revize aplikasyon anvan yo voye yo, okenn pozisyon sou Early Decision oswa Early Action, ni okenn pwosesis pou rekòmandasyon.

strings.text: Both ratios are derived (184 ÷ 2 and 50 ÷ 2). The school never states a counselor-to-student ratio, and publishes no caseload assignment method or the point at which a student is assigned a counselor.
strings.t: Tou de rapò yo derive (184 ÷ 2 ak 50 ÷ 2). Lekòl la pa janm deklare yon rapò konseye-a-elèv, epi li pa pibliye okenn metòd asiyasyon chay ak pwen kote yo asiyen yon elèv yon konseye.

strings.text: No grade-by-grade curriculum map is published. The live page carries no 9/10/11/12 breakdown — only “begins in 9th grade” plus the fall/spring event list, whose names map to grades only loosely.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kat kourikoulòm nivo pa nivo ki pibliye. Paj ki an dirèk la pa pote okenn dekoupaj 9/10/11/12 — sèlman “kòmanse nan 9yèm ane” plis lis evènman otòn/prentan an, ki gen non ki makonnen ak nivo yo yon fason ki lach.

strings.text: The office makes no published promise that it reads every application before it is sent. It states no approach to Early Decision / Early Action, and no count of counselor campus visits. A two-person office could well review everything. But it never says so in writing.
strings.t: Biwo a pa pibliye okenn pwomès ke li li chak aplikasyon anvan yo voye l. Li pa bay okenn apwòch sou Early Decision / Early Action, ni okenn kantite vizit kanpis konseye. Yon biwo de moun ka byen revize tout bagay. Men li pa janm di sa alekri.

strings.text: The Class of 2026 — 47 graduates — was offered more than $7.9M in merit aid; the latest full outcome set, the Class of 2025’s, shows 258 acceptances and 100% enrolling at four-year institutions.
strings.t: Yo te ofri Klas 2026 la — 47 gradye — plis pase $7.9M nan èd merit; dènye ansanm rezilta konplè a, sa Klas 2025 la, montre 258 aksepte ak 100% ki enskri nan enstitisyon kat ane.

It names 278 colleges, each of which admitted at least one Davidson Day student across six graduating classes. It combines the school’s two most recent profile lists, 2021–2025 and 2022–2026.

strings.text: The $7.9M uses the school’s own word, “offered”, not accepted. So it includes awards from colleges no student attended. The school does not publish how many students received merit awards, the median award, or the accepted total. Morehead-Cain, Robertson, QuestBridge and ROTC results are also unpublished.
strings.t: $7.9M la itilize pwòp mo lekòl la, “ofri”, se pa aksepte. Kidonk li enkli prim nan men inivèsite kote okenn elèv pa t ale. Lekòl la pa pibliye konbyen elèv ki te resevwa prim merit, prim medyàn nan, oswa total yo aksepte a. Rezilta Morehead-Cain, Robertson, QuestBridge ak ROTC pa pibliye non plis.

strings.text: The school does not publish which colleges students actually enrolled at. It also gives no data on repeat enrollment at the same college, or on how many admitted students enrolled at each one. You cannot tell from this list whether students go to any one college year after year.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye nan ki kolèj elèv yo te vrèman enskri. Li pa bay okenn done non plis sou enskripsyon ki repete nan menm kolèj la, oswa sou konbyen elèv yo te admèt ki te enskri nan chak. Ou pa ka konnen apati lis sa a si elèv yo ale nan yon menm kolèj ane apre ane.

strings.text: For a 184-student Upper School, the spike-building machinery is disproportionate: real permitted archaeology abroad, and a Global Studies Diploma that sends a second transcript and profile to colleges.
strings.t: Pou yon Upper School 184 elèv, machin pou bati espesyalite a dispwopòsyone: vrè akeyoloji ak pèmi aletranje, ak yon Global Studies Diploma ki voye yon dezyèm relve nòt ak pwofil bay inivèsite yo.

strings.text: What the school cannot offer is a well-known name. So what it can control is the Profile itself, the number of college rep visits, and access to counselors.
strings.t: Sa lekòl la pa ka ofri se yon non ki byen koni. Kidonk sa li ka kontwole se Pwofil la li menm, kantite vizit reprezantan inivèsite, ak aksè a konseye.

strings.text: **AFAR international field research** — real archaeology digs in Belize (since 2009), Spain (2014), Greece (2017) and Portugal (2018). The Belize dig runs with the BVAR project at Cahal Pech, under a permit from the Belize Institute of Archaeology. The program’s history appears in a peer-reviewed journal (*Heritage*, 2020). Students publish and present at conferences around the world.
strings.t: **Rechèch teren entènasyonal AFAR** — vrè fouy akeyolojik nan Belize (depi 2009), Espay (2014), Lagrès (2017) ak Pòtigal (2018). Fouy Belize la fèt ak pwojè BVAR la nan Cahal Pech, anba yon pèmi Belize Institute of Archaeology. Istwa pwogram nan parèt nan yon jounal ak revizyon kanmarad (*Heritage*, 2020). Elèv yo pibliye epi prezante nan konferans atravè lemonn.

strings.text: **Global Studies Diploma** — a core course in Honors Anthropology, four approved AP courses, and the same world language in all four Upper School years. It also requires at least two weeks of international field research and a capstone paper. Most important, it *produces a separate transcript and profile sent to colleges*. That is an extra document in the file, not a line on the transcript.
strings.t: **Global Studies Diploma** — yon kou debaz nan Honors Anthropology, kat kou AP apwouve, ak menm lang etranje a pandan tout kat ane Upper School yo. Li egzije tou omwen de semèn rechèch teren entènasyonal ak yon papye kapston. Sa ki pi enpòtan, li *pwodui yon relve nòt ak pwofil apa yo voye bay inivèsite yo*. Sa se yon dokiman anplis nan dosye a, se pa yon liy sou relve nòt la.

strings.text: **STEMM and Business & Civic Engagement Diplomas** — each requires at least 100 hours of approved internship or practicum (supervised field work). Each also requires Ethics Labs every quarter and an 11th-grade Research Methods Honors course. In 12th grade, students do a Capstone Research Honors mentorship. They then give a public talk at the Scholars Research Conference.
strings.t: **STEMM ak Business & Civic Engagement Diplomas** — chak egzije omwen 100 èdtan estaj oswa praktikòm (travay sou teren ki sipèvize) apwouve. Chak egzije tou Ethics Labs chak trimès ak yon kou Research Methods Honors nan 11yèm ane. Nan 12yèm ane, elèv yo fè yon mentora Capstone Research Honors. Apre sa yo fè yon prezantasyon piblik nan Scholars Research Conference la.

strings.text: **Recruiting and arts tracks** — a yearly Athletic Recruitment Workshop and National Signing Day events. One recent signing day saw seven NLI (National Letter of Intent) signings. For the arts, there is AP Studio Art, plus portfolio results at SCAD, Pratt, Manhattan School of Music, UNCSA and AMDA.
strings.t: **Pis rekritman ak atizay** — yon Athletic Recruitment Workshop chak ane ak evènman National Signing Day. Nan yon jou siyati resan, te gen sèt siyati NLI (National Letter of Intent). Pou atizay, gen AP Studio Art, plis rezilta pòtfèy nan SCAD, Pratt, Manhattan School of Music, UNCSA ak AMDA.

strings.text: The required internship or capstone applies only to students seeking a Diploma Distinction. There is no school-wide required internship or senior project. The AFAR participation counts ("hundreds", "150+", "200+") cover the whole program across many schools. How many Davidson Day students have taken part is not published.
strings.t: Estaj oswa kapston obligatwa a aplike sèlman pou elèv k ap chèche yon Diploma Distinction. Pa gen okenn estaj oswa pwojè dènye ane obligatwa pou tout lekòl la. Kantite patisipasyon AFAR yo (“dè santèn”, “150+”, “200+”) kouvri tout pwogram nan atravè anpil lekòl. Konbyen elèv Davidson Day ki te patisipe pa pibliye.

strings.text: **The School Profile as an instrument** — the strongest lever here, and well done. It is four pages, current and linked in public. It gives the full grading scale and weighting, what the GPA leaves out, and the Class of 2027 GPA range. It also has the complete course catalog, with courses not offered clearly marked. Then come graduation requirements, the Honor Code and the five-year acceptance list. A reader who has never been to Davidson, NC, can understand a student without relying on test scores or rank. That is exactly the job the Profile has to do.
strings.t: **School Profile la kòm yon zouti** — leviye ki pi solid isit la, epi li byen fèt. Li gen kat paj, li aktyèl epi li gen lyen piblik. Li bay echèl nòt ak pwa konplè a, sa GPA a kite deyò, ak ranje GPA Klas 2027 la. Li gen tou katalòg kou konplè a, ak kou yo pa ofri ki byen make. Apre sa vini kondisyon gradyasyon, Kòd Onè a ak lis aksepte senk ane a. Yon moun k ap li ki pa t janm ale Davidson, NC, ka konprann yon elèv san li pa depann de nòt tès oswa ran. Se egzakteman travay Pwofil la gen pou l fè a.

strings.text: **Integrity signalling** — the Honor Code is published word for word. The school holds the usual memberships in groups that set ethics rules for college admissions: NACAC, SACAC and ACCIS. It also belongs to SACS, SAIS, NAIS, NCAIS, NCISAA, the Educational Records Bureau (ERB) and College Board.
strings.t: **Siyal sou entegrite** — Kòd Onè a pibliye mo pou mo. Lekòl la gen manbraj abityèl nan gwoup ki fikse règ etik pou admisyon inivèsite: NACAC, SACAC ak ACCIS. Li manm tou SACS, SAIS, NAIS, NCAIS, NCISAA, Educational Records Bureau (ERB) ak College Board.

strings.text: **Regional co-hosting** — each spring Davidson Day and Cannon School co-host the Lake Norman Area College Admissions Case Studies Program and College Fair. Families act as a mock admissions committee. They read real files with the details changed.
strings.t: **Ko-resevwa rejyonal** — chak prentan Davidson Day ak Cannon School ko-resevwa Lake Norman Area College Admissions Case Studies Program ak College Fair la. Fanmi yo jwe wòl yon komite admisyon similye. Yo li vrè dosye ak detay yo chanje.

strings.text: **Proximity, not partnership** — Davidson College is one mile away and appears on the acceptance list. But the school publishes no deal for dual enrollment, course access or preferred admission. Being close is a fact, not a documented path from one to the other.
strings.t: **Pwoksimite, se pa patenarya** — Davidson College chita yon mil lwen epi li parèt sou lis aksepte a. Men lekòl la pa pibliye okenn akò pou enskripsyon doub, aksè a kou oswa admisyon preferansyèl. Lefèt ke yo pre se yon reyalite, se pa yon chemen ki dokimante soti nan youn al nan lòt.

strings.text: The discipline-reporting half of integrity signalling is not disclosed. The school does not say whether suspensions or honor-code violations go on the secondary school report it sends colleges. Nor does it say how a student may explain an incident.
strings.t: Pati rapò disiplin nan siyal entegrite a pa divilge. Lekòl la pa di si sispansyon oswa vyolasyon kòd onè ale sou rapò lekòl segondè li voye bay inivèsite yo. Li pa di non plis kijan yon elèv ka eksplike yon ensidan.

strings.text: Davidson Day has published no SAT or ACT scores since its 2020–21 profile — the current one says “due to the popularity of test-optional policies, we will not be providing the testing profiles for the Class of 2027”.
strings.t: Davidson Day pa pibliye okenn nòt SAT oswa ACT depi pwofil 2020–21 li a — pwofil aktyèl la di “akoz popilarite politik tès opsyonèl yo, nou p ap bay pwofil tès pou Klas 2027 la”.

strings.text: What remains is a three-point GPA disclosure, a genuinely staffed Learning Enrichment Center, and an acceptance list broad enough to show the middle of the class is served.
strings.t: Sa ki rete se yon divilgasyon GPA twa pwen, yon Learning Enrichment Center ki vrèman gen estaf, ak yon lis aksepte ki ase laj pou montre yo sèvi mitan klas la.

strings.text: Three summary points are all the school shares. There is no table splitting the class into fifths or tenths. So an admissions reader learns the range and the midpoint, but nothing about the shape. The reader cannot see how tightly the class bunches, how many sit above 4.0, or where the 25th percentile falls. Still, publishing a 2.58 low beside a 4.67 high is a choice to be open that many peer schools avoid.
strings.t: Twa pwen rezime se tout sa lekòl la pataje. Pa gen tab ki divize klas la an senk oswa dis pati. Kidonk yon moun k ap li nan admisyon aprann ranje a ak pwen mitan an, men anyen sou fòm nan. Moun k ap li a pa ka wè jan klas la sere, konbyen ki pi wo pase 4.0, oswa kote 25yèm pousantaj la tonbe. Sepandan, pibliye yon ba 2.58 bò kote yon wo 4.67 se yon chwa pou yo ouvè anpil lekòl parèy evite.

strings.t: Learning Enrichment Center la

strings.text: This is a genuinely staffed support team, not just an accommodations desk. It offers one-on-one tutoring during or outside the school day. It offers academic coaching and help with planning, organizing and focus skills. It also runs social-skills groups. And it offers speech-language therapy and occupational therapy.
strings.t: Sa a se yon ekip sipò ki vrèman gen estaf, se pa sèlman yon biwo akomodasyon. Li ofri titora youn a youn pandan oswa deyò jounen lekòl la. Li ofri antrènman akademik ak èd pou konpetans planifikasyon, òganizasyon ak konsantrasyon. Li gen gwoup konpetans sosyal tou. Epi li ofri terapi lapawòl-lang ak terapi okipasyonèl.

strings.text: Continuity
strings.t: Kontinwite

strings.text: Support runs from age two through grade twelve, so it does not stop at the Upper School door. Tutors work with families and classroom teachers. One-on-one academic coaching builds planning, organizing and focus skills.
strings.t: Sipò a kouri soti laj dezan rive nan douzyèm ane, kidonk li pa kanpe nan pòt Upper School la. Titè yo travay ak fanmi ak pwofesè klas yo. Coaching akademik youn a youn bati konpetans planifikasyon, òganizasyon ak konsantrasyon.

strings.text: The school’s pages never say whether the LEC writes or manages accommodations. They also do not say how those would carry over to College Board / ACT testing or to college disability services. The services are well documented. Any hand-off into the application process is not.
strings.t: Paj lekòl la pa janm di si LEC la ekri oswa jere akomodasyon. Yo pa di non plis kijan sa yo ta pote sou tès College Board / ACT oswa sou sèvis andikap nan inivèsite. Sèvis yo byen dokimante. Nenpòt pasaj nan pwosesis aplikasyon an pa dokimante.

strings.text: The list is the evidence
strings.t: Lis la se prèv la

strings.text: The 2021–26 list runs from Brown, Dartmouth, Cornell and Chicago down to colleges that admit most applicants. These include Belmont Abbey, Brevard, Catawba, Mars Hill, Methodist, Wingate, Gardner-Webb, Lenoir-Rhyne, UNC Pembroke and Winston-Salem State. A school placing only its top quarter would not produce that range.
strings.t: Lis 2021–26 la kouvri Brown, Dartmouth, Cornell ak Chicago desann rive nan kolèj ki admèt pifò kandida. Pami yo gen Belmont Abbey, Brevard, Catawba, Mars Hill, Methodist, Wingate, Gardner-Webb, Lenoir-Rhyne, UNC Pembroke ak Winston-Salem State. Yon lekòl ki plase sèlman ka anwo li a pa t ap bay ranje sa a.

strings.text: No rank, by design
strings.t: Pa gen ran, espre

strings.text: In a 50-person class, a class rank hurts far more than it informs. The no-rank policy protects the middle of the class. The spring Case Studies Program also teaches families that admissions turns on what a college needs, not on ranking applicants.
strings.t: Nan yon klas 50 moun, yon ran nan klas fè plis mal pase li enfòme. Politik san ran an pwoteje mitan klas la. Case Studies Program prentan an aprann fanmi yo tou ke admisyon depann de sa yon inivèsite bezwen, se pa de ran kandida yo.

strings.text: Service academies: Air Force and West Point. Music and arts schools: Manhattan School of Music, UNCSA, Pratt, SCAD and AMDA. International universities: seven across five countries (UCL, Edinburgh, Manchester, Toronto, Copenhagen, John Cabot, Richmond American London). Specialised technical schools: Embry-Riddle, Colorado School of Mines, RPI and RIT.
strings.t: Akademi sèvis: Air Force ak West Point. Lekòl mizik ak atizay: Manhattan School of Music, UNCSA, Pratt, SCAD ak AMDA. Inivèsite entènasyonal: sèt atravè senk peyi (UCL, Edinburgh, Manchester, Toronto, Copenhagen, John Cabot, Richmond American London). Lekòl teknik espesyalize: Embry-Riddle, Colorado School of Mines, RPI ak RIT.

strings.text: For every class after 2021, all SAT and ACT data is withheld — means, ranges, and even the number of testers. The count of testers is as revealing as the scores, since it shows whether a class is testing at all; neither is available. This is a disclosure decision tied to test-optional admissions, not a signal about how students score.
strings.t: Pou chak klas apre 2021, tout done SAT ak ACT kenbe — mwayèn, entèval, ak menm kantite moun ki pase tès. Kantite moun ki pase tès la revelatè menm jan ak nòt yo, paske li montre si yon klas ap pase tès ditou; ni youn ni lòt pa disponib. Sa a se yon desizyon divilgasyon makonnen ak admisyon ak tès opsyonèl, se pa yon siy sou kijan elèv yo fè.

strings.text: No gap-year policy or counselling is published, and no quintile table, decile table or mean GPA.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn politik oswa konsèy sou ane apre diplòm ki pibliye, ak pa gen tab senkyèm, tab dizyèm oswa GPA mwayèn.

strings.text: Latest-scores check, 2026-11-07: the 2022–23 through 2026–27 profiles all withhold testing. The 2021–22 edition (Issuu slug dds81-college_profile-2022-22_online) was overwritten in place and could not be read, so a Class of 2022 figure, if it was ever printed, is unseen. Record: School Profile 2020-2021.md.
strings.t: Verifikasyon dènye nòt yo, 2026-11-07: pwofil 2022–23 rive 2026–27 yo tout kenbe done tès yo. Edisyon 2021–22 la (slug Issuu dds81-college_profile-2022-22_online) te ranplase sou plas epi yo pa t ka li l, kidonk yon chif Klas 2022, si li te janm pibliye, pa t wè. Dosye: School Profile 2020-2021.md.

strings.text: A small, program-rich school whose strengths are process, access and spike-building — and whose weakness is disclosure.
strings.t: Yon ti lekòl ki rich an pwogram ak fòs ki nan pwosesis, aksè ak konstriksyon espesyalite — epi ki gen feblès nan divilgasyon.

strings.text: Every verdict point below is about what the school does. A family that evaluates schools on published outcome metrics will find less here than anywhere else in this set, which puts the burden of verification on the tour.
strings.t: Chak pwen jijman ki anba a konsène sa lekòl la fè. Yon fanmi k ap evalye lekòl sou mezi rezilta ki pibliye ap jwenn mwens isit la pase okenn lòt kote nan gwoup sa a, sa ki mete chay verifikasyon an sou vizit la.

strings.text: The spike machinery is real and credited
strings.t: Machin espesyalite a reyèl epi li kredite

strings.text: AFAR is not a service trip. Students dig under permit at Cahal Pech with the BVAR project. The program runs in four countries, each with a documented start year. Students publish and present at conferences, and the program’s history appears in a peer-reviewed journal.
strings.t: AFAR se pa yon vwayaj sèvis. Elèv yo fouye anba pèmi nan Cahal Pech ak pwojè BVAR la. Pwogram nan fèt nan kat peyi, chak ak yon ane kòmansman ki dokimante. Elèv yo pibliye epi prezante nan konferans, epi istwa pwogram nan parèt nan yon jounal ak revizyon kanmarad.

strings.text: The Global Studies Diploma sends a second transcript
strings.t: Global Studies Diploma a voye yon dezyèm relve nòt

strings.text: This is different in kind from an honours cord. The Profile states that an extra transcript and profile go to colleges. The diploma is backed by language study, two weeks of international field research and a capstone paper.
strings.t: Sa a diferan nèt de yon kòdon onè. Pwofil la deklare ke yon relve nòt ak yon pwofil anplis ale bay inivèsite yo. Diplòm nan sipòte pa etid lang, de semèn rechèch teren entènasyonal ak yon papye kapston.

strings.text: The caseload is genuinely small, and starts in 9th grade
strings.t: Chay la vrèman piti, epi li kòmanse nan 9yèm ane

strings.text: Two counselors for 184 Upper Schoolers (~1:92, ~1:25 at senior level) makes the “individualized” language credible rather than promotional.
strings.t: De konseye pou 184 elèv Upper School (~1:92, ~1:25 nan nivo dènye ane) fè lang “endividyalize” a kredib olye ke pwomosyonèl.

strings.text: The Profile does the work test scores would
strings.t: Pwofil la fè travay nòt tès yo ta fè

strings.text: Full grading scale, explicit weighting and exclusions, GPA range and median, the complete catalog with unoffered courses flagged, and a five-year acceptance list — with a disclosed 2.58 GPA floor.
strings.t: Echèl nòt konplè, pwa ak eksklizyon eksplisit, ranje ak medyàn GPA, katalòg konplè ak kou yo pa ofri ki make, ak yon lis aksepte senk ane — ak yon planche GPA 2.58 ki divilge.

strings.text: Rep-visit volume is high per student
strings.t: Volim vizit reprezantan wo pa elèv

strings.text: 80+ reps a year at a 184-student Upper School, visits running all fall, plus a spring case-studies program and fair co-hosted with Cannon School that drew nearly 70 colleges.
strings.t: 80+ reprezantan pa ane nan yon Upper School 184 elèv, ak vizit k ap fèt pandan tout otòn nan, plis yon pwogram etid ka ak fwa nan prentan ko-resevwa ak Cannon School ki te rale prèske 70 inivèsite.

strings.text: You don’t publish AP exam results. What share of AP exams scored 3 or higher last year, and what share were 4s and 5s? Are students in an AP course required to take the exam?
strings.t: Ou pa pibliye rezilta egzamen AP. Ki pòsyon nan egzamen AP yo ki te fè 3 oswa pi wo ane pase, epi ki pòsyon ki te 4 ak 5? Èske elèv nan yon kou AP oblije pase egzamen an?

strings.text: The Profile says you won’t provide testing profiles. What were the actual middle-50% SAT and ACT ranges for the last class, and how many students tested?
strings.t: Pwofil la di ou p ap bay pwofil tès. Ki vrè ranje mitan-50% SAT ak ACT pou dènye klas la, epi konbyen elèv ki te pase tès?

strings.text: Has Davidson Day had any National Merit Semifinalists, Finalists or Commended Students in the last five years? (Be explicit you mean the NC school — the name collides with Davidson Academy in Nevada.)
strings.t: Èske Davidson Day te gen okenn Semifinalis, Finalis oswa Commended Students National Merit nan senk dènye ane yo? (Di klèman w ap pale de lekòl NC la — non an kolizyon ak Davidson Academy nan Nevada.)

strings.text: You publish a highest, median and lowest GPA but no quintiles. How many of the seniors are above a 4.0, and where does the 25th percentile fall?
strings.t: Ou pibliye yon GPA pi wo, medyàn ak pi ba men pa gen senkyèm. Konbyen nan elèv dènye ane yo ki pi wo pase yon 4.0, epi kote 25yèm pousantaj la tonbe?

strings.text: The school names the Class of 2025’s 35 colleges nowhere, and the Class of 2026’s outcome block is not yet on the counseling page. Where did each class actually enroll, and which colleges take a Davidson Day student most years?
strings.t: Lekòl la pa nome 35 inivèsite Klas 2025 la okenn kote, epi blòk rezilta Klas 2026 la poko sou paj konsèy la. Ki kote chak klas te vrèman enskri, epi ki inivèsite ki pran yon elèv Davidson Day pifò ane?

strings.text: Does someone read every application before it’s submitted? What’s your stance on binding Early Decision, and how do you handle teacher recommendations?
strings.t: Èske gen yon moun ki li chak aplikasyon anvan yo soumèt li? Ki pozisyon w sou Early Decision ki angaje, epi kijan w jere rekòmandasyon pwofesè?

strings.text: Davidson College is one mile away — is there any dual-enrollment, course-access or partnership arrangement with them, or with UNC Charlotte?
strings.t: Davidson College chita yon mil lwen — èske gen okenn aranjman enskripsyon doub, aksè a kou oswa patenarya ak yo, oswa ak UNC Charlotte?

strings.text: Does the Learning Enrichment Center write or manage accommodations? If so, who gets them approved for College Board and ACT testing, and documented for college disability services?
strings.t: Èske Learning Enrichment Center la ekri oswa jere akomodasyon? Si se wi, kiyès ki fè apwouve yo pou tès College Board ak ACT, epi ki dokimante yo pou sèvis andikap nan inivèsite?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Carmel Christian School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 59.2% over the last five entering classes — 346 acceptances from 584 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Carmel Christian School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 59.2% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 346 admisyon sou 584 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 25.0% in Fall 2025 — 4 of 16 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 25.0% nan otòn 2025 — 4 sou 16 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: 73% of seniors scored a 3 or higher on at least one AP exam, and 80% took at least one. That is enough for the College Board’s Platinum AP School Honor Roll, its top tier.
strings.t: 73% nan elèv fen etid yo te fè yon 3 oswa plis nan omwen yon egzamen AP, epi 80% te pase omwen youn. Sa ase pou Platinum AP School Honor Roll College Board la, nivo ki pi wo li.

strings.text: A broad-participation AP program: 14 AP courses across 21 sections taught by 12 teachers, with 19% of seniors sitting five or more exams.
strings.t: Yon pwogram AP ak patisipasyon laj: 14 kou AP atravè 21 seksyon anseye pa 12 pwofesè, ak 19% nan elèv fen etid yo ki chita senk egzamen oswa plis.

strings.text: Breadth over a narrow elite

strings.text: Platinum goes to schools where a large share of seniors both take AP exams and score well on them. Here **80% sat an exam and 73% scored 3+**. So the award rests on the whole class, not a handful of stars.
strings.t: Platinum ale bay lekòl kote yon gwo pati nan elèv fen etid yo ni pase egzamen AP ni fè bon nòt ladan yo. Isit la **80% te pase yon egzamen epi 73% te fè 3+**. Kidonk prim nan chita sou tout klas la, se pa sou yon ti ponyen zetwal.

strings.t: Pwofondè nan pati dèyè a

strings.text: **19% of seniors sat five or more AP exams** — a meaningful group carrying a heavy AP load, not just one or two courses.
strings.t: **19% nan elèv fen etid yo te chita senk egzamen AP oswa plis** — yon gwoup enpòtan k ap pote yon chaj AP lou, se pa jis youn oswa de kou.

strings.t: **21 seksyon atravè 14 kou AP, anseye pa 12 pwofesè** — pwogram nan gaye atravè yon vrè fakilte olye li konsantre nan youn oswa de sal.

strings.text: The 2024–25 profile reports a weighted-GPA range (**3.67–4.50**) against an unweighted range (**3.29–3.81**) and states the school does not rank students — the range stands in for a rank.
strings.t: Pwofil 2024–25 la rapòte yon plaj GPA ponn (**3.67–4.50**) kont yon plaj san pwa (**3.29–3.81**) epi li deklare lekòl la pa klase elèv yo — plaj la ranplase yon klasman.

strings.text: The AP School Honor Roll post states no year. Its metadata (2024-02-12) plus the phrase “last year’s AP exams” points to the 2023 exams — treated as 2023 here, TO VERIFY. Separately, a 94%-of-exams-scoring-3+ figure surfaced in Course Offerings research (May 2025, 145 students); it measures a different denominator (exams, not seniors) and is not conflated with the 73% here.
strings.t: Pòs AP School Honor Roll la pa deklare okenn ane. Metadata li (2024-02-12) plis fraz “last year’s AP exams” lonje dwèt sou egzamen 2023 yo — trete kòm 2023 isit la, TO VERIFY. Apa, yon chif 94%-nan-egzamen-fè-3+ te parèt nan rechèch Course Offerings (me 2025, 145 elèv); li mezire yon denominatè diferan (egzamen, se pa elèv fen etid) epi li pa konfonn ak 73% isit la.

strings.text: No yearly record of National Merit / College Board honors is published. There are no Semifinalist, Finalist or Commended counts by year, so this card shows no merit record. The College Planning Timeline mentions National Merit only through the PSAT/NMSQT.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn rejis chak ane sou rekonesans National Merit / College Board ki pibliye. Pa gen kantite Semifinalist, Finalist oswa Commended pa ane, kidonk kat sa a pa montre okenn rejis merit. College Planning Timeline la mansyone National Merit sèlman atravè PSAT/NMSQT.

strings.text: The page gives no time window, no counts and no markings showing where students enrolled. So it reads as an acceptance list built up over time. Here it is scored against the current U.S. News tiers.

Bucket membership near the Top-75 line (e.g. Agnes Scott, Hampden-Sydney) should be re-confirmed against the live U.S. News edition at ingest.
strings.t: Antre “Xavier University” la anbigi ant Xavier (OH) ak Xavier of Louisiana (yon HBCU); li rete san kategori annatandan konfimasyon, kidonk kont bokèt HBCU 8 la eskli l. Manm bokèt tou pre liy Top-75 la (pa egzanp Agnes Scott, Hampden-Sydney) ta dwe rekonfime kont edisyon U.S. News aktif la nan moman ingest.

strings.text: The edge here is a fully published, sequenced counseling program plus a broad-participation AP record — legibility and cadence rather than national-competition credentials.
strings.t: Avantaj la se yon pwogram konsèy ki byen pibliye, ki byen ranje, plis yon dosye AP ak laj patisipasyon — lizibilite ak kadans olye kalifikasyon konpetisyon nasyonal.

strings.text: What the school hands a family is a documented four-year plan and a top-tier College Board recognition; what it does not publish is a research-program or Olympiad track.
strings.t: Sa lekòl la remèt yon fanmi se yon plan kat ane ki dokimante ak yon rekonesans College Board nan pi wo nivo; sa li pa pibliye se yon pwogram rechèch oswa yon pist Olympiad.

strings.text: Lever 1 — Build the record
strings.t: Levye 1 — Bati dosye a

strings.text: what your child brings

strings.text: **Platinum AP School Honor Roll** — the College Board’s top tier, earned on broad participation (80% of seniors sat an exam, 73% scored 3+) rather than a narrow elite.
strings.t: **Platinum AP School Honor Roll** — pi wo nivo College Board la, genyen sou laj patisipasyon (80% nan elèv fen etid yo te chita yon egzamen, 73% te fè 3+) olye yon ti gwoup elit.

strings.text: **A heavy-load group exists** — 19% of seniors sat five or more AP exams, across a 14-course / 21-section program.
strings.t: **Gen yon gwoup ak chaj lou** — 19% nan elèv fen etid yo te chita senk egzamen AP oswa plis, atravè yon pwogram 14-kou / 21-seksyon.

strings.text: **A sequenced plan** — the published four-year timeline runs Strong Start → Involvement & Service → Testing & Research → Essays & Applications. So a student works toward the application from 9th grade. It is not thrown together in the fall of senior year.
strings.t: **Yon plan ki byen ranje** — kalandriye kat ane pibliye a mache konsa: Strong Start → Involvement & Service → Testing & Research → Essays & Applications. Kidonk yon elèv travay sou aplikasyon an depi 9yèm ane. Li pa mete l ansanm an kouri nan otòn dènye ane a.

strings.text: **A NACCAP-certified counselor** — name recognition inside the Christian-college admissions circuit, matching the list’s deepest concentrations (Christian colleges and NC publics).
strings.t: **Yon konseye sètifye NACCAP** — rekonesans non anndan sèk admisyon kolèj kretyen an, ki matche ak konsantrasyon ki pi fon nan lis la (kolèj kretyen ak kolèj piblik NC).

strings.text: **A signature program that reps see** — the College Admissions Panel puts college reps in one room with families. They come from public, private and Christian colleges. A financial-aid officer, a Marine recruiter and a campus minister join them.
strings.t: **Yon pwogram siyati reprezantan yo wè** — College Admissions Panel la mete reprezantan kolèj nan yon sèl sal ak fanmi yo. Yo soti nan kolèj piblik, prive ak kretyen. Yon ofisye èd finansye, yon rekritè Marine ak yon minis kanpis vin jwenn yo.

strings.text: **A clear transcript** — a stated weighting range and a no-rank policy let a reader judge, in context, how demanding a student’s courses were. The AP Honor Roll adds an outside seal of approval.
strings.t: **Yon relve nòt ki klè** — yon plaj pwa deklare ak yon règleman san klasman pèmèt yon lektè jije, nan kontèks, jan kou yon elèv te egzijan. AP Honor Roll la ajoute yon mak apwobasyon ki soti deyò.

strings.text: No research program, Olympiad results, or national-competition credentials are published — the differentiators are cadence and legibility, not competition results.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn pwogram rechèch, rezilta Olympiad, oswa kalifikasyon konpetisyon nasyonal ki pibliye — sa ki fè diferans yo se kadans ak lizibilite, se pa rezilta konpetisyon.

strings.text: The 2024–25 profile publishes Class of 2024 test and GPA data as ranges, not distributions — a middle 50% for SAT, ACT and GPA, and nothing behind it.
strings.t: Pwofil 2024–25 la pibliye done tès ak GPA Class of 2024 la kòm plaj, se pa distribisyon — yon mitan 50% pou SAT, ACT ak GPA, epi anyen dèyè sa.

strings.text: The school does not rank, so the weighted range stands in for class position. But it publishes no percentiles, quintiles or counts of test-takers. So the shape of the class behind these ranges cannot be worked out.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa klase elèv, kidonk plaj ponn nan ranplase pozisyon nan klas la. Men li pa pibliye okenn pousantaj, kentil oswa kantite moun ki pase tès. Kidonk yo pa ka konprann fòm klas la dèyè plaj sa yo.
