strings.t: Yon Personal Counselor / Registrar (Clay Kessler) sèvi klas 9–12, apa de biwo kolèj la — kanal sipò pastoral ak pèsonèl la.

strings.text: The list matches a broad class
strings.t: Lis la matche ak yon klas laj

strings.text: The acceptance list runs from Princeton and Duke through NC public universities (Chapel Hill, NC State, UNC Charlotte, App State, East Carolina). It also includes Christian colleges, community colleges and trade schools (NASCAR Technical Institute). That is the spread of a broad class, not an all-elite one.
strings.t: Lis akseptasyon an mache depi Princeton ak Duke atravè inivèsite piblik NC (Chapel Hill, NC State, UNC Charlotte, App State, East Carolina). Li gen tou kolèj kretyen, kolèj kominotè ak lekòl metye (NASCAR Technical Institute). Sa se varyete yon klas laj, se pa youn ki elit nèt ale.

strings.text: Art and specialist schools appear. They include SCAD, Ringling College of Art & Design, Watkins College of Art and UNC School of the Arts. New York Film Academy and The American Musical & Dramatic Academy appear too. So do universities in the UK and elsewhere abroad: St Andrews, Glasgow, Stirling, York, Brock and Cape Breton.
strings.t: Lekòl atizay ak espesyalis parèt. Pami yo gen SCAD, Ringling College of Art & Design, Watkins College of Art ak UNC School of the Arts. New York Film Academy ak The American Musical & Dramatic Academy parèt tou. Menm jan tou pou inivèsite nan UK ak lòt kote aletranje: St Andrews, Glasgow, Stirling, York, Brock ak Cape Breton.

strings.text: No score percentiles, no GPA quintiles, no tester counts and no per-quintile outcomes are published — only the ranges above. The shape of the class is not recoverable from public sources.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn pousantaj nòt, okenn kentil GPA, okenn kont moun ki teste ak okenn rezilta pa kentil ki pibliye — sèlman plaj anwo yo. Fòm klas la pa rekiperab nan sous piblik yo.

strings.text: A well-documented, sequenced counseling program and a broad-participation AP record — with the current-year quantitative profile the one real hole a visit should close.
strings.t: Yon pwogram konsèy ki byen dokimante, ki byen ranje ak yon dosye AP ak laj patisipasyon — ak pwofil kantitatif ane aktyèl la kòm sèl vrè twou yon vizit ta dwe fèmen.

strings.text: The process disclosure is unusually complete for a school this size; the outcomes and test data are thinner, and the latest profile could not be located.
strings.t: Divilgasyon pwosesis la konplè yon fason ki pa abityèl pou yon lekòl gwosè sa a; rezilta yo ak done tès yo pi mens, epi pwofil ki pi resan an pa t kapab jwenn.

strings.text: The AP story is broad, not narrow
strings.t: Istwa AP la laj, se pa etwat

strings.text: Platinum AP School Honor Roll earned on whole-class participation — 80% of seniors sat an exam and 73% scored 3+, with 19% sitting five or more.
strings.t: Platinum AP School Honor Roll genyen sou patisipasyon tout klas la — 80% nan elèv fen etid yo te chita yon egzamen epi 73% te fè 3+, ak 19% ki chita senk oswa plis.

strings.text: The counseling program is fully published
strings.t: Pwogram konsèy la byen pibliye nèt

strings.text: A grade-by-grade timeline, a signature College Boot Camp, an essay workshop, an eight-part application framework and an admissions panel — more process detail than several larger peers publish.
strings.t: Yon kalandriye klas pa klas, yon siyati College Boot Camp, yon atelye disètasyon, yon fòm aplikasyon uit pati ak yon panèl admisyon — plis detay pwosesis pase plizyè lekòl parèy pi gwo pibliye.

strings.text: A single dedicated counselor
strings.t: Yon sèl konseye dedye

strings.text: One NACCAP-certified college counselor, cushioned by a separate academic advisor and personal counselor — but the senior caseload is never stated, so ask it directly.
strings.t: Yon sèl konseye kolèj sètifye NACCAP, sipòte pa yon konseye akademik apa ak yon konseye pèsonèl — men chaj travay dènye ane a pa janm deklare, kidonk mande l dirèkteman.

strings.text: Outcomes show breadth
strings.t: Rezilta yo montre lajè

strings.text: Around 215 named acceptances led by Princeton and Duke, deep in NC public universities and Christian colleges. But the list does not mark enrollments, so it shows acceptances, not where students enrolled.
strings.t: Anviwon 215 akseptasyon ki gen non, ak Princeton ak Duke an tèt, byen fon nan inivèsite piblik NC ak kolèj kretyen. Men lis la pa make enskripsyon, kidonk li montre akseptasyon, se pa kote elèv yo te enskri.

strings.text: The weighting changes with the Class of 2026
strings.t: Ponderasyon an chanje ak Class of 2026 la

strings.text: The profile states that from the Class of 2026, honors courses carry **+0.5** and AP courses **+1.0**. That is down from the **+1** and **+2** quality points behind the GPA ranges above. So a weighted GPA quoted today is not calculated the same way as one quoted for a current freshman.
strings.t: Pwofil la deklare ke apati Class of 2026 la, kou Honors yo pote **+0.5** epi kou AP yo **+1.0**. Sa pi ba pase **+1** ak **+2** pwen kalite ki dèyè plaj GPA anwo yo. Kidonk yon GPA ponn yo site jodi a pa kalkile menm jan ak youn yo site pou yon elèv premye ane kounye a.

strings.text: How many seniors does the college counselor carry at peak season, and how large is the senior class?
strings.t: Konbyen elèv fen etid konseye kolèj la pote nan gwo sezon an, epi ki gwosè klas fen etid la?

strings.text: Can we see the current-year School Profile — what are this year’s SAT/ACT and GPA figures, and how many students test?
strings.t: Èske nou ka wè School Profile ane aktyèl la — ki chif SAT/ACT ak GPA ane sa a, epi konbyen elèv teste?

strings.text: Which AP courses actually run next year, and how are students placed into them?
strings.t: Ki kou AP ki vrèman ap mache ane pwochèn, epi kijan elèv yo plase nan yo?

strings.text: The acceptance list marks no enrollments. Where did last year’s class actually enroll, and in what numbers at each college?
strings.t: Lis akseptasyon an pa make okenn enskripsyon. Ki kote klas ane pase a te vrèman enskri, epi konbyen elèv nan chak kolèj?

strings.text: How are testing accommodations documented for the College Board and ACT, and what learning-support is available beyond personal counseling?
strings.t: Kijan akomodasyon tès dokimante pou College Board ak ACT, epi ki sipò aprantisaj ki disponib apa de konsèy pèsonèl?

strings.text: Roughly how many college reps visit each year, and how does the College Admissions Panel fit the application calendar?
strings.t: Apeprè konbyen reprezantan kolèj vizite chak ane, epi kijan College Admissions Panel la kadre ak kalandriye aplikasyon an?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Hickory Grove Christian School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 74.9% over the last five entering classes — 256 acceptances from 342 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Hickory Grove Christian School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 74.9% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 256 admisyon sou 342 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 20.0% in Fall 2025 — 2 of 10 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 20.0% nan otòn 2025 — 2 sou 10 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 256 of 342 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 256 sou 342 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 2 of 10, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 2 sou 10, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: 85 students sat 176 AP exams in May 2026 across a 17-course AP program with AP Capstone — and 14 of them earned a 5 on at least one exam.
strings.t: 85 elèv te chita 176 egzamen AP nan me 2026 atravè yon pwogram AP 17 kou ak AP Capstone — epi 14 nan yo te fè yon 5 nan omwen yon egzamen.

strings.text: A college-prep school, built on a biblical worldview, that does not rank students. The transcript rests on a weighted GPA, with a quality-point bonus for honors and AP courses. Its AP catalog reaches as far as AP Seminar and AP Research.
strings.t: Yon lekòl preparasyon inivèsite, ki bati sou yon vizyon biblik, ki pa bay elèv li yo ran. Relve nòt la chita sou yon GPA ak pwa, ak yon bonis pwen kalite pou kou honors ak AP. Katalòg AP li rive jiska AP Seminar ak AP Research.

strings.t: 17 + Capstone

strings.t: kou AP, plis pis AP Seminar → Research Capstone la

strings.t: elèv / egzamen AP, me 2026 (14 te fè yon 5 nan ≥1 egzamen)

strings.text: the school does not rank its students
strings.t: lekòl la pa bay elèv li yo ran

strings.text: National recognition — the profile’s 2020–2026 window
strings.t: Rekonesans nasyonal — peryòd 2020–2026 pwofil la

strings.text: National Merit — 1 Finalist and 8 Commended Students across the seven-year profile window.
strings.t: National Merit — 1 Finalis ak 8 Commended Students atravè fenèt pwofil sèt ane a.

strings.text: College Board National Recognition — 8 National African American and 6 National Hispanic Recognition awardees.
strings.t: College Board National Recognition — 8 moun ki resevwa National African American ak 6 National Hispanic Recognition.

strings.text: AP Scholars — 18 AP Scholars, 6 with Honors, 10 with Distinction, plus 3 AP Capstone Diplomas.
strings.t: AP Scholars — 18 AP Scholars, 6 with Honors, 10 with Distinction, plis 3 AP Capstone Diploma.

strings.text: Figures are cumulative windows the profile prints, not single-year counts. The Fall 2023 profile carried a smaller window (1 Finalist / 5 Commended; 11 AP Scholars), so the program is growing.
strings.t: Chif yo se fenèt kimilatif pwofil la enprime, se pa kont pou yon sèl ane. Pwofil Fall 2023 la te pote yon fenèt pi piti (1 Finalis / 5 Commended; 11 AP Scholars), kidonk pwogram nan ap grandi.

strings.text: What the AP record rests on
strings.t: Sou kisa dosye AP la chita

strings.text: A broad AP catalog
strings.t: Yon katalòg AP laj

strings.text: The school advertises **17 AP courses plus AP Capstone** (AP Seminar + AP Research). The 2026–27 profile names 13 by title. Calculus BC and Psychology are no longer printed, and Human Geography is back. The 2023 profile named 17, covering every title any edition has printed. So which of them run varies from year to year.
strings.t: Lekòl la anonse **17 kou AP plis AP Capstone** (AP Seminar + AP Research). Pwofil 2026–27 la bay non 13. Calculus BC ak Psychology pa enprime ankò, epi Human Geography tounen. Pwofil 2023 la te bay non 17, ki kouvri tout tit nenpòt edisyon te enprime. Kidonk kilès ki fèt varye de yon ane a yon lòt.

strings.text: Real depth in the scores
strings.t: Vrè pwofondè nan nòt yo

strings.text: **14 students earned a 5 on one or more AP exams in May 2026** (38 a 4, 50 a 3) — these are students-scoring-X counts, which overlap, not a per-exam distribution the school does not publish.
strings.t: **14 elèv te fè yon 5 nan youn oswa plizyè egzamen AP nan me 2026** (38 yon 4, 50 yon 3) — sa yo se kont elèv-ki-fè-X, ki chevoche, se pa yon distribisyon pa egzamen ke lekòl la pa pibliye.

strings.text: Dual enrollment beyond AP
strings.t: Doub enskripsyon pi lwen pase AP

strings.text: Courses taught on campus are credited through **Judson College** (2026–27 profile; earlier years went through the College at Southeastern). Only courses taught by HGCS teachers carry dual credit. Students also take **NC Career & College Promise** courses at local community colleges.
strings.t: Kou yo fè sou kanpis la jwenn kredi atravè **Judson College** (pwofil 2026–27; ane anvan yo te pase pa College at Southeastern). Se sèlman kou pwofesè HGCS fè ki bay doub kredi. Elèv yo pran kou **NC Career & College Promise** tou nan community college lokal yo.

strings.text: The school **does not rank students** (verbatim, both profiles). GPA averages regular and weighted courses together on a 4.0 base.
strings.t: Lekòl la **pa bay elèv yo ran** (mo pou mo, nan tou de pwofil yo). GPA a fè mwayèn kou regilye ak kou ak pwa yo ansanm sou yon baz 4.0.

strings.text: The weighting was halved mid-2024
strings.t: Yo te koupe pwa a an mwatye nan mitan 2024

strings.text: Under the current (Spring 2024 and beyond) scale, **Honors courses earn +½ a quality point and AP courses +1** — down from +1 and +2 on the 2016–17 scale. Transcripts of the Classes of 2025 through 2027 span both scales.
strings.t: Dapre echèl kounye a (prentan 2024 ak apre), **kou Honors bay +½ pwen kalite epi kou AP +1** — desann soti +1 ak +2 nan echèl 2016–17 la. Relve nòt Klas 2025 rive 2027 yo kouvri toude echèl yo.

strings.text: 27 units to graduate
strings.t: 27 inite pou gradye

strings.text: Bible 4 · English 4 · Math 4 · Social Studies 4 · Science 3 · Foreign Language 2 · Health/PE 1 · Fine Arts 1 · Electives 4 — a Bible credit every year is part of the required load.
strings.t: Bib 4 · Anglè 4 · Matematik 4 · Syans Sosyal 4 · Syans 3 · Lang Etranje 2 · Sante/PE 1 · Bozar 1 · Elektif 4 — yon kredi Bib chak ane fè pati chay obligatwa a.

strings.text: No per-exam AP 1–5 distribution is published — only the overlapping "students who earned a 5 / 4 / 3 on at least one exam" counts. The "17 AP courses" marketing figure and the profile's shorter named list (13) are reconciled here as catalog-vs-offered-this-year, not a contradiction.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn distribisyon AP 1–5 pa egzamen ki pibliye — se sèlman kont ki chevoche yo "students who earned a 5 / 4 / 3 on at least one exam". Chif maketing "17 AP courses" la ak lis ki gen non pi kout pwofil la (13) rekonsilye isit la kòm katalòg-kont-sa-yo-ofri-ane-sa-a, se pa yon kontradiksyon.

strings.text: The 2026–27 profile prints AP Scholar counts of 18 AP Scholars, 6 with Honors, 10 with Distinction and 3 AP Capstone Diplomas under the label "2024-2025". The 2025–26 profile printed 22 / 5 / 10 / 4 under the same label. The school has not said which is right; the newer edition is shipped. Re-check against the next profile.
strings.t: Pwofil 2026–27 la enprime 18 AP Scholars, 6 with Honors, 10 with Distinction ak 3 AP Capstone Diplomas anba etikèt "2024-2025". Pwofil 2025–26 la te enprime 22 / 5 / 10 / 4 anba menm etikèt la. Lekòl la pa di kilès ki kòrèk; se edisyon ki pi resan an ki parèt isit la. Verifye ankò ak pwochen pwofil la.

strings.text: A two-person counseling office — a Director of Counseling and an Administrator for Student Services — running a biblical-worldview program of 1:1 meetings, guidance lunches and parent-night sessions.
strings.t: Yon biwo konsèy ak de moun — yon Director of Counseling ak yon Administrator for Student Services — k ap dirije yon pwogram ak yon vizyon biblik ki gen reyinyon 1:1, manje midi konsèy ak sesyon aswè pou paran.

strings.text: The school does not publish how many seniors each counselor serves. Using the Class of 2025 senior count, the latest it has published, the ratio works out to roughly 34:1 across the two staff. Across all 287 high-school students, it is about 144:1.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye konbyen elèv dènye ane chak konseye sèvi. Si w itilize kantite elèv dènye ane Klas 2025 la, dènye lekòl la pibliye, rapò a bay apeprè 34:1 pou de manm pèsonèl yo. Sou tout 287 elèv lekòl segondè yo, li se apeprè 144:1.

strings.t: anplwaye konsèy ki gen non (Bennett + Similton)

strings.t: elèv dènye ane pa konseye — kalkile, pa pibliye

strings.t: elèv lekòl segondè (2026–27)

strings.t: Pa gen zouti

strings.text: The guidance page describes these as its program. It does not publish a grade-by-grade timeline. None of the profiles or the guidance page names an application platform (Naviance / SCOIR / Common App) or an NCAA code.
strings.t: Paj konsèy la dekri sa yo kòm pwogram li. Li pa pibliye yon kalandriye klas pa klas. Okenn nan pwofil yo ni paj konsèy la pa nonmen yon platfòm aplikasyon (Naviance / SCOIR / Common App) ni yon kòd NCAA.

strings.text: Two named counseling staff serve the whole high school — no separate college-only counselor is published
strings.t: De anplwaye konsèy ki gen non sèvi tout lekòl segondè a — pa gen okenn konseye apa pou inivèsite sèlman ki pibliye

strings.text: A "College Admissions Boot Camp" summer program (rising juniors & seniors) is run by the counseling staff, including 1–2 campus visits
strings.t: Anplwaye konsèy yo dirije yon pwogram ete "College Admissions Boot Camp" (elèv rising twazyèm ak dènye ane), ki gen ladan 1–2 vizit kanpis

strings.text: No senior-class size or seniors-per-counselor ratio is published. The ≈34:1 figure is computed from the Class of 2025 bucket counts (43 + 15 + 7 + 2 = 67 graduates) against the two counseling staff; the ≈144:1 school-wide figure uses all 287 high-school students. Both are derived, not stated. The 2026–27 profile prints attendance shares without counts, so no newer senior count exists.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye ni gwosè klas dènye ane a ni rapò elèv dènye ane pou chak konseye. Chif ≈34:1 la soti nan kantite pa kategori Klas 2025 la (43 + 15 + 7 + 2 = 67 gradye) konpare ak de manm pèsonèl konsèy yo; chif ≈144:1 pou tout lekòl la itilize tout 287 elèv lekòl segondè yo. Toude se kalkil, se pa chif lekòl la bay. Pwofil 2026–27 la enprime pousantaj destinasyon san kantite, kidonk pa gen okenn kantite elèv dènye ane ki pi resan.

strings.text: 158 different colleges appear on the school's three published acceptance lists (Classes of 2023, 2025 and 2026). They run from Bowdoin, Pomona, Georgia Tech and Boston University to many NC public colleges, Christian colleges and HBCUs (historically Black colleges).
strings.t: 158 kolèj diferan parèt sou twa lis aksepte lekòl la pibliye yo (Klas 2023, 2025 ak 2026). Yo kouri soti Bowdoin, Pomona, Georgia Tech ak Boston University rive nan anpil kolèj piblik NC, kolèj kretyen ak HBCU (kolèj istorikman Nwa).

strings.text: The lists carry no markings showing where students enrolled, so they read as acceptances. No Class of 2024 list was published. Here the three lists are combined, with repeats removed, and scored against the current U.S. News tiers.
strings.t: Lis yo pa gen okenn mak ki montre kote elèv yo te enskri, kidonk yo li tankou akseptasyon. Lekòl la pa t pibliye okenn lis pou Klas 2024. Isit la, twa lis yo konbine, san doublon, epi yo evalye dapre nivo U.S. News aktyèl yo.

strings.text: The profiles publish acceptance lists and recognition counts, but no scholarship-offer totals or named-award ledger.
strings.t: Pwofil yo pibliye lis aksepte ak kont rekonesans, men pa gen okenn total òf bous ni rejis prim ki gen non.

strings.text: Bucket membership near the Top-75 line should be re-confirmed against the live U.S. News edition at ingest. HBCU membership was checked per institution. The list holds both "Xavier University of Louisiana" (2023 list, an HBCU) and "Xavier University" (2026 list, printed bare, read as the Ohio university by its official name, untagged).
strings.t: Fòk yo konfime ankò manm kategori ki toupre liy Top 75 la dapre edisyon U.S. News ki an vigè a lè y ap entegre done yo. Yo te verifye manm HBCU yo enstitisyon pa enstitisyon. Lis la gen ni "Xavier University of Louisiana" (lis 2023, yon HBCU) ni "Xavier University" (lis 2026, enprime san plis, yo li l kòm inivèsite Ohio a dapre non ofisyèl li, san etikèt).

strings.text: The edge here is a broad-participation AP program with AP Capstone and a growing National-recognition record, set inside an explicitly biblical-worldview college-prep school.
strings.t: Avantaj la isit la se yon pwogram AP ak laj patisipasyon ki gen AP Capstone ak yon dosye rekonesans National k ap grandi, mete anndan yon lekòl preparasyon inivèsite ki eksplisitman gen yon vizyon biblik.

strings.text: What the school hands a family is a real AP catalog and a decade of College Board recognitions; what it does not publish is a research-program or national-competition track.
strings.t: Sa lekòl la remèt yon fanmi se yon vrè katalòg AP ak yon dizèn ane rekonesans College Board; sa li pa pibliye se yon pwogram rechèch oswa yon pis konpetisyon nasyonal.

strings.text: **A 17-course AP program with AP Capstone** — the AP Seminar → AP Research sequence produced 3 AP Capstone Diplomas in the profile’s 2024–25 window, and 85 students sat 176 exams in May 2026.
strings.t: **Yon pwogram AP 17 kou ak AP Capstone** — sekans AP Seminar → AP Research la bay 3 AP Capstone Diplomas nan peryòd 2024–25 pwofil la, epi 85 elèv te pase 176 egzamen nan mwa me 2026.

strings.text: **A widening recognition record** — 1 National Merit Finalist and 8 Commended over 2020–2026, up from 1/5 in the 2019–2023 window, plus 14 College Board National African American / Hispanic recognitions.
strings.t: **Yon dosye rekonesans k ap elaji** — 1 National Merit Finalist ak 8 Commended sou 2020–2026, monte soti 1/5 nan peryòd 2019–2023 la, plis 14 rekonesans College Board National African American / Hispanic.

strings.text: **Dual-enrollment credit** — courses credited through Judson College (prior years, the College at Southeastern) and NC Career & College Promise at community colleges.
strings.t: **Kredi doub enskripsyon** — kou ki kredite atravè Judson College (ane anvan yo, College at Southeastern la) ak NC Career & College Promise nan kolèj kominotè yo.

strings.text: **A clear, no-rank transcript** — the school does not rank. It publishes both grading scales and the honors/AP weighting, so a reader can judge how hard a student’s courses were.
strings.t: **Yon relve nòt klè, san ran** — lekòl la pa bay ran. Li pibliye tou de echèl nòt yo ak pwa honors/AP la, kidonk yon moun k ap li ka jije jan kou yon elèv te difisil.

strings.text: **A signature summer on-ramp** — the counseling office runs a College Admissions Boot Camp for rising juniors and seniors, with campus visits.
strings.t: **Yon pòt antre ete siyati** — biwo konsèy la dirije yon College Admissions Boot Camp pou elèv rising twazyèm ak dènye ane, ak vizit kanpis.

strings.text: **A deep HBCU and NC-public pipeline** — 23 HBCUs and the full NC public system appear across the three acceptance lists, matching the school's applicant base.
strings.t: **Yon gwo kanal pou HBCU ak kolèj piblik NC** — 23 HBCU ak tout sistèm piblik NC a parèt atravè twa lis akseptasyon yo, sa ki koresponn ak baz kandida lekòl la.

strings.text: No research program, Olympiad results, or national-competition credentials are published — the differentiators are AP breadth and legibility, not competition results.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn pwogram rechèch, rezilta Olympiad, ni kalifikasyon konpetisyon nasyonal ki pibliye — sa ki fè diferans lan se lajè AP ak lizibilite, se pa rezilta konpetisyon.

strings.text: The school publishes class means — not percentile distributions — and it says so: small tester counts (SAT n=45) are disclosed on the profile itself.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye mwayèn klas yo — pa distribisyon pa pousantil — epi li di sa: ti kantite moun ki teste yo (SAT n=45) parèt sou pwofil la li menm.

strings.text: Test scores are the Class of 2026’s, the same class as the newest acceptance list; the counted attendance split is the Class of 2025’s. Every table below is means, so none carries a percentile header.
strings.t: Nòt tès yo se pou Klas 2026, menm klas ak lis akseptasyon ki pi resan an; repatisyon destinasyon ak kantite yo se pou Klas 2025. Chak tablo ki anba a se mwayèn, kidonk okenn pa gen tèt pousantil.

strings.t: Pa gen okenn distribisyon GPA ni tab kentil ki pibliye — lekòl la pa bay ran, epi li pa enprime okenn kantil GPA. Echèl nòt ki pibliye yo (§transcript) se tout divilgasyon GPA a.

strings.text: Educational Support Services
strings.t: Educational Support Services

strings.text: Fee-based **Educational Support Services (ESS)** work under an annual contract and serve K through 12th grade. They offer accommodations plans built from educational testing or a prior 504/IEP. They also offer approved testing accommodations and high school Academic Coaching.
strings.t: **Educational Support Services (ESS)**, ki peye, mache ak yon kontra chak ane epi sèvi elèv depi K rive nan 12yèm ane. Yo ofri plan aranjman ki baze sou evalyasyon edikatif oswa sou yon 504/IEP anvan. Yo ofri tou aranjman pou tès ki apwouve ak Academic Coaching nan lekòl segondè.

strings.text: The three acceptance lists run from Bowdoin, Pomona, Georgia Tech and Boston University through the full NC public system. That includes Chapel Hill, NC State, Charlotte, Wilmington, Greensboro, Asheville and Pembroke. Christian colleges, HBCUs and community colleges (Central Piedmont, Cape Fear, Rowan-Cabarrus) appear too. That is the spread of a broad class, not one that is elite all the way through.
strings.t: Twa lis akseptasyon yo ale depi Bowdoin, Pomona, Georgia Tech ak Boston University rive nan tout sistèm piblik NC a. Sa enkli Chapel Hill, NC State, Charlotte, Wilmington, Greensboro, Asheville ak Pembroke. Kolèj kretyen, HBCU ak community college (Central Piedmont, Cape Fear, Rowan-Cabarrus) parèt tou. Sa se varyete yon klas laj, se pa youn ki elit nèt ale.

strings.text: Non-4-year paths are real
strings.t: Chemen ki pa 4 ane yo reyèl

strings.text: The 2026–27 profile puts typical plans after high school at 65% 4-year college, 25% 2-year college and 10% work, military or a gap year. The Class of 2025 is the last year printed with counts. It had 22% planning a 2-year college and 11% choosing not to pursue higher education. The acceptance list reflects this, with community colleges and trade paths on it.
strings.t: Pwofil 2026–27 la mete plan abityèl apre lekòl segondè a 65% kolèj 4 an, 25% kolèj 2 an ak 10% travay, lame oswa yon ane pòz. Klas 2025 la se dènye ane yo te enprime ak kantite. Ladan l, 22% te planifye yon kolèj 2 an epi 11% te chwazi pa kontinye etid siperyè. Lis akseptasyon an reflete sa, ak community college ak chemen metye ladan l.

strings.text: No score percentiles, GPA quintiles or outcomes by quintile are published. There are only class averages and medians (with the number of testers shown) and AP award tiers. The shape of the class cannot be worked out from public sources.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn pousantil nòt, okenn kentil GPA ni okenn rezilta pa kentil ki pibliye. Se sèlman mwayèn ak medyàn klas la (ak kantite moun ki pase tès yo montre) ak nivo prim AP. Yo pa ka konprann fòm klas la apati sous piblik.

strings.text: A college-prep school with a biblical worldview, a real AP-and-Capstone program and a growing record of awards. The small tester counts and the unpublished caseload are the two things a visit should probe.
strings.t: Yon lekòl preparasyon inivèsite ak yon vizyon biblik, yon vrè pwogram AP-ak-Capstone ak yon dosye prim k ap grandi. Ti kantite moun ki pase tès yo ak chaj travay ki pa pibliye a se de bagay yon vizit ta dwe eksplore.

strings.text: The AP catalog and the three-class acceptance record are the real strengths; the quantitative profile is thin by design (means, not distributions) and the counseling caseload is never stated.
strings.t: Katalòg AP a ak dosye akseptasyon twa klas yo se vrè fòs yo; pwofil kantitatif la mens espre (mwayèn, pa distribisyon) epi lekòl la pa janm di konbyen elèv chak konseye genyen.

strings.text: The AP story is real and broad
strings.t: Istwa AP la reyèl epi laj

strings.text: 17 AP courses with AP Capstone, 176 exams taken in May 2026, 14 students earning a 5 on at least one, and 3 AP Capstone Diplomas. That is a program with real depth for a school this size.
strings.t: 17 kou AP ak AP Capstone, 176 egzamen pase nan mwa me 2026, 14 elèv ki jwenn yon 5 nan omwen youn, ak 3 AP Capstone Diplomas. Sa se yon pwogram ki gen vrè pwofondè pou yon lekòl gwosè sa a.

strings.text: Recognition is growing
strings.t: Rekonesans lan ap grandi

strings.text: National Merit (1 Finalist / 8 Commended) and 14 College Board National recognitions over 2020–2026, both up from the 2019–2023 window.
strings.t: National Merit (1 Finalist / 8 Commended) ak 14 rekonesans College Board National sou 2020–2026, toude pi wo pase peryòd 2019–2023 la.

strings.text: A two-person counseling office
strings.t: Yon biwo konsèy ak de moun

strings.text: A Director of Counseling and an Administrator for Student Services run the program, but the senior caseload is never published — the ≈34:1 figure here is computed, so ask it directly.
strings.t: Yon Director of Counseling ak yon Administrator for Student Services dirije pwogram nan, men yo pa janm pibliye chay travay elèv dènye ane a — chif ≈34:1 la isit la kalkile, kidonk mande l dirèkteman.

strings.text: Outcomes show breadth over three classes
strings.t: Rezilta yo montre lajè sou twa klas

strings.text: 158 institutions across the 2023, 2025 and 2026 lists — Bowdoin and Pomona at the top, 23 HBCUs, the full NC public system. But the lists do not mark where students enrolled, so they show acceptances, not enrollment.
strings.t: 158 enstitisyon atravè lis 2023, 2025 ak 2026 yo — Bowdoin ak Pomona anwo nèt, 23 HBCU, tout sistèm piblik NC a. Men lis yo pa make kote elèv yo te enskri, kidonk yo montre akseptasyon, se pa enskripsyon.

strings.text: The quantitative profile is thin by design
strings.t: Pwofil kantitatif la mens espre

strings.text: The school publishes class averages based on small numbers of testers (SAT n=45). It publishes no percentile spread or GPA table, and it does not rank. So the shape of the class is not public.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye mwayèn klas ki baze sou ti kantite moun ki pase tès (SAT n=45). Li pa pibliye okenn distribisyon pa pousantil ni okenn tablo GPA, epi li pa klase elèv yo. Kidonk fòm klas la pa piblik.

strings.text: How many seniors does each of the two counselors carry, and is there a college-only counselor at peak season?
strings.t: Konbyen elèv dènye ane chak nan de konseye yo pote, epi èske gen yon konseye pou inivèsite sèlman nan gwo sezon an?

strings.text: Which of the 17 AP courses actually run in 2026–27 — the profile names 13, the catalog lists 17?
strings.t: Kilès nan 17 kou AP yo ki fèt vrèman nan 2026–27 — pwofil la bay non 13, katalòg la bay lis 17?

strings.text: The acceptance lists mark no enrollments. Where did the Classes of 2024, 2025 and 2026 actually enroll, and how many went to each college?
strings.t: Lis akseptasyon yo pa make okenn enskripsyon. Ki kote Klas 2024, 2025 ak 2026 yo te vrèman enskri, epi konbyen elèv ki te ale nan chak kolèj?

strings.text: How does the school document and support College Board and ACT testing accommodations for a student with an ESS accommodations plan?
strings.t: Kijan lekòl la dokimante epi sipòte aranjman pou tès College Board ak ACT pou yon elèv ki gen yon plan aranjman ESS?

strings.text: Only 45 students took the SAT and 79 the ACT — what share of the class tests, and how is test-optional handled?
strings.t: Se sèlman 45 elèv ki te pran SAT la ak 79 ACT la — ki pati nan klas la ki fè tès, epi kijan yo jere tès opsyonèl la?

strings.text: How does the College Admissions Boot Camp fit the application calendar, and is it open to all rising juniors and seniors?
strings.t: Kijan College Admissions Boot Camp la kadre ak kalandriye aplikasyon an, epi èske li louvri pou tout elèv rising twazyèm ak dènye ane?

strings.text: Across the six top-ranked NC public universities, Gaston Day School’s applicants were admitted at a pooled 57.9% over the last five entering classes — 140 acceptances from 242 applications.
strings.t: Nan sis inivèsite piblik ki pi byen klase nan NC yo, kandida Gaston Day School yo te admèt nan yon to konbine 57.9% sou senk dènye pwomosyon ki antre yo — 140 admisyon sou 242 aplikasyon.

strings.text: UNC-Chapel Hill is the hard one: 27.3% in Fall 2025 — 3 of 11 — against far higher rates at the less-selective universities. These are UNC-system figures published by the state, not the school’s own.
strings.t: UNC-Chapel Hill se sa ki difisil la: 27.3% nan otòn 2025 — 3 sou 11 — kont to ki pi wo anpil nan inivèsite ki mwens selektif yo. Sa se chif sistèm UNC leta a pibliye, se pa chif lekòl la menm.

strings.text: pooled admit rate — 140 of 242 across those five classes
strings.t: to admisyon konbine — 140 sou 242 nan senk pwomosyon sa yo

strings.text: at UNC-Chapel Hill — 3 of 11, the toughest of the six for this school
strings.t: nan UNC-Chapel Hill — 3 sou 11, sa ki pi difisil nan sis yo pou lekòl sa a

strings.text: drew the most applications in Fall 2025 (15)
strings.t: te resevwa plis aplikasyon nan otòn 2025 (15)

strings.text: Every AP student must sit the exam, and the share scoring 3+ has climbed five years running — 72% in 2021 to 95% in 2025.
strings.t: Chak elèv AP dwe pase egzamen an, epi pòsyon ki fè 3+ la monte senk ane youn dèyè lòt — 72% an 2021 rive 95% an 2025.

strings.text: With no class rank, the profile gives admissions readers three stand-ins at once. It has a GPA quintile table (a split of the class into fifths) and a table of grades by department. It also states the most APs a student may take, which defines what "most rigorous" means here.
strings.t: San okenn ran nan klas, pwofil la bay moun k ap li nan admisyon twa ranplasan alafwa. Li gen yon tab GPA pa senkyèm (klas la divize an senk pati) ak yon tab nòt pa depatman. Li deklare tou kantite maksimòm AP yon elèv ka pran, sa ki defini sa “pi rijid la” vle di isit la.

strings.text: of AP students scored 3+ in 2025 — up from 72% in 2021
strings.t: nan elèv AP yo te fè 3+ an 2025 — monte soti 72% an 2021

strings.text: These are college merit awards won by graduating seniors, not Gaston Day tuition scholarships. The school’s own Kimbrell awards are separate and appear in the Financial Aid area. The dollar total rose while the number of students fell (25 students/$2.75M in 2023 → 20/$3.87M in 2024). So the average per student roughly doubled across those two classes.
strings.t: Sa yo se prim merit inivèsite elèv fen etid yo genyen, se pa bous frè eskolè Gaston Day. Pwòp prim Kimbrell lekòl la apa epi yo parèt nan zòn Financial Aid la. Total an dola a monte pandan kantite elèv yo bese (25 elèv/$2.75M an 2023 → 20/$3.87M an 2024). Kidonk mwayèn pa elèv la prèske double atravè de klas sa yo.

strings.text: Where the curriculum goes deepest
strings.t: Kote kourikoulòm nan ale pi fon

strings.text: The fullest AP pairing on offer — both **Calculus AB** and **Calculus BC**, atop Honors PreCalculus, Honors Calculus and Honors Statistics.
strings.t: Pè AP ki pi konplè yo ofri a — tou de **Calculus AB** ak **Calculus BC**, anwo Honors PreCalculus, Honors Calculus ak Honors Statistics.

strings.text: **AP Biology, AP Chemistry and AP Physics II**, with Honors Environmental Science and Honors Physics beneath them. Physics II as the AP (rather than Physics 1) implies a two-year sequence.
strings.t: **AP Biology, AP Chemistry ak AP Physics II**, ak Honors Environmental Science ak Honors Physics anba yo. Physics II kòm AP la (olye ke Physics 1) vle di gen yon sekans de ane.

strings.text: Computer science & engineering
strings.t: Syans enfòmatik ak enjenyri

strings.text: **AP Computer Science**, plus Honors Engineering and Honors Robotics as electives — feeding the VEX Robotics team that reached TSA VEX Nationals in 2023.
strings.t: **AP Computer Science**, plis Honors Engineering ak Honors Robotics kòm elektif — k ap nouri ekip VEX Robotics ki te rive nan TSA VEX Nationals an 2023.

strings.text: DE opens in the fall of grade 11; students may replace **up to two elective credits** with DE credit in each of grades 11 and 12. **Intro to Business (H)(DE)** is taught by Gaston Day faculty. DE grades are **not** calculated into the GPA.
strings.t: DE louvri nan otòn grad 11 la; elèv yo ka ranplase **jiska de kredi elektif** ak kredi DE nan chak nan grad 11 ak 12. **Intro to Business (H)(DE)** se pwofesè Gaston Day k ap anseye l. Nòt DE yo **pa** antre nan kalkil GPA a.

strings.text: Beyond the classroom
strings.t: Pi lwen pase sal klas la

strings.text: A **Capstone Project of at least 40 hours** is required of every senior — internship, research or service — beginning in the second semester of junior year and reported on throughout.
strings.t: Yo egzije yon **Capstone Project omwen 40 èdtan** pou chak elèv dènye ane — estaj, rechèch oswa sèvis — ki kòmanse nan dezyèm semès onzyèm ane a epi ki rapòte pandan tout tan an.

strings.text: Weighted, on a stated scale
strings.t: Ak pwa, sou yon echèl ki deklare

strings.text: A 4.0 scale with a published band table (100–97 = 4.330 down to 62–60 = 0.670); **Honors +0.50, AP +1.0**. Only GDS coursework counts — outside courses appear on the transcript but are excluded from the GPA.
strings.t: Yon echèl 4.0 ak yon tab bann ki pibliye (100–97 = 4.330 desann rive 62–60 = 0.670); **Honors +0.50, AP +1.0**. Sèlman kou GDS yo konte — kou deyò yo parèt sou relve nòt la men yo eskli yo nan GPA a.

strings.text: The profile publishes all five GPA quintiles (fifths of the class) for the Class of 2026, as of the end of junior year. So a reader can place any applicant within the class without the school naming a #1.
strings.t: Pwofil la pibliye tout senk senkyèm GPA yo (klas la divize an senk pati) pou Klas 2026 la, jan yo te ye nan fen onzyèm ane a. Kidonk yon moun k ap li ka plase nenpòt aplikan nan klas la san lekòl la pa nonmen yon #1.

strings.text: The school publishes the most APs a student may take: **one AP in grade 10, three in each of grades 11 and 12**. That tells colleges exactly what the hardest schedule here looks like. So a normal six-course load is not read as thin.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye kantite maksimòm AP yon elèv ka pran: **yon sèl AP nan grad 10, twa nan chak nan grad 11 ak 12**. Sa di inivèsite yo egzakteman kijan orè ki pi difisil la sanble isit la. Kidonk yo pa li yon chaj nòmal sis kou kòm yon bagay mens.

strings.text: Grade distribution is published by department
strings.t: Distribisyon nòt yo pibliye pa depatman

strings.text: A 2024-25 table gives the A+/A/A-…D spread for English, Arts, History, Math, Science and Languages — an unusual disclosure that lets a reader calibrate a GDS grade against its own department.
strings.t: Yon tab 2024-25 bay repartisyon A+/A/A-…D pou English, Arts, History, Math, Science ak Languages — yon divilgasyon ki pa abityèl ki pèmèt yon moun k ap li kalibre yon nòt GDS kont pwòp depatman l.

strings.text: The profile publishes no AP score table by subject, no count of AP exams taken, and no National Merit record. So the 3+ rate is one school-wide figure per year, not a breakdown.
strings.t: Pwofil la pa pibliye okenn tab nòt AP pa matyè, okenn kantite egzamen AP yo pase, ni okenn dosye National Merit. Kidonk to 3+ la se yon sèl chif pou tout lekòl la chak ane, se pa yon dekoupaj.

strings.text: The standout strength here is unusually concrete for a small school. The school has a gold-medal iGEM synthetic-biology team and a VEX Robotics squad that reached TSA Nationals in its first year. And there is a required 40-hour Capstone every senior must defend.
strings.t: Pwen fò espesyal la isit la konkrè yon fason ki pa abityèl pou yon ti lekòl. Lekòl la gen yon ekip byoloji sentetik iGEM ki gen meday lò ak yon eskwad VEX Robotics ki te rive nan TSA Nationals nan premye ane l. Epi gen yon Capstone 40 èdtan obligatwa chak elèv dènye ane dwe defann.

strings.text: What the school cannot offer is wide name recognition. Gaston Day is a 510-student school in Gastonia, not a nationally known feeder school. So its case rests on being distinctive, not on sending many students.
strings.t: Sa lekòl la pa ka ofri se yon non ki byen koni toupatou. Gaston Day se yon lekòl 510 elèv nan Gastonia, se pa yon lekòl ki konnen nasyonalman pou voye anpil elèv nan gwo inivèsite. Kidonk agiman li chita sou sa ki fè l diferan, se pa sou kantite elèv li voye.

strings.text: what a student can actually point at
strings.t: sa yon elèv ka reyèlman montre

strings.text: **iGEM synthetic biology** — teams in 2012, 2016, 2018 and 2020, with a **gold medal**. Projects included a kudzu phytotoxin (a plant poison) and an *E. coli* K-12 isobutanol biofuel. iGEM is a university-level contest with a high-school track. Fielding a team from a school this size is rare.
strings.t: **Byoloji sentetik iGEM** — ekip an 2012, 2016, 2018 ak 2020, ak yon **meday lò**. Pwojè yo te enkli yon fitotoksin kudzu (yon pwazon plant) ak yon byokabiran izobitanòl *E. coli* K-12. iGEM se yon konpetisyon nan nivo inivèsite ki gen yon pis pou lekòl segondè. Mete yon ekip sou teren apati yon lekòl gwosè sa a se yon bagay ki ra.

strings.text: **VEX Robotics** — for years Gaston Day was part of a FIRST Robotics team shared with other schools, which placed **4th at state**. Then it started its own team, which **qualified for TSA VEX Nationals in 2023, its first year competing**.
strings.t: **VEX Robotics** — pandan plizyè ane Gaston Day te fè pati yon ekip FIRST Robotics li te pataje ak lòt lekòl, ki te fè **4yèm nan eta a**. Apre sa li te lanse pwòp ekip pa l, ki te **kalifye pou TSA VEX Nationals an 2023, premye ane li nan konpetisyon**.

strings.text: **Capstone Project** — every senior completes an internship, research or service project of **at least 40 hours**. It is documented and reported on across a full year. It is required, so every applicant has one.
strings.t: **Capstone Project** — chak elèv dènye ane konplete yon estaj, yon rechèch oswa yon pwojè sèvis **omwen 40 èdtan**. Li dokimante epi rapòte pandan tout yon ane. Li obligatwa, kidonk chak aplikan genyen youn.

strings.text: **Sunship Earth peer mentoring** — juniors and seniors lead the fourth-grade class through a multi-day mountain programme, then mentor the same child for the rest of the year. A sustained leadership commitment rather than a one-off.
strings.t: **Mentoraj ant kanmarad Sunship Earth** — elèv onzyèm ak douzyèm ane mennen klas katriyèm ane a atravè yon pwogram plizyè jou nan mòn, epi apre sa yo mentore menm timoun nan pou rès ane a. Yon angajman lidèchip ki soutni olye ke yon bagay yon sèl fwa.

strings.text: **Blutopia** — the student-run literary and art magazine, with **numerous Scholastic Art and Writing Awards** and repeated recognition in the NC Scholastic Media Association Literary Magazine Contest.
strings.t: **Blutopia** — magazin literè ak atistik elèv yo dirije a, ak **anpil Scholastic Art and Writing Awards** ak rekonesans repete nan NC Scholastic Media Association Literary Magazine Contest la.

strings.text: **President’s Service Award** for 100+ service hours, atop a 25-hour annual requirement (40 for NHS).
strings.t: **President’s Service Award** pou 100+ èdtan sèvis, anwo yon egzijans anyèl 25 èdtan (40 pou NHS).

strings.text: what the name itself does
strings.t: sa non an limenm fè

strings.text: **Accreditation and memberships that a reader recognises** — Cognia/SACS CASI, NCAIS, SAIS, NAIS, plus NACAC and ACCIS on the counseling side.
strings.t: **Akreditasyon ak manm yon moun k ap li rekonèt** — Cognia/SACS CASI, NCAIS, SAIS, NAIS, plis NACAC ak ACCIS sou bò konsèy la.

strings.text: **A profile built for admissions readers** — quintiles, grades by department, stated AP limits and published transcript timing all make a GDS record easy to read. That is a quieter kind of advantage.
strings.t: **Yon pwofil bati pou moun k ap li nan admisyon** — senkyèm, nòt pa depatman, limit AP ki deklare ak lè relve nòt yo pibliye tout fè yon dosye GDS fasil pou li. Sa se yon avantaj ki pi trankil.

strings.text: **International students and a Global Classroom Initiative** — partnerships with schools overseas for grades 10–12 and a documented homestay programme. They give the applicant pool a genuinely international character.
strings.t: **Elèv entènasyonal ak yon Global Classroom Initiative** — patenarya ak lekòl aletranje pou grad 10–12 ak yon pwogram lojman lakay ki dokimante. Yo bay gwoup aplikan yo yon karaktè vrèman entènasyonal.

strings.text: **A five-county draw** — Gaston, Lincoln, Cleveland, Mecklenburg and York counties, so the school is regionally rather than locally known.
strings.t: **Yon zòn senk konte** — konte Gaston, Lincoln, Cleveland, Mecklenburg ak York, kidonk lekòl la konnen rejyonalman olye ke lokalman.

strings.text: The school publishes no evidence of ties with college admissions offices. It gives no counts of college rep visits and makes no claims about its alumni network. So its pull with colleges is judged from accreditation and profile quality, not shown.
strings.t: Lekòl la pa pibliye okenn prèv relasyon ak biwo admisyon inivèsite. Li pa bay okenn kantite vizit reprezantan inivèsite epi li pa fè okenn reklamasyon sou rezo ansyen elèv li. Kidonk enfliyans li ak inivèsite yo jije apati akreditasyon ak kalite pwofil la, li pa demontre.

strings.text: The iGEM gold medal is third-party-confirmed: the iGEM team wikis return 403 to automated fetches, so the medal level was not re-verified at source in this pass. Team participation in 2012, 2016, 2018 and 2020 is confirmed by the archived team pages.
strings.t: Yon twazyèm pati konfime meday lò iGEM la: wiki ekip iGEM yo bay 403 bay fetch otomatik, kidonk nou pa t re-verifye nivo meday la nan sous la nan pas sa a. Paj ekip ki achive yo konfime patisipasyon ekip la an 2012, 2016, 2018 ak 2020.

strings.text: A class of 35 with a published five-year test series and all five GPA quintiles — enough to see the whole class, not just its top.
strings.t: Yon klas 35 elèv ak yon seri tès senk ane ki pibliye ak tout senk senkyèm GPA yo — ase pou wè tout klas la, se pa sèlman tèt li.

strings.text: The bottom fifth sits at 2.5–3.05 and the top at 4.3–4.74, so the spread is real and the school publishes it rather than leading with a single average.
strings.t: Senkyèm anba a chita nan 2.5–3.05 epi tèt la nan 4.3–4.74, kidonk repartisyon an reyèl epi lekòl la pibliye l olye ke li kòmanse ak yon sèl mwayèn.

strings.text: Published as ranges rather than quintile means, and the ranges are reproduced exactly as printed. Because Honors adds +0.50 and AP +1.0, a top-quintile GPA above 4.0 reflects course weighting as much as raw grades. Note the school states grades 10–12 must hold a cumulative 2.0 in core courses, so the bottom of the fifth quintile sits well clear of the academic-standing floor.
strings.t: Yo pibliye yo kòm entèval olye ke mwayèn pa senkyèm, epi nou repwodui entèval yo egzakteman jan yo enprime yo. Paske Honors ajoute +0.50 epi AP +1.0, yon GPA nan senkyèm anwo a ki pi wo pase 4.0 reflete pwa kou yo menm jan ak nòt brit yo. Note ke lekòl la deklare grad 10–12 dwe kenbe yon 2.0 kimilatif nan kou debaz yo, kidonk anba senkyèm senkyèm nan chita byen lwen anwo planche estati akademik la.

strings.text: Learning Academy
strings.t: Learning Academy

strings.text: A **Coordinate Program** for students with diagnosed learning disabilities, running alongside the standard curriculum.
strings.t: Yon **Coordinate Program** pou elèv ki gen andikap aprantisaj yo dyagnostike, k ap kouri ansanm ak kourikoulòm estanda a.

strings.text: Intervention
strings.t: Entèvansyon

strings.text: **Early Reading and Math Intervention** in the Lower School, so support is not only a secondary-school offering.
strings.t: **Early Reading and Math Intervention** nan Lower School la, kidonk sipò a pa sèlman yon ofrann nan lekòl segondè.

strings.text: Therapies on site
strings.t: Terapi sou plas

strings.text: **Speech and Language Therapy** and **Occupational Therapy** are provided at school.
strings.t: Yo bay **Speech and Language Therapy** ak **Occupational Therapy** nan lekòl la.

strings.text: Coaching
strings.t: Konsèy pèsonalize

strings.text: **Academic Coaching** and tutoring, plus a paid on-site summer tutoring programme open to non-students at $30/half-hour.
strings.t: **Academic Coaching** ak titora, plis yon pwogram titora ete peye sou plas ki louvri pou moun ki pa elèv a $30/demi-èdtan.

strings.text: World language exception
strings.t: Eksepsyon pou lang etranje

strings.text: International students for whom English is a second language are **not required** to take an additional world language — a documented accommodation within the graduation requirements.
strings.t: Elèv entènasyonal ki gen angle kòm dezyèm lang **pa oblije** pran yon lang etranje anplis — yon akomodasyon ki dokimante anndan egzijans gradyasyon yo.

strings.text: If a student is in the middle
strings.t: Si yon elèv nan mitan an

strings.text: Everyone gets an advisor
strings.t: Tout moun jwenn yon konseye pèsonèl

strings.text: Every Upper School student gets a faculty advisor matched to their interests and needs. The advisor **stays with them through graduation**. That steady support does not depend on being a top student.
strings.t: Chak elèv Upper School jwenn yon pwofesè konseye ki matche ak enterè ak bezwen yo. Konseye a **rete ak yo jiska gradyasyon**. Sipò fiks sa a pa depann de si w se yon elèv nan tèt la.

strings.text: Everyone gets the counselor
strings.t: Tout moun jwenn konseye a

strings.text: With ~18 seniors per counselor, the office reaches the whole class rather than triaging to the strongest applicants.
strings.t: Ak ~18 elèv dènye ane pa konseye, biwo a rive jwenn tout klas la olye ke li triye pou pi bon aplikan yo.

strings.text: A six-course load, not a race
strings.t: Yon chay sis kou, se pa yon kous

strings.text: AP access is deliberately capped (1 in grade 10, 3 in grades 11 and 12), so the transcript ceiling is defined and a moderate load is normal rather than remedial.
strings.t: Aksè AP limite espre (1 nan grad 10, 3 nan grad 11 ak 12), kidonk plafon relve nòt la defini epi yon chay modere nòmal olye ke remedyal.

strings.text: Demanding non-AP courses
strings.t: Kou egzijan ki pa AP

strings.text: A broad Honors tier sits below the AP courses across every department, plus dual enrollment from grade 11 for students who want college credit without an AP exam.
strings.t: Yon nivo Honors laj chita anba kou AP yo nan chak depatman, plis doub enskripsyon apati grad 11 pou elèv ki vle kredi inivèsitè san yon egzamen AP.

strings.text: A required spike for everyone
strings.t: Yon pwen fò obligatwa pou tout moun

strings.text: The 40-hour Capstone and the 25-hour annual service requirement mean every graduate has something concrete to write about, not only the students who sought it out.
strings.t: Capstone 40 èdtan an ak egzijans sèvis anyèl 25 èdtan an vle di chak gradye gen yon bagay konkrè pou ekri sou li, se pa sèlman elèv ki te chèche l yo.

strings.text: No counts of test-takers are published for any year. So you cannot tell what share of a ~35-student class took the SAT. With so few students, a mid-50% range can shift sharply because of just a few of them.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn kantite moun ki pase tès ki pibliye pou okenn ane. Kidonk ou pa ka di ki pòsyon nan yon klas ~35 elèv ki te pase SAT la. Ak si tèlman pe elèv, yon entèval mitan 50% ka chanje anpil akoz jis kèk nan yo.

strings.text: The quintile table gives ranges only, with no average SAT or ACT for each fifth. So a reader cannot link a GPA band to test scores, as some peer profiles allow.
strings.t: Tab senkyèm nan bay entèval sèlman, san okenn mwayèn SAT oswa ACT pou chak senkyèm. Kidonk yon moun k ap li pa ka lye yon bann GPA ak nòt tès, jan kèk pwofil parèy pèmèt.

strings.text: A small school that publishes like a much larger one — five-year test and AP series, full GPA quintiles, a department-level grade distribution and a seven-year acceptance list.
strings.t: Yon ti lekòl ki pibliye tankou yon lekòl pi gwo anpil — seri tès ak AP senk ane, senkyèm GPA konplè, yon distribisyon nòt nan nivo depatman ak yon lis akseptasyon sèt ane.

strings.text: The concerns are about size and disclosure, not quality. With a 35-senior class, every rate can swing a lot. And the public athletics and club rosters are thinner than the academic record.
strings.t: Enkyetid yo konsène gwosè ak divilgasyon, se pa kalite. Ak yon klas 35 elèv dènye ane, chak to ka chanje anpil. Epi lis piblik atletism ak klib yo pi mens pase dosye akademik la.

strings.text: The AP trend is real and rising
strings.t: Tandans AP la reyèl epi l ap monte

strings.text: The 3+ rate went 72% → 76% → 86% → 89% → **95%** across 2021–2025, and because **every AP student must sit the exam**, that rate is not flattered by opting out.
strings.t: To 3+ la te ale 72% → 76% → 86% → 89% → **95%** atravè 2021–2025, epi paske **chak elèv AP dwe pase egzamen an**, to sa a pa flate paske moun pa patisipe.

strings.text: Rank is replaced, not merely omitted
strings.t: Yo ranplase ran an, yo pa senpleman kite l deyò

strings.text: Most no-rank schools stop there. Gaston Day publishes a **five-band GPA quintile table**, a **grade distribution by department**, and **defined AP maxima** — three separate substitutes.
strings.t: Pifò lekòl san ran kanpe la. Gaston Day pibliye yon **tab GPA senk bann pa senkyèm**, yon **distribisyon nòt pa depatman**, ak **maksimòm AP ki defini** — twa ranplasan apa.

strings.text: Counseling starts in eighth grade
strings.t: Konsèy kòmanse nan uityèm ane

strings.text: Course planning begins four years before applications, and the ~18:1 senior caseload is among the lowest on this roster.
strings.t: Planifikasyon kou kòmanse kat ane anvan aplikasyon yo, epi chay ~18:1 pou elèv dènye ane a pami pi ba sou lis sa a.

strings.text: The spike is institutional
strings.t: Pwen fò a enstitisyonèl

strings.text: A **gold-medal iGEM** team, **TSA VEX Nationals in year one**, and a **required 40-hour Capstone** mean distinctiveness is built into the programme rather than left to the individual student.
strings.t: Yon ekip **iGEM ak meday lò**, **TSA VEX Nationals nan premye ane a**, ak yon **Capstone 40 èdtan obligatwa** vle di distenksyon bati anndan pwogram nan olye ke yo kite l pou chak elèv poukont li.

strings.text: The acceptance breadth is genuine
strings.t: Lajè akseptasyon an vre

strings.text: **231 institutions** including Yale, Stanford, Dartmouth, Duke, Johns Hopkins and Georgetown, plus 24 top-75 liberal arts colleges — wide range for classes of ~35.
strings.t: **231 enstitisyon** ki enkli Yale, Stanford, Dartmouth, Duke, Johns Hopkins ak Georgetown, plis 24 kolèj liberal arts nan top-75 — yon gran varyete pou klas ~35 elèv.

strings.text: The money is disclosed
strings.t: Lajan an divilge

strings.text: Four years of merit-scholarship totals are published — **$3.76M for 21 students in 2025** — where many schools publish none.
strings.t: Kat ane total bous merit yo pibliye — **$3.76M pou 21 elèv an 2025** — kote anpil lekòl pa pibliye okenn.

strings.text: With 35 seniors and two counselors, does Kristy Smith carry her own caseload, or is the ~18:1 figure really 35:1 against the Director?
strings.t: Ak 35 elèv dènye ane ak de konseye, èske Kristy Smith gen pwòp chay pa l, oswa èske chif ~18:1 la se vrèman 35:1 kont Direktè a?

strings.text: The acceptance list covers seven years — where did the last two graduating classes actually enroll, and in what concentrations?
strings.t: Lis akseptasyon an kouvri sèt ane — kote de dènye klas ki gradye yo te enskri reyèlman, epi nan ki konsantrasyon?

strings.text: What share of a class sits the SAT versus the ACT, given the ACT is required in grade 11 and no tester counts are published?
strings.t: Ki pòsyon nan yon klas ki pase SAT la kont ACT la, etandone ACT la obligatwa nan grad 11 epi pa gen okenn kantite moun ki pase tès ki pibliye?

strings.text: The AP cap is one course in grade 10 and three in grades 11–12 — how is that applied to a student who wants more, and does it ever get waived?
strings.t: Plafon AP la se yon kou nan grad 10 ak twa nan grad 11–12 — kijan yo aplike sa pou yon elèv ki vle plis, epi èske yo janm bay yon dispans?

strings.text: What does the Learning Academy Coordinate Program cost, who qualifies, and how are College Board accommodations documented?
strings.t: Konbyen Learning Academy Coordinate Program la koute, kiyès ki kalifye, epi kijan yo dokimante akomodasyon College Board yo?

strings.text: The International Program runs through one exclusive agency (ABC Education Group) — what English-language support exists on campus for those students?
strings.t: International Program la pase nan yon sèl ajans eksklizif (ABC Education Group) — ki sipò nan lang angle ki egziste sou kanpis la pou elèv sa yo?

strings.text: Enrollment reads 510 on the school profile but 466 and 448 on third-party and federal sources — which counts preschool, and what is the Upper School number?
strings.t: Enskripsyon an li 510 sou pwofil lekòl la men 466 ak 448 sou sous twazyèm pati ak federal — kilès ki konte preschool, epi ki nimewo Upper School la?
